izzyondroid:com.jbselfcompany.tyr.name: Tyr - P2P Email
izzyondroid:com.jbselfcompany.tyr.summary: True P2P email and built-in chat over Yggdrasil network. No central servers.
izzyondroid:com.jbselfcompany.tyr.description:
Tyr is a revolutionary Android application that provides true peer-to-peer email communication using the Yggdrasil mesh network. Unlike traditional email systems that rely on centralized servers, Tyr runs a complete email server directly on your device.
 Key Features: 
 True P2P Email - No central servers, no cloud infrastructure. Your device IS the email server.
 Built-in Tyr Chat - Native P2P messenger built directly into the app. No third-party client required. Send messages and photos over Yggdrasil instantly.
 Yggdrasil Integration - Built on the Yggdrasil overlay mesh network providing secure, end-to-end encrypted connections.
 Standard Protocols - Exposes SMTP/IMAP protocols on localhost, compatible with standard email clients like DeltaChat.
 Privacy First - All data stays on your device. Encrypted configuration backup with AES-256-GCM encryption.
 DeltaChat Ready - Seamless integration with DeltaChat for instant messaging over email.
 Cryptographic Identity - Your email address is derived from your Ed25519 public key, ensuring authenticity.
 Mesh Networking - Connect via public Yggdrasil peers or configure your own custom peers. Automatic peer selection tests the public peers, keeps the fastest one plus a backup, and switches to the backup if the main peer goes down.
 Battery Optimized - Sophisticated power management with timed wake locks and network monitoring.
 Secure by Design - Password protection using Android Keystore with EncryptedSharedPreferences.
 Backup & Restore - Export and import all settings with optional inclusion of your cryptographic keys.
 Technical Details: 
 The app runs a foreground service that manages the native Yggmail library (Go-based), providing SMTP on port 1025 and IMAP on port 1143 (localhost only). Your mail address format is: <64-hex-characters>@yggmail, cryptographically derived from your Ed25519 key pair.
 Perfect For: 
 Privacy enthusiasts who want control over their communications
 Users seeking decentralized alternatives to traditional email
 DeltaChat users wanting P2P messaging infrastructure
 Anyone interested in mesh networking technology
 Requirements: 
 Android 6.0 (API 23) or higher
 Internet connection for initial Yggdrasil peer connections
 Battery optimization exemption recommended for best performance
 Join the peer-to-peer email revolution with Tyr.

izzyondroid:rikka.safetynetchecker.name: Yet Another SafetyNet Attestation Checker
izzyondroid:rikka.safetynetchecker.description:
YASNAC (short for Yet Another SafetyNet Attestation Checker) is an Android app that demonstrates SafetyNet Attestation API.
 The API key used by YASNAC has a quota of 10,000 times per day. If the quota is exhausted, you will see an error and you will not be able to use it until the quota is restored the next day.
 SafetyNet is developed by Google, it provides a set of services and APIs. SafetyNet Attestation API provides a cryptographically-signed attestation, assessing the device's integrity. The app developer can use SafetyNet Attestation API to check if the device is an emulator, bootloader unlocked, system integrity compromised (root for example), etc.
 This app uses SafetyNet Attestation API and displays the result.
 In an production environment, the response of the SafetyNet Attestation API should be transfer to a remote server for verification. As a simple demonstration project, it is impractical to provide a server, so the verification step runs locally.

fdroid:com.baluchon.app.name: Baluchon
fdroid:com.baluchon.app.summary: Share expenses: trips with friends, or kids' costs between separated parents
fdroid:com.baluchon.app.description:
Baluchon helps you manage shared expenses with friends or family during a trip (vacation,
weekend, group travel...), or share costs over time with a "shared account" (for example
kids' expenses between separated parents).
Main features:
* Create a trip and group your participants by family (optional).
* Assign a weight to each participant (normal share = 1, half share for a child for
 example), individually adjustable for each expense.
* Record your expenses, dated and named, with one or more payers (total amount calculated
 automatically, simple calculations accepted like "12+8").
* Choose precisely who is concerned by each expense.
* Shared accounts: add the children, attach expenses to them and set the split between the
 parents per child, with exceptions by category (for example 50/50 for health, 70/30 for
 activities). Recurring expenses are created automatically, and periods close
 automatically once the accounts are at zero.
* View each person's (or family's) balance, the total trip cost per person, and the
 minimal list of reimbursements to make.
* Record a real transfer between two people to settle up.
* Handle multiple currencies with a custom exchange rate per expense.
* Export the full summary as PDF, or as JSON to share between devices and merge expenses
 from several participants at the end of the trip.
* Import participants directly from your contacts.
* Duplicate a trip (participants and families only) for a recurring trip with the same
 group of friends.
Baluchon is completely free, open source (GPL-3.0-or-later license), ad-free, with no
account required, and works fully offline: all your data stays on your phone.
Source code: https://framagit.org/android1/baluchon

fdroid:com.garfiec.librechat.name: Switchboard: A LibreChat Mobile App
fdroid:com.garfiec.librechat.summary: Native LibreChat client: multi-account, offline reading, dictation
fdroid:com.garfiec.librechat.description:
All of LibreChat, built for Android. Switchboard keeps the LibreChat you're used to and makes it faster and more natural on a phone, tablet or foldable. It also does things the website can't, from reading your chats offline to keeping the apps it builds on your home screen.
You need your own LibreChat server. There is no hosted service and no default server. Switchboard is a third-party app and is not affiliated with the LibreChat project.
Why not just use the web app in a browser?
* Smoother and faster — a real native app rather than a website in a wrapper, so scrolling, typing and watching responses stream all feel snappier.
* Built for touch — swipe to switch accounts, swipe back, comfortable tap targets, and a layout that adapts to tablets and foldables.
* Integrated with your phone — share text, images and files into the app, pin a generated artifact to your home screen, get shortcuts to the models you use most, and save or share images through the system menus.
* Works offline — your chat list and any conversation you have opened are stored on the device, so you can keep reading with poor or no signal.
* Multiple accounts — sign in to different accounts on different servers and switch instantly, with storage scoped per account.
Features
* Chat — real-time streaming, message branching and sibling navigation, stop/regenerate/fork, markdown with syntax highlighting, LaTeX maths, copyable code blocks, file attachments, tool-call progress cards, and an approval panel that asks before a tool runs.
* Artifacts — Mermaid, SVG, HTML, React and Markdown artifacts open in a viewer sheet, or full screen if you prefer, and each type can be switched on to render inline instead. Any artifact can be pinned to the home screen.
* Models — searchable picker grouped by endpoint, starred models sorted first, and a comparison mode that runs two models on the same prompt: side by side on wider screens, swipe between them on narrow ones.
* Agents — marketplace with search and categories, plus MCP server configuration.
* Conversations — paginated list with date grouping, tags, search, rename, archive, delete, share, duplicate and export.
* Media — full-screen viewer with pinch-to-zoom and swiping between images; attach from the device or reuse server files without re-uploading.
* Themes — pick any accent colour and the whole app regenerates a Material 3 palette around it; system/light/dark modes, wallpaper-based colours on Android 12+, and a choice of the Material or Liquid Glass interface style.
* Voice — dictation, live and on-device on Android 12 and later, and text-to-speech playback.
* Accessibility — semantic headings, content descriptions, comfortable touch targets, and live regions that announce streaming replies.
Privacy
All chat traffic goes to the LibreChat server you configure. The app contains no analytics, no crash reporting and no advertising, and every script its renderers execute is bundled in the APK rather than fetched from a CDN.
Some images come from other hosts, none of them carrying your chat messages: web-search result cards load site icons from Google or an address your server supplies, only after you allow it; model icons and profile avatars load from whatever addresses your server's configuration supplies, which are often vendor or CDN URLs; attachments and generated images load straight from object storage when your server uses one; and generated HTML, React or Markdown artifacts may load images from any address they reference.
Dictation is the one thing that can carry content elsewhere: where your phone has no on-device recogniser, or it fails, voice typing falls back to the network one, which sends that audio to whichever service your phone uses. You can instead send audio to your own LibreChat server.
Compatibility
Built against LibreChat v0.8.9-rc1. Earlier v0.8.x servers are expected to work, with features gated on what your server reports; newer releases on a best-effort basis until the next sync.

fdroid:com.oksigenia.oksigenia_sos.name: Oksigenia SOS
fdroid:com.oksigenia.oksigenia_sos.summary: Smart safety and distress alerts with fall and inactivity detection.
fdroid:com.oksigenia.oksigenia_sos.description:
Oksigenia SOS is an offline-first personal safety app for outdoor sports and high-risk environments. No account, no cloud, no Google Services required — everything runs on your device.
When something goes wrong, it sends an SMS alert with your GPS coordinates to your emergency contact. No internet connection needed.
Smart Fall Detection (Smart Sentinel)
The accelerometer monitors you continuously at high frequency. A sudden impact triggers an observation window. If sustained walking movement is detected during that window, the alarm is dismissed automatically — false positives from drops or normal jolts won't fire the SOS. If no rhythmic movement is detected, the SOS is sent.
Activity profiles
Pick the profile that matches what you're doing — Smart Sentinel adapts its sensitivity:
- Trekking / Hiking: balanced default for walking outdoors.
- Running (road): tuned for the sustained high-G cadence of road running, with an adaptive rhythm detector.
- Trail running / MTB: higher impact threshold for terrain with constant vibration.
- Mountaineering: longer observation window for slow recoveries on technical ground.
- Paragliding / Kayak / Watersports: automatic fall detection is disabled (the sensor cannot reliably interpret flight or water motion); inactivity monitor and manual SOS remain active.
- Professional / Rescue: extended observation window for advanced operational use.
Inactivity Monitor (Dead Man's Switch)
Set a check-in timer. If you don't confirm you're OK before it expires, the alert is sent automatically. Essential for solo adventures where a fall might leave you conscious but unable to call for help.
Live Tracking
Send your GPS position by SMS every 30, 60 or 120 minutes. Pause, resume or check in manually at any time — without stopping the monitoring session.
Dying Gasp
When the battery drops below 5%, a final SMS with your last GPS position is sent automatically before the phone shuts down.
Privacy and Compatibility
- No account or registration required
- All data stays on your device — no cloud sync, no telemetry
- No trackers, no analytics, no ads
- Works on de-Googled phones (GrapheneOS, MicroG)
- Open source under GPLv3
About the permissions
Oksigenia SOS asks for sensitive permissions because its job is to call for help when you cannot. Each one maps to a single rescue function:
- SMS: sends the alert. SMS is the only channel that works in the mountains without internet.
- Location, including "Allow all the time" (background location): when you fall, your phone is in your pocket with the screen off and the app in the background. Without background access, Android can deny a fresh GPS fix at exactly that moment, and the SOS would leave without usable coordinates. Your position is read only when an alert or tracking update is being sent, and it travels exclusively inside the SMS to the contacts you configured — it is never uploaded anywhere. The app has no network access at all: it does not even request the INTERNET permission.
- Motion sensors / physical activity: fall and inactivity detection.
- Battery exemption: so Android doesn't kill the monitoring service mid-route.
A safety app that prioritised permission minimalism over getting your coordinates to a rescuer would be failing at its only job. The privacy guarantee here is structural, not cosmetic: everything stays on the device.
Available in 11 languages.
IMPORTANT: Oksigenia SOS is a support tool and does not replace professional emergency services. Its operation depends on mobile coverage, GPS signal and battery level.

fdroid:com.seiko.keystoreviewer.name: KeyStoreViewer: App Signatures
fdroid:com.seiko.keystoreviewer.summary: Inspect app and APK signing certificates, fingerprints, and public keys.
fdroid:com.seiko.keystoreviewer.description:
Find the signing information you need for Android apps.
KeyStoreViewer helps developers inspect signing certificates from installed apps and APK files. View MD5, SHA-1, and SHA-256 certificate fingerprints and public key information without digging through command-line output.
KEY FEATURES
• Inspect the signing information of installed apps.
• Open an APK file to view its signing certificates.
• View MD5, SHA-1, and SHA-256 certificate fingerprints.
• View public key information, including the modulus for RSA keys.
• Copy fingerprints and public key values, or share signature details.
BUILT FOR EVERYDAY DEVELOPMENT
• Find the certificate fingerprints required by APIs and third-party SDKs.
• Retrieve signature and public key information for app registration.
• Investigate signing differences between debug and release builds.
Certificate fingerprints identify signing certificates. They are not APK file checksums, and a matching signature alone does not guarantee that an app is safe.

fdroid:de.jepfa.bdt.name: Break.Down.Timer
fdroid:de.jepfa.bdt.description:
This is a handy timer that lets you set notifications ("breaks") during the timer's duration.
Imagine this scenario: You have 45 minutes for a walk and should return halfway through.
So, set the timer duration to 45 minutes, define a break at the halfway point, and start the timer.
You will now receive a notification (audio, vibration, device notification) once the halfway point is reached,
AND, of course, when the entire time has elapsed.
Other scenarios include notifications every 15 minutes to keep track of the elapsed and remaining time.
Or to receive notifications shortly before the timer expires.
The notifications are coded as audio signals and/or vibrations so you can recognize the breaks without having to look at the display.
The pattern is very simple: A short beep means "1," a long beep means "5." "Beeeeep beep," for example, means "6."
All signals begin with a short "bep-bep" sequence to attract your attention.
Thanks to the audio and vibration patterns, you'll be notified of the timer's progress without having to take your smartphone out of your pocket.
This is especially convenient during workouts or other outdoor activities.
 Features: 
 - Up to 20 notifications ("breaks") during a timer run
 - Audible and haptic feedback
 - Intuitive patterns to indicate the current reached break
 - Two different timer modes, "Timer" and "Clock"
 - Various predefined "break" presets
 - Save your own presets
 - Various color and audio schemes
 - Pre-timer to get the actual timer started at a precise moment
 - Pausing and resuming a running timer
 - Single or infinite repetitions of the timer run
For more information see bdt.jepfa.de

fdroid:net.moasdawiki.app.name: MoasdaWiki
fdroid:net.moasdawiki.app.description:
MoasdaWiki App is a privacy-friendly frontend for the MoasdaWiki Server
knowledge management tool. It mirrors the Wiki content on your mobile device.
 Features: 
- Synchronizes the content from your MoasdaWiki Server instance.
- Fast full text search.
- Calendar integration: Shows birthdays and events in the mobile calendar.
- Data privacy by design: Directly connects to your server instance in your private network. No trackers, never establishes a cloud connection.
 Synchronize content with a MoasdaWiki Server: 
1. Download MoasdaWiki Server from https://moasdawiki.net/.
2. Set up a MoasdaWiki Server instance in your LAN.
3. Enable LAN access to the server: Edit the repository file config.txt and change the setting authentication.onlylocalhost = false. Restart the server afterwards.
4. Install the MoasdaWiki App.
5. In the app you can see a hint that it has to be configured first. Press on that hint.
6. Press on "Host name" and enter the host name or IP address of the server instance, e.g. 192.168.1.101. Press OK.
7. In the status section below you should see "Needs authorization at server". Otherwise check host name and port again.
8. On server side open the Wiki page in a browser, click on "Help" and "Synchronization".
9. You can see a list of devices and synchronization sessions. Check the device name and click on "Grant".
10. Back in the app press the back button on the upper left corner to get back to the main dialog. Now you can see a hint that the app has to be synchronized. Press on that hint.
11. Now you should have all the server content also in the app and you can see the "Home-App" wiki page.
Hint: Content cannot be modified within the app as it is no fun to type Wiki syntax on the mobile device, changes have to be done via the MoasdaWiki Server.

fdroid:neth.iecal.curbox.name: App Blocker: Curbox Detox
fdroid:neth.iecal.curbox.summary: App blocker and screen time tracker. Block apps, websites, reels and shorts.
fdroid:neth.iecal.curbox.description:
Curbox (formerly Digipauwse) is a free and open source app blocker and screen time tracker built for digital wellbeing and a real digital detox. As an app blocker it lets you block apps, websites, reels and shorts, then watch your screen time drop and your focus come back.
 Block apps and websites 
• App and Website Blocker : block any distracting app or website completely
• URL Path Blocking : block just one part of a site, like m.youtube.com/shorts, while the rest of YouTube still works
• Short Form Content Blocker : shut off Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts so the feed stops pulling you back
• Instagram DM Exception : choose to allow Reels opened from your DM inbox
• Tamper Protection : make it difficult to uninstall Curbox or turn off its blocking service
• Settings Change Delay : make weaker rule changes wait before they take effect, giving you time to reconsider
 Hide only the distracting parts 
Granular UI Hiding lets you remove the trap inside an app without losing the app. Curbox lays a clean overlay over the exact area you pick, so everything else keeps working. For example, hide the YouTube home feed but keep search, blank out the Instagram explore tab, or the entire home feed while allowing posts from friends. You stay in control of what you see.
 Stay focused 
• Focus Mode : pause apps and websites for a set time, or use a Pomodoro timer for work and breaks
• Scheduled DND : turn on Do Not Disturb automatically at the hours you set
• App Specific Grayscale : drain the color out of Instagram while your Camera stays full color, so dull apps lose their pull
• Scheduled Usage Limits : set when a group is active and how much use is available during that time
• Mindful Messages : gentle overlay nudges with custom colors and variables to make each message your own
• Warning Messages : show a random message when you open a blocked app
• Attention Span Tracking : see how long you stay with short form videos before moving on
 See your time 
• Usage Analytics : daily and weekly views of time spent in each app and website, with a background you can choose
• Focus Statistics : track your focus sessions and your progress over time
• Live Scroll Counter : count short videos as you scroll, choose counter colors, or show it only at checkpoints
• Session Timer : a live timer of how long the current app has been open
• Home Screen Widgets : keep your stats and quick controls on your home screen
 Choose how hard it is to give in 
When you use all the time available in a schedule, you decide what it takes to get back in.
• Strict Blockade : no access at all
• Timed Unlocks : each unlock lasts a short set time, like 5 minutes
• Dynamic Unlocks : pick the unlock length yourself each time
• QR or Barcode Unlock : scan a real barcode, like one on a book, with a flashlight option for dark rooms
• Sentence Retyping : type out a full sentence before the app will open
• Unlock Limits : cap how many unlocks you get every few hours
• NFC Unlock : use a physical NFC tag to make unlocking a deliberate action
• Adaptive Math : solve a changing math challenge before you can unlock, with a wait after wrong answers
 Keep your setup 
Back up and restore your Curbox data so you can keep your setup when you need it again.
 Built for developers 
The Curbox API lets approved apps start Focus Mode, change Curbox settings, and read usage statistics. You stay in control of which apps receive access.
Curbox is the app blocker for anyone who wants to block distracting apps and websites, cut screen time, and take back their focus. Free, open source, no ads.

* Localization - Right now: English, German
 Usage: 
1. Enter your data in any 2 of the 3 fields
2. Tap "Calculate"
3. View your results
4. To clear all 3 fields, tap the "clear" Button.
🚨DISCLAIMER🚨: This is NOT a medical application NOR a medical product. This is just a calculator. Correct results are not guaranteed. User is responsible for checking results and plausibility.
Created with ❤️ by Valentin. 
Tags: calculator, alcoholic solution, volume percent, v/v, Volumenprozent, Volumenprozentrechner, Alkoholgehalt, alcohol content, mass of alcohol (grams), specific weigth, spezifisches Gewicht, Normalbedingungen.

flathub:io.github.suchnsuch.Tangent.name: Tangent
flathub:io.github.suchnsuch.Tangent.description:
Tangent lets you write the way you think. Your thoughts are connected; Tangent lets you link
 to existing notes and make new ones with ease. Let your mind wander along the path of interest.
 Don't suppress tangential thoughts; embrace them. Key features include:
 [[Wiki-link]] linking to other files in your workspace by name.
 Horizontally-scrolling sliding panels for quickly moving back and forth along a trail of
 thoughts.
 A Map View of the links between notes created and followed during your current session.
 Note creation automation with support for creating notes within folders defined by wildcards.
 Full-workspace note search powered by a custom query language.
 Tangent reads and writes plaintext notes using a loose interpretation of Markdown syntax. Text
 is rendered in a pseudo-WYSIWYG style, with formatting characters appearing only when you need
 them. Tangent supports bold, italics, headers, lists, links, images, todos, tags, inline code,
 block code with syntax highlighting, inline and block KaTeX math, color highlights, strikethrough,
 and comments.

Notorious is a keyboard centric notes app
 Notorious can be controlled entirely with your keyboard. No need to move your hand to the mouse, just open it up and dump your brain.
 In Notorious you can write your notes however you want, but if you like Markdown, you can easily enable syntax highlighting.
 No need to worry about saving. When you change note or exit the app whatever you wrote gets automatically saved.
 No need for cumbersome online sync features. Just choose a folder on your disk and that's it.
 Of course nothing stops you froms syncing that folder with your service of choice.

flathub:org.openscad.OpenSCAD.name: OpenSCAD
flathub:org.openscad.OpenSCAD.description:
OpenSCAD is a software for creating solid 3D CAD models. Unlike most free software for creating 3D models (such as Blender) it does not focus on the artistic aspects of 3D modelling but instead on the CAD aspects. Thus it might be the application you are looking for when you are planning to create 3D models of machine parts but pretty sure is not what you are looking for when you are more interested in creating computer-animated movies.
 OpenSCAD is not an interactive modeller. Instead it is something like a 3D-compiler that reads in a script file that describes the object and renders the 3D model from this script file. This gives you (the designer) full control over the modelling process and enables you to easily change any step in the modelling process or make designs that are defined by configurable parameters.
 OpenSCAD provides two main modelling techniques: First there is constructive solid geometry (aka CSG) and second there is extrusion of 2D outlines. As data exchange format for this 2D outlines Autocad DXF files are used. In addition to 2D paths for extrusion it is also possible to read design parameters from DXF files. Besides DXF files OpenSCAD can read and create 3D models in the STL and OFF file formats.

fedora-packages:azove/azove.name: azove
fedora-packages:azove/azove.description: Azove is a tool designed for counting (without explicit enumeration) and enumeration of 0/1 vertices. Given a polytope by a linear relaxation or facet description `P = {x | Ax <= b}`, all 0/1 points lying in P can be counted or enumerated. This is done by intersecting the polytope P with the unit-hypercube `[0,1] d`. The integral vertices (no fractional ones) of this intersection will be enumerated. If P is a 0/1 polytope, azove solves the vertex enumeration problem. In fact it can also solve the 0/1 knapsack problem and the 0/1 subset sum problem.

fedora-packages:ddupdate/ddupdate.description: A tool to update dynamic IP addresses typically obtained using DHCP with dynamic DNS services such as changeip.com, duckdns.org or no-ip.com. It makes it possible to access a machine with a fixed name like myhost.duckdns.org even if the ip address changes. ddupdate caches the address, and only attempts the update if the address actually is changed. The tool has a plugin structure with plugins for obtaining the actual address (typically hardware-dependent) and to update it (service depen‐ dent). fedora-packages:gfs-eustace-fonts/gfs-eu.description: As it is known, the Greek alphabet was used in majuscule form for over a millennium before the minuscule letters gradually replaced it until they became the official script in the 9th century A.D. Thereafter, majuscule letters were confined to sparse use as initials or elaborate titles until the Italian Renaissance. The new art of Typography, as well as the need of the humanists to mimic the ancient Greco-Roman period brought back the extensive use of the majuscule letter-forms in both Latin and Greek typography. Greek books of the time were printed using the contemporary Byzantine hand with which they combined capital letters modeled on the Roman antiquity, i.e. with thick and thin strokes and serifs. At the same time the Byzantine majuscule tradition, principally used on theological editions, remained alive until the early 19th century. GFS Eustace is a typical example of Byzantine woodcut initials used in many similar forms in Italy for Greek editions of the Bible, Prayers and other theological literature from the 15th to 19th centuries. It has been designed by George D. Matthiopoulos.

It can view astronomical data such as contained in files based on the FITS (Flexible Image Transport System) file format. It is written and is maintained by software engineers at the Subaru Telescope, National Astronomical Observatory of Japan. The Ginga toolkit centers around an image display class which supports zooming and panning, color and intensity mapping, a choice of several automatic cut levels algorithms and canvases for plotting scalable geometric forms. In addition to this widget, a general purpose “reference” FITS viewer is provided, based on a plugin framework. firefox-addons:2916634.name: ip8.com privacy & security tools
firefox-addons:2916634.summary: IP8.com tools as comprehensive suite for digital diagnostics, offering an array of technical tools to enhance your security & privacy.
firefox-addons:2916634.description:
IP8 Privacy Inspector is a powerful yet lightweight browser extension that gives you full visibility into your online identity and helps you stay private with a single click. It instantly shows your public IP address, geolocation, DNS servers, and privacy score, all in one streamlined dashboard.
This extension goes beyond basic IP lookups. It features built-in WebRTC leak protection to prevent your real IP from leaking during peer-to-peer connections, and offers a one-click DNS leak test to check if your system is leaking requests outside your VPN or secure tunnel.
It includes a Speed and Ping Test tool to quickly evaluate your connection quality, plus IPv4 and IPv6 compatibility checks to ensure you’re covered no matter your setup. The extension also displays reverse hostname, reverse DNS, ASN, and other technical data useful for power users.
With no ads, no tracking, and zero data collection, IP8 Privacy Inspector is designed for privacy-conscious users, VPN users, and anyone who wants to understand and control their digital footprint.

firefox-addons:1478584.description:
N-able Passportal is a cloud-based privileged access management solution built for MSPs and IT teams. This browser extension connects you to your Passportal vault so you can securely access, autofill, and manage credentials across all your clients and systems — without leaving your browser. 
Trusted by 2,500+ MSPs, 29,000 technicians, and protecting over 3 million assets worldwide. 
Secure Credential Access

Strong Password Management 
• Generate unique, complex passwords on demand — no more reuse, no more weak credentials 
• Automate password rotation and enforce policy-driven credential hygiene 
• Sync password changes across Active Directory, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 automatically 
Built for Teams, Not Just Individuals

Anywhere Access

Compliance-Ready

firefox-addons:3030885.summary: Hear videos in your language. Real-time AI dubbing and subtitles: YouTube free, Udemy, Coursera and more with Basic - 115 languages.
firefox-addons:3030885.description:
dubly.me adds real-time AI dubbing and translated subtitles to online video - so you can watch YouTube, Udemy, Coursera, Vimeo and more in your own language.
Found the perfect video, lecture or course... in a language you don't speak? Install dubly.me , open the video, pick your language - and hear it dubbed, read it in subtitles, or both. No uploading, no downloading, no editing. It just works, right in your browser.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Add dubly.me to Firefox
2. Open a video on a supported site
3. Pick your language and a mode: Dubbed voice, Subtitles or Both - the first minutes play instantly, the rest streams in the background
TWO WAYS TO WATCH
- Dubbed voice: natural AI speech over the video, made for lectures, tutorials and courses
- Subtitles: the original sound stays and the translation appears on screen - no voice is generated, made for films and series
- Both: listen and read along, handy for language learners
WHAT YOU GET
- Real-time AI dubbing with 322 natural neural voices
- Translated subtitles in 169 languages, dubbing with a voice in 115 - European, Asian, Middle Eastern and more, including Chinese (Simplified, Traditional and Cantonese)
- On YouTube free with YouTube's auto-translate; AI translation on Basic
- First minutes play instantly - no waiting for the full video
MORE WAYS TO FOLLOW ALONG
- Two-language subtitles: the original line right under the translation
- Subtitle look: high contrast, no background or light, in the size you like
- With headphones: the original in your left ear, the dubbed voice in your right
- Missed a sentence? Alt+Shift+R repeats it
- For language learners: sentence by sentence — the original first, a short pause, then the dubbed voice repeats it
- Download the subtitles as an .srt file: translation, original or both
- Pauses during YouTube ads and picks up right where the video left off
DEDICATED SUPPORT FOR 9 PLATFORMS
YouTube works on the free plan. With Basic, YouTube, Udemy, Coursera, Vimeo, edX, TED, Loom, Wistia, Netflix and Rumble get controls built into their own player. On other sites it works with the Basic plan when the page plays a plain video file.
MADE IN THE EU
Made in the EU. GDPR compliant. Your video and audio are never stored.
PERFECT FOR
- Language learners who want real, native content
- Students taking online courses in another language
- Viewers who prefer subtitles to a voice-over
- Anyone who found a great video... in the wrong language
FREE AND BASIC
- Free: YouTube with YouTube's auto-translate, 30 minutes a day with a free account (10 minutes a day without one) - no credit card needed
- Basic (€5/month): up to 9 hours a day on all platforms, AI translation as an option and your choice of voice, translation style (polite, plain language or close to the original) and metric units, a summary and chapters of the video without starting a dub
Add dubly.me to Firefox and watch your first video in your language in seconds.

firefox-addons:3056900.summary: Track price history, view trends, and get instant price-drop alerts across major Indian shopping sites.
firefox-addons:3056900.description:
PriceHistory.ai helps shoppers understand product prices, view historical trends, create price-drop alerts, and organize shopping activity from supported online stores.
To provide these features, the extension reads the current product URL and relevant visible product details—such as the product title, image, price, availability, and product identifier—on supported shopping pages. The necessary information is transmitted securely to PriceHistory.ai to retrieve and maintain price history, product tracking, and alerts.
 View historical price trends on supported product pages
 Compare the current price with previous prices
 Create price-drop alerts with a target price
 Access product information without repeatedly switching tabs
 Enable or disable the product-page companion from the extension popup
 Open the PriceHistory.ai dashboard directly from the extension
My Shopping Lens helps bring supported wishlist, cart, and open-order products together in one place.
Shopping synchronization happens only after you choose a supported store and confirm the action. The extension reads relevant product details from the selected shopping page and sends those details to your PriceHistory.ai account.
 PriceHistory.ai does not request or collect your shopping-site password or payment information.
Product-page features currently support major stores including:
 Amazon
 Flipkart
 Myntra
 Reliance Digital
 Nykaa
 FirstCry
Feature availability may vary depending on the store and product page.
The extension accesses supported shopping pages only to provide its disclosed price-history, tracking, alert, and optional shopping-synchronization features.
Some account-based features require signing in to PriceHistory.ai . You can disable product-page functionality from the extension popup.
Privacy policy: https://pricehistory.ai/privacy 
Buttons and product links presented inside the PriceHistory.ai extension interface may use affiliate links. PriceHistory.ai may earn a commission when you make an eligible purchase through one of these links, at no additional cost to you.
 PriceHistory.ai is an independent price-tracking service and is not endorsed by or affiliated with the supported retailers.
For questions or assistance, visit https://pricehistory.ai/contact or email support@pricehistory.ai .

firefox-addons:961473.name: Switch To Previous Active Tab & Reload All Tabs
firefox-addons:961473.summary: Activate the last accessed tab in the same window, or any window. Right-click the toolbar button for a most recent tabs list (MRU) and options. Adds "Reload All Tabs" to the tab right-click context menu. (For Fx115/Fx128, use "See all versions".)
firefox-addons:961473.description:
As you browse and switch tabs, this extension keeps track of the previous tab in each window so you can switch back to it with a single click. Right-click the toolbar button for more options.
 Note: You must click the toolbar button; extensions cannot change the left-click behavior of tabs. 
 Keyboard shortcut: Alt+Shift+Left Arrow switches to the immediately previous tab in the same window; on Mac, Ctrl+Shift+Left Arrow. Users of Firefox 66 and later can modify the shortcut through the Add-ons page: Manage extension shortcuts in Firefox .
 Version 2.1 adds optional "Go to Tab" shortcuts. You already have Ctrl+1, Ctrl+2, etc. (on Mac, Command+1, Command+2). If you want keyboard shortcuts that can skip pinned, hidden, and unloaded tabs, you can set those up on the Add-ons page (refer to the above article for where to do that).
 Reload All Tabs: "Reload All Tabs" on the tab context menu reloads all tabs that are not currently playing media. To force a full reload bypassing the cache, hold down the Shift key while clicking the menu command. (Fifth screenshot.)
You can set the extension to always bypass cache, to reload tabs with currently playing media, or to skip the active tab, pinned tabs, or pending/discarded tabs, on the Reload All Tabs Options tab. To call that up, either Ctrl+click "Reload All Tabs" or right-click the extension's toolbar button. (Sixth screenshot.)
 Permissions: "Access browser tabs" allows the extension to read the URLs, titles and site icon addresses of pages in tabs. Up to 30 URLs are kept in memory to build the list of recently accessed tabs. See: Permission request messages for Firefox extensions (scroll way down or use Find to get to Access browser tabs. 
 Background: Could be useful to those who miss this feature from the legacy extensions FLST (Firefox 4+) by fabianswebworld, LastTab by Timothy Humphrey, or Tab Mix Plus by onemen, Gary Reyes. However, to repeat: it's not possible to connect this extension to a click on the current tab.

bluejetty:00133486:ios.description:
Remove people from photos on your iPhone.
Key features:
• Remove unwanted people (and objects too)
• Use tapping to remove rather than drawing which is quicker and easier.
• Uses the latest AI to accurately remove even the largest foreground subjects (e.g. an ex-partner)
• Preserves original photo quality
• Selectively remove some people while keeping others
• Move people closer together to fill the gap left after removing someone — a unique way to keep group shots looking natural
• Clean up vacation and group photos
• Select all people to remove then choose who to exclude, making cleaning shots with lots of background people super easy.
--------
Can Removex remove large objects or people in the foreground?
Yes. Removex can accurately remove large subjects, including people standing close to the camera, while reconstructing the background naturally in full quality.
How is Removex different from Apple Photos’ cleanup tool?
Apple’s cleanup tool isn’t supported on many devices and often struggles with complex or large removals. Removex works on a wider range of phones and is designed to handle more difficult scenes with better consistency. It's also much easier to select lots of people to remove.
How is it superior to AI chat models like ChatGPT for image editing?
LLM-based editors regenerate the entire image, which can change faces, textures, and lighting. Removex edits only the selected area, preserving the original photo’s detail and realism.
Why should I use Removex for removing people rather than a different app?
Removex specialises in removing people and makes it super easy, we detect people first so you can just tap the people you want to remove without drawing (which is what most other apps make you do). We use more advanced AI than other apps for better results.
Will Removex change the rest of my photo?
No. Only the area you remove is modified, everything else remains exactly as captured.
Can I use Removex for vacation photos?
Absolutely. Removex is perfect for removing strangers, crowds, or distractions from travel photos.
Can I use Removex for group photos?
Yes. You can remove specific people from group shots without affecting others or distorting the scene.
Can I remove someone standing right next to me, like a partner or friend?
Yes. Removex is designed to handle close-contact situations and can remove someone beside you while keeping you intact and natural-looking.
Can I remove multiple people or objects at once?
Yes. You can remove multiple subjects in a single photo with just a few taps.
Will my photo lose quality after editing?
No. Removex preserves resolution and avoids the blurry or artificial look common in many AI-based editors.
Is Removex free?
Removex is free to download, and offers a free trial and even without the trial, the first erase is on us.
Is my data private?
Yes. Your photos are processed securely and are not used to train AI models.
How do I get support?
Email us: ben@bendoesapps.com, a real person (me Ben) will respond to you within a day.
Pro:
• You can subscribe to unlock Pro, which gives you unlimited watermark free erasing.
• Subscriptions auto-renew at the end of current period, unless cancelled 24-hours in advance prior to the end of the current period. The subscription fee is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Per Apple policy, no cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
App website: https://RemovexApp.com
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://bendoesapps.com/privacy

bluejetty:00023475:ios.summary: SSH Terminal+: Terminal & Stats is a comprehensive SSH dashboard and terminal tool designed for developers and system administrators. Experience seamless server management with powerful insights into server performance and a full-featured t
bluejetty:00023475:ios.description:
SSH Terminal+: Terminal & Stats is a comprehensive SSH dashboard and terminal tool designed for developers and system administrators. Experience seamless server management with powerful insights into server performance and a full-featured terminal interface—all in one app!
Key Features:
* Dynamic SSH Terminal: Enjoy a robust terminal experience with features like multi-session management, command history, and customizable keyboard shortcuts for efficient navigation. Execute commands with ease, and interact with your servers directly from your mobile device.
* Server List Overview: Quickly monitor all your servers at a glance, displaying key metrics like load, memory usage, swap space, disk usage, I/O rates, and network activity.
* Secure SSH Bastion & Proxy: Connect to your servers securely through SSH bastion or proxy, providing an additional layer of protection while accessing your infrastructure.
* Comprehensive System View: Dive deep into server stats, including server name, processor details, process status, and live charts for load, CPU usage, disk space, and network rates. Gain insights into performance trends over time.
* Load Monitoring: Visualize real-time performance with live charts that track CPU overall usage and detailed core statistics, along with memory consumption metrics.
* I/O Performance: Monitor I/O transactions per second (TPS) and read/write speeds with intuitive charts, helping you assess the efficiency of your server's storage.
* Network Insights: Keep an eye on network performance with TX/RX rate charts and TCP connection statuses to ensure smooth operations.
* Process Management: Access a list of running processes along with their CPU and memory usage to identify resource-hogging applications.
* Ping Status: Instantly check server responsiveness with ping times displayed in milliseconds (ms) and Time to Live (TTL).
* SSH File Editor: Edit files directly on the server using terminal-based editors. The app features a mobile-optimized keyboard designed for seamless coding and command input.
* Command Snippets: Save frequently used commands as snippets for quick access and execution across multiple servers.
* SFTP File Explorer: Navigate and manage your server files effortlessly. Download, upload, and edit files with a user-friendly file manager interface.
How It Works:
SSH Terminal+ loads performance data from standard /proc file

Use high-quality images and videos, write compelling captions, and make sure your content is consistent with your brand identity.
Another important strategy is to use relevant hashtags. Hashtags are a powerful tool for increasing your visibility and reaching new audiences. Use hashtags that are relevant to your content and target audience, and make sure to include both popular and niche hashtags.
Engaging with your followers is also crucial for building a loyal following. Respond to comments, ask questions, and start conversations with your audience. Show them that you care about their opinions and value their feedback.

Don't let a small following hold you back. Start focusing on growing your follower count today and see the results for yourself. With more followers, you can take your brand to new heights and achieve your goals faster than ever before.

Hashtags are also an important tool for getting your content in front of more people. Use relevant hashtags that are specific to your niche, and include them in your captions or comments. This will help people who are interested in your content find you more easily and potentially follow your account.
Another important strategy for gaining followers is to engage with your existing followers and potential followers. Respond to comments and direct messages, and interact with people who are using the same hashtags as you. This will help you build a sense of community around your content and encourage people to engage with you more frequently.
Of course, it's important to be cautious when using any type of third-party service. Make sure you research the company thoroughly and read reviews from other users before making a purchase. Look for services that offer transparent pricing and clear terms of service, and avoid any that seem too good to be true.
In conclusion, getting more followers on social media requires a combination of high-quality content, relevant hashtags, and engaging with your audience. But with the help of social media growth services, you can take your follower count to the next level and achieve your goals faster than ever before. Don't let a small following hold you back - start building your social media presence today and see the results for yourself.

bluejetty:00184503:ios.name: Wild West: Farm Town Building
bluejetty:00184503:ios.summary: Howdy, farmers! It's a perfect day for an amazing adventure simulation in the world of farming simulator games. Take your empty patch of farmland and build a prosperous, thriving farm that everyone will want to visit! Earn ranching experien
bluejetty:00184503:ios.description:
Howdy, farmers! It's a perfect day for an amazing adventure simulation in the world of farming simulator games. Take your empty patch of farmland and build a prosperous, thriving farm that everyone will want to visit! Earn ranching experience and expand your frontiers to collect even more resources, create a variety of western-style products, and raise cute animals for a wonderful simulation of peaceful village life! It's time for your hay day in the fields of the wild wild west!
Experience the quiet charm of rural village life - a beautiful location with a view of a flowing river awaits you. Design the ranch of your dreams, with plenty of buildings and decorations. Raise cute farm animals and harvest diverse crops for an exciting ranching experience! Become a real cowboy in Wild West!
From a farm to a town!
Expand your borders: build a school, theater, hotel, saloon, hospital and city hall, and turn your farm into a town! Increase your population, trade with other towns, and build your dream city! Have you got what it takes to become a successful mayor?
Raise virtual animals
Start filling your farm zoo with cows and pigs and step by step, unlock a variety of other animals: goats, sheeps, geese and more! Don't forget about pets, of course: dogs and puppies, cats and kittens, and even different kinds of bunnies are waiting for you in your very own farm zoo!
Build farm workshops
So, now you have a lot of resources - it’s the perfect time to start the production process. Build farm workshops like the Dairy, Summer Kitchen, Grill, Mill, Stove, Coffee Bar and much more to create various types of useful goods and products. Repair your dock to unlock the island, where you can take part in the fishing mini-game to discover the treasures beneath the surface! Level up to get even more supplies and get rich!
Send goods by train
Build a railway platform to send trains to other players' farms - fill your trains with the goods you've created and earn a valuable reward, and experience, of course! Still have lots of goods left - complete the tasks on the order board to progress to the next level faster!
Join the neighborhood races
Wild West is a place where the bravest players can compete in the fast-paced farm games! Join the hay day of the Neighborhood Race and prove your farming family is the best in the west. Earn high scores and hightail it through the farm games to win the best prizes ever and reach the top of the leaderboard! Discover all that farming games have to offer in Wild West - start your new life as a farmer today. A delightful ranching simulation is waiting for you!
Enjoy village life simulator in your farming simulator!
Wild West: New Frontier is free to play, but some game items can also be purchased for real money - if you'd prefer, you can earn these items for free by simply playing the game: watching ads, winning contests, logging in every day and much more.
An internet connection is required to play Wild West: New Frontier - this allows you to download the latest updates, autosave your progress and communicate with your neighborhood family in this charming farming simulation.

bluejetty:00024099:ios.description:
Play puzzles and brain teasers in hide & seek mystery games! In this one of the top hidden objects games, your goal is to find hidden pictures needed to become a hero!
People lived in the northern kingdom of Wintersea with the Spirit of Fire. He warmed everything with his flame - and people took care of his fiery creatures in return. However, one day the Spirit of Fire and all his servants suddenly left people and went to the Heavenly Mountains. Since then, the kingdom was terrorized by the ancient Spirit of Cold and her ice monsters. You are a tamer of magical creatures. Together with your grandmother Dayona, you keep order in the snowy forest. Dayona is known as the best tamer, but now you are to take her place, go on the dangerous expedition, and stop the Spirit of Cold. Otherwise, the kingdom is going to become a snowy grave... bluejetty:00026663:ios.description:
Plan your day visually. Stay focused. Get things done.
400,000+ five-star ratings · Trusted by 1.5 million active users
The daily planner built for how your brain actually works. Map your tasks and calendar onto a visual timeline, block your time with intention, and finally build a routine that sticks — whether you have ADHD or just a lot on your plate.
WHY STRUCTURED WORKS
Most planners give you a blank page. Structured gives you a timeline. You see your whole day laid out, with every task, event, and routine in order. It's time blocking made simple.
Built for ADHD minds, busy professionals, and students who need more than a to-do list.
FREE FEATURES
- Visual day planner with an intuitive drag-and-drop timeline
- Inbox to capture ideas fast and sort them later
- Syncs across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac
- Break big projects into sub-tasks with notes
- Pomodoro focus timer, Live Activities, and interactive widgets
- Color-coding and hundreds of icons to personalize your schedule
- Accessibility built in: VoiceOver, Voice Control, dyslexia-friendly font, and multiple languages
STRUCTURED PRO
- Connect your calendars and Reminders for a complete daily schedule organizer
- Build recurring tasks and routines
- AI-powered day planning: draft your schedule in seconds
- Replan: automatically reschedules missed or forgotten tasks
- Custom notifications to match your workflow
PERFECT FOR
- ADHD-friendly daily planning that actually sticks
- Time blocking your work and study sessions
- Morning routine and evening routine planning
- Students managing class timetables and study tasks
- Anyone who wants a simple to-do list app with a timeline view
- Habit tracking alongside your daily task planner
YOUR DAY, YOUR WAY
Structured isn't just a task manager or a habit tracker. It's the daily planner that puts everything in one place — so you can plan your day, build better habits, and get things done without the overwhelm.
Structured Pro is available monthly, annually, or as a lifetime purchase.
Terms & Privacy: https://structured.app/legal

bluejetty:00160724:ios.summary: Dive into the enchanting world of "Royal Romances: The Power of Chosen One" where epic romance stories and adventurous quests await. This captivating love story game is not just about finding hidden objects, it's an immersive experience fil
bluejetty:00160724:ios.description:
Dive into the enchanting world of "Royal Romances: The Power of Chosen One" where epic romance stories and adventurous quests await. This captivating love story game is not just about finding hidden objects, it's an immersive experience filled with puzzles, brain teasers, and thrilling storylines!
With a compelling narrative that intertwines love and destiny, this game offers an escape into a fantastical universe where your choices shape the future of kingdoms. The fate of the world rests in your hands – navigate through adventure-packed quests to thwart the evil plans of a powerful witch and a tyrannical king.
The situation may seem grim, but there is hope on the horizon. There is a prophecy of a Chosen One that will be able to command the dragons once they return. That’s why Ida is kidnapping people: she wants to know who the mystery hero is. She took Glissando, but failed while trying to kidnap Princess Amelia… who might just be the real Chosen One. But beware: the witch won’t give up so easily. There is also the matter of King Illeon preparing a final assault on the forest, and he has a story of his own, too. See all there is to uncover in this magical world and be the force to tip the scale of fate!
Compelling Key Features:
- Engaging Romance Stories: Experience heart-fluttering romantic games within an immersive fantasy setting. Your decisions influence the love stories unfolding in a realm of magic and mystery!
- Find Hidden Objects: Sharpen your observation skills with beautifully crafted hidden object scenes. Each discovery brings you closer to unraveling the secrets of the prophecy and identifying the Chosen One destined to command the dragons!
- Puzzles and Brain Teasers: Engage in a variety of challenging puzzles and brain teasers that will test your wit and reward you with achievements. Perfect for fans of casual games seeking a blend of excitement and intellect!
- Casual Games for Everyone: Whether you're a seasoned player of love story games or new to the genre, "Royal Romances" offers an accessible yet deep gameplay experience that appeals to all!
- Collectibles and Bonus Materials: Keep an eye out for collectibles scattered throughout the game. Enjoy fantasy-themed bonus materials that enrich the narrative and offer deeper insights into this magical world!
- Influence Kingdoms: Your choices matter. Make hard decisions that affect the lives of characters and the fate of entire kingdoms. Be the hero the world needs in these trying times!
Are you ready to find love, fight darkness, and discover your true destiny? Play now and become the hero of your own romantic adventure!
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

Zoo doctor dentist - we all love when people around us smile. We become well and happy when someone on the street gives us a smile. But for a smile to be beautiful, you need to take good care of your teeth. Like people, they also sometimes need to treat their teeth. This can be done by a special doctor - dentist. 
We present to your attention an exciting game - a zoo dentist (vet clinic).

bluejetty:00023674:ios.description:
This application consists of three modules: RECORDER, SMART ALARM, STOP SNORING.
RECORDER
Records your talk or snoring while you are asleep (automatic or manual sensitivity level, records only snoring using smart snoring detection), creates the graph of noise in room during the night, takes the total time of snoring down.
SMART ALARM
Helps you wake up easy in your lightest sleep phase and allows you to get up relaxed every morning. Improve your sleep naturally, maximize your sleep efficiency. 
STOP SNORING
Tries to stop your snoring by playing chosen sound or using iPhone vibration when the snoring is detected.
By using the tracker data and by defining your own factors (activities/means/drugs/custom notes) it is possible to find out which facts influence your sleep positively and limit your snoring. At your disposal there are beautiful statistic charts for simple and efficient analyzing of your sleeps/nights.
Snoring detection is based on artificial intelligence (A.I.) with the support of a new Apple machine learning technology. By using a large number of snoring samples, we can achieve high accuracy in statistics and in snoring detection itself.
How to place your device correctly is shown in instructions. 
HIGHLIGHTS:
- ADJUSTABLE RECORDING SOUND SENSITIVITY:
For different sound conditions in your room (a quiet or loud environment).
- HIGH TECH SNORING DETECTION:
Accurate snoring detection based on A.I.
- POSSIBILITY OF RECORDING ONLY SNORING
- AUDIO VISUALIZATION DURING RECORDING OR PLAYING
- FAVORITE RECORDINGS
- SHARING RECORDINGS WITH YOUR FRIENDS:
Send recordings via email, iMessage or post to Facebook
- UNLIMITED ALARMS: 
Set your own alarms, daily alarms, weekly alarms, etc. You can use included alarm sounds or your own iPod music.
- SMART WAKE UP: 
Wake you up with gradual alarm when you are in your lightest sleep phase (based on your movements).
- SLEEP TRACKER:
Sleep cycle analyzes and statistics with complete history and beautiful charts.
- SNOOZE BY SHAKING:
No need to unlock screen or enter password.
- STOP SNORING:
Possibility of playing chosen sound or using iPhone vibration when the snoring is detected. 
- FACTORS, WAKE UP MOOD, NOTES:
User can place factors (alcohol, coffee, stress etc.) to every night as well as the mood after waking up or users own notes.
- ACTIVATION DELAY:
Start monitoring after a period of time.
- BACKGROUND MODE:
Monitoring runs also in background mode. Alarm also fires from background.
- APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
- iCLOUD SYNCHRONIZATION:
Synchronization among your devices and between free and paid version.
- EXPORTING HISTORY TO CSV FILE
- APPLE WATCH:
Tracks your sleep movements and plays haptic (sound, vibration) if alarm is triggered or snoring is detected.
PLEASE NOTE THE FOLLOWING:
* It is recommended to connect your iPhone (iPad) to a charger.
* Set "Airplane Mode" or "Do Not Disturb" on your iPhone (iPad) for undisturbed sleep.
* Place your iPhone (iPad) according to the instructions (see screenshots).
CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Happy customers are our highest priority. If you have a problem with our app, please contact us at stopsnoring4@apirox.com.

bluejetty:00133684:ios.description:
Welcome to one of the best yatzy - a free dice-roller classic game where you’ll shake, score and shout! Have great fun and some luck with Yatzy lucky dice!
How to play?
Yatzy is a 13 round game where you take turns rolling five dice.
After each roll player chooses which dice to keep and which to reroll.
A player may re-roll some or all the dice up to two times on a turn.
You must put a score or zero into a combination each turn.
Once all the combinations have been exhausted the player with the highest score wins the game.
Some combinations offer the player a choice as to which category to score them. A full house could be scored in the Full House, the Three-Of-A-Kind, Two Pairs, One Pair or the chance combination.
YATZY is a board game with its original rules. Five dice with six sides and 15 sections to be filled in 15 rounds. It is a Scandinavian public domain dice game very similar to Poker Dice, Yacht, Generala and Cheerio. Yatzy is also known as Yachty and Farkle in different countries. it is very simple, fast to learn and fun to play !
This fun Yatzy Classic dice game has 2 modes:
- Solo game : train yourself and improve your best score
- Play Offline: challenge an AI opponent offline in 2 modes Standard yatzy and American yatzy !

bluejetty:00156447:ios.description:

Never forget a winning hand again. Fastroll Poker lets you capture detailed hand histories at the table, build a searchable database, and analyze every decision you make. Now with AI-powered shorthand parsing - type the way you think, and Fastroll turns it into a complete database entry instantly.
Whether you're studying with a coach, posting to Crush Live Call-Ins, or finding leaks on your own, Fastroll gives you the tools serious players need to improve.
Key Features:
Modern UI (NEW): Improved appearance, animations to make the hand logging experience smoother
Guided Logging Flow (NEW): Step-by-step logging flow to help new users become accustomed to the process
Stats (NEW): Track the performance of your logged hands
AI-Powered Text Hand History Conversion
- Type hands the way you'd jot them in your notes — "UTG 20, H BTN 60 AKs, flop A72r, cbet half pot, call..." - and Fastroll's AI translates your shorthand into a full structured hand history. The fastest way to log a hand on the planet.

bluejetty:00135123:ios.description:
Features:
- designed for people who are interested in strategy board games (checkers or draughts).
- a fun brain exercise to keep you mentally sharp.
- can be played by 2 - 6 players.
- both the normal mode and the Super Chinese Checkers mode (the fast-paced mode usually takes much less time to finish) are available.
- can be played both online and offline.
- play online by matching with a random player or creating a match with a friend.
- play offline and develop your skills with a bot(s) (weak/medium/strong bot).
- play locally with another player on the same device.
- interactive tutorial to help you learn the rules in only a few minutes.
- absolutely no ads.
- choose your preferred background music.
- choose your preferred interface theme and game board theme.
- choose to display all possible destinations of one ball (this will make the game much easier for you to win).
- create your own profile: type your name and choose an avatar.
- easy to understand user interface.
--------
The game
Chinese checkers (also known as Sternhalma or Chinese chequers) is a popular board game originating from Germany. It is played on a star-shaped board by 2 to 6 players. Each player tries to move all of their pieces from their starting corner to the opposite one.
To learn more about the rules of the game, click “Read rules” on the main screen.
--------
Game modes
The app allows you to play the game both online and offline.
There are two ways of playing online: 1. be matched to a random opponent, 2. create a private game and play with your friends or join such a game by typing in the code.
Offline games offer capabilities to play against the computer, or against another player locally on the same device. You can configure the game to have any number of players (e.g. you against a bot, or you against 5 bots).
--------
Bots
Currently 3 different bots are available: “weak bot”, “medium bot” and “strong bot".
As the name suggests, weak bot simulates a weak player that frequently makes non-optimal moves. Choose this option if you just started learning the game.
Regular bot is much smarter, though experienced players should be able to beat it.
It takes even more effects to beat a strong bot. 
--------
Profile
Click on the person icon on the bottom-right corner of the main screen to configure your profile which is displayed to other players during online games. You can type in your name and choose an avatar. 
--------
Settings
Click on the gear icon on the main page to open the Settings screen. It allows you to configure the game to match your preferences. In Settings, you can:
- adjust interface sounds volume (button clicks, moves, game end & other sounds);
- adjust background music volume;
- choose background music track;
- choose interface theme and game board theme;
- switch on/off Super Chinese Checkers mode;
- switch on/off “cheating” mode: show all possible destinations;
- and many more.
--------
How to play
Click the “Read rules” button on the main screen to watch an interactive tutorial.
--------
Privacy Policy: https://www.dong.digital/chinesecheckers/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.dong.digital/chinesecheckers/tos/
Have fun!

bluejetty:00095083:ios.description:
Welcome to the most chaotic job: running the Lost & Found counter! Sort through dozens of ridiculous lost items to match customers with their missing things. all this while the boss is watching you. From earbuds, burritos, passports and a suspiciously emotional teddy bear, every request is a test of speed, memory and sharp eyes.
What to expect?
- Fast-paced item matching (the faster an item is returned, the more reputation awarded)
- Hilarious characters and absurd requests
- Fast-growing challenge as more lost items pile up
- Increasingly impatient customers
- Survival mode type of gameplay: 3 hearts available 
- ZEN mode for a relaxing, pressure-free experience
- A paid game: no ads, no tracking, no distractions, no data collected 
- Haptic Feedback | Game Center | Leaderboards & Achievements
I made Is This Yours? as a solo developer: from the artwork to the animations to the code. It’s a little absurd, a little chaotic, and built with a lot of love. I hope it brings you a few smiles and some satisfying moments along the way. Enjoy running the world’s weirdest lost & found counter. Hurry! Customers are losing their minds and their stuff.

bluejetty:00015569:ios.description:
MODERN DRUMMER MAGAZINE (October 2015 issue):
“This is a must-have for anyone wanting an encyclopedia of world percussion rhythms at their fingertips.”
PercussionTutor is an educational app for dedicated world percussion enthusiasts. The app and its free companion book feature a unique library of world rhythms and instruments played by leading percussionists and drummers. A time stretching feature and a metronome give the users the option to practice at their own pace.
NO IN-APP PURCHASES! Make sure to buy the app now and get all the future content for free. We will release updates on a regular basis adding new rhythms and videos.
Damian Erskine (bassist, educator, writer for NoTreble.com):
“PercussionTutor is truly fantastic and a blast to play along with”. (full review on NoTreble.com)
Lincoln Goines (electric and acoustic bassist) writes: “This app is an engaging and informative way to check out the original funk. A great tool for musicians, dancers, and all lovers of rhythm”.
Percussive Arts Society: “The interactive application is very thorough [...]. Navigation is simple and the layout is logical and easy to grasp.” 
PercussionTutor will allow you to approach South American, Caribbean and West African music in a different way. This app offers you more than a simple play-along. It includes standard notation, videos and specific claves. We also took the outmost care to capture the natural feeling of all those drumming traditions. 
For the batá rhythms we even developed a random playback engine that will simulate an actual batá performance.
This app puts you in a live playing situation - just like you learned your mother language. You will sound more natural and more alive and you will awaken to new rhythmic possibilities. It's also a great tool for other musicians, dancers and performers who want to immerse themselves into centuries-old traditional languages.
FEATURES:
- Over 80 rhythms (some rhythms include a basic and a more advanced version)
- Rhythms from Cuba, Brazil, Puerto Rico, Peru, West Africa, ... 
- ALL drums can be turned on and off individually
- audio time-stretching feature
- 59 videos
- over 50 percussion instruments
- Sheets of all the rhythms included in the app and in the free book
- A description of all the rhythms
- MORE RHYTMS COMING: we are working on a lot more content to be released on a regular basis!

bluejetty:00026624:ios.description:
Glow Nurture is the most comprehensive pregnancy app on the market. With Glow Nurture, you can track your pregnancy, learn about baby development, and connect with other moms.
FEATURES
 - Pregnancy tracking: Glow Nurture tracks your pregnancy from week to week, so you can see how your baby is growing and developing. You can also track your symptoms, moods, and weight gain.
 - Baby development: Glow Nurture provides you with detailed information about baby development, from conception to birth. You can learn about baby's physical and emotional development, as well as milestones to expect.
 - Community: Glow Nurture has a large and supportive community of moms. You can connect with other moms who are pregnant or who have recently given birth. You can also share your experiences, ask questions, and get advice.
 - Expert advice: Glow Nurture is backed by a team of experts in pregnancy and parenting. You can access articles, videos, and podcasts on a variety of topics, including nutrition, labor and delivery, and breastfeeding.
 - Contraction timer: Glow Nurture's contraction timer can help you track the frequency and intensity of your contractions, so you can know when it's time to head to the hospital.
 - Baby registry: Glow Nurture's baby registry makes it easy to create a list of the things you need for your baby. You can share your registry with friends and family, so they can easily purchase the items you need.
 - AI-powered insights: Glow Nurture uses AI to provide you with personalized insights and advice throughout your pregnancy. This information can help you understand your pregnancy, make informed decisions, and feel more confident as a mom.
 - Apple Health Integration: Sync data between Glow and Apple Health app.
BENEFITS
 - Peace of mind: Glow Nurture can help you feel more confident and prepared for your pregnancy. With Glow Nurture, you can track your pregnancy, learn about baby development, and connect with other moms.
 - Knowledge: Glow Nurture provides you with comprehensive information about pregnancy and parenting. You can learn about everything from conception to birth, and from nutrition to breastfeeding.
 - Support: Glow Nurture has a large and supportive community of moms. You can connect with other moms who are pregnant or who have recently given birth. You can also share your experiences, ask questions, and get advice.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Glow is free to download and use. Upgrading to Glow Premium will unlock:
Comparative Insights: "Is this normal?" Compare with millions of women
Premium Articles - Next level fertility facts
Private messaging: Find friends. Glow together.
Custom profile: Stand out from the rest.
Premium support: Jump the queue!
$29.99 for 3 months, first 3 months trial at $23.99
$59.99 for 1 year after 7 day free trial ($4.99/month)
$79.99 for lifetime

 - Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, Glow yearly subscription is $59.99, 3-month subscription is $29.99.

Mix your favorite music and add effects easily with a real DJ player with two DJ cross-discs!
Simple but Powerful DJ Music Mixer Tool!
DJ Music Mixer Studio is a complete home DJ mixer to create creative music with your device! DJ Music Mixer - Dj Remix Pro packs a complete DJ kit into your mobile phone. And that's without sacrificing a single music mixer feature. Imagine it! Your fingertips can make songs and remix tracks just like a PRO, except you need a little smartphone instead of a vast kit!
With this personalized DJ mixer experience, your tracks will sound as good as the best tracks from veteran DJs. So slide your finger to download and take advantage of these excellent DJ mix features!
DJ Music Mixer Fantastic Features!
DJ mixer tips. 
It can be tough starting something new. But luckily, we're here to help. DJ Mixer app helps you from master looping to learning hot new cues and the ins and outs of mashups! Be a PRO Music DJ and song editor! We're here to help you learn all you need to know about remixing songs and making fresh tracks.
Glossary.

+ Metronome Function BPM upgradeable.

+ Adjustable volume and pitch
+ Automatic BPM detection for all your songs
+ Access to all the music stored on your device from the playlist on the selector
+ Looping & Cue Points
+ Automatic beat & tempo detection
+ Optimized turntables, you are only 1 click away from the essential
+ Simple equalizer to control turntable effects.
+ High-quality circles - DJ mixer Player app
+ Record your mixes with the built-in recorder
Discover different built-in melodies and sound effects available to mix with your main DJ music.

This excellent music DJ mixer makes it easy for creative people and music lovers like you! Explore music tracks with different loops and a place where you can edit sound like a PRO. Manipulate the music by adding sound fx (DJ sounds effects), using music equalizers, and more!

bluejetty:00147561:ios.description:
Dive into Loot & Legends, where a darkness has risen from underground and taken control of the crystals that power the world. Courageous heroes have been called to fight against this darkness and take back the crystals that give power to the world. 
In Loot & Legends, you play as a hero fighting back against the darkness. Enter dungeons of the world to reclaim the power of the world's crystals and discover some epic loot along the way. 
Loot & Legends is a roguelite action rpg with massively-multiplayer online (MMO) and engaging progression elements. Battle your way through dungeons while increasing your character's strength along the way. Level up, improve your own unique skill tree, craft and collect mighty gear, befriend pets to help you in battle, and so much more. 
Explore The Dungeons
• Endless hours of unique dungeons to conquer. Each dungeon attempt offers a unique, procedurally generated experience with randomly generated monsters, loot and secrets that evolve as you progress.
• Discover epic bosses with powerful skills and abilities. Take them down for the chance of finding epic loot.
• Thematic and challenging changes await as you progress deeper into the dungeons of Loot & Legends. From the dungeons of lava, to the wastelands, and more.
• High stakes roguelite - dying in a dungeon means you'll lose some of your gold, skill points, and unequipped gear and loot!
Master Combat Systems
• Master Loot & Legends' real time combat system with strategic dodging, skill timings, positioning, and more.
• Choose your equipment, skill and pet companions carefully.
• Conserve potions and use consumable items in the heat of battle to turn the outcome in your favor.
• Use the auto-battler & idle systems while on the go to aid in clearing dungeons.
Deep Character Progression Awaits
• Level up your character, select and power up unique skills along the way.
• Discover epic loot, enhance and upgrade it to make it more powerful and unlock unique weapon abilities.
• Collect runes and enchantment stones to progress your characters passive abilities.
• Unlock achievements that give permanent stat buffs for completing challenging quests.

• Participate in PvP challenges & the global leaderboard.
• Fight other players in the arena to earn rewards and rank up.

bluejetty:00014202:ios.description:
NOVIDADE: o FolhaCerta se uniu a plataforma de gestão Flash e agora se chama Folha Flash!
Simplifique as rotinas trabalhistas com o aplicativo de controle de jornada da Flash. que oferece soluções para o RH, gestores e colaboradores realizarem uma gestão completa da jornada de trabalho incluindo ponto, férias, escalas e muito mais.
Confira as principais vantagens:
RH: muito menos trabalho para organizar os processos do dia-a-dia e assim poder focar nas atividades estratégicas que ajudam o negócio.
Gestores: aprovam solicitações, notificações de status de férias, horas extras, atrasos, banco de horas e sabe onde está sua equipe de trabalho na hora.
Colaboradores: acesso à agenda do dia, marcam o ponto, programam férias, avisam que vai chegar mais tarde, solicitam uma folga, e muito mais.
Empresa: ganha produtividade e eficiência, consegue avaliar melhor seus recursos, traz flexibilidade para gestão de pessoas e atrai talentos.
Contador: recebem todos os meses informações para cálculo da Folha de Pagamento, emissão de Férias e muito mais de forma organizada e automatizada.
O ponto eletrônico é regularizado e dentro da lei conforme a LGPD e a portaria 671 e 1486 do Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego.
Unimos tecnologia e inteligência para facilitar a gestão da jornada de trabalho, garantindo mais segurança e praticidade para o seu RH:
Reconhecimento facial: registro de ponto por meio do reconhecimento facial ideal para evitar fraudes, verificar a identidade e coletar evidências, além de garantir mais segurança no registro de ponto.
Cercas de localização: o registro de ponto dos colaboradores pode ser feito com diferentes cercas de localização: Wi-Fi, GPS e Bluetooth (Beacons).
Confira as principais funcionalidades:
Gestão completa do espelho de ponto
Facilidade para acompanhar pedidos e justificativas de ausências
Gestão das escalas de trabalho
