bluejetty:00131601:ios.description:
Option Signal is an advanced app for stock and option investors. Find out about big movements as they happen and have the tools to cat on them. Option signal help you stay on top of the market and get insights wherever you are. Swim with option alerts with tons of features, and more coming all the time.
--Real Time Alert
Options market moves very fast, with our push notification function, you will detect and fill with strange activity and big flows that force direction. Get alerted about the movements that you can act on, not the noise. 
--Screener & Scanner
Explore option chains and data on all option trading flow chains and history to uncover new trading strategies. Detect unusual option alerts by using advanced filters and criteria to find out the unusual call and put option activities on stock market now. You can view a quick breakdown of some common options factors such as open interest, expire date, volume, implied volatility and so on. 
-Watchlist
Build unlimited personal watchlist, stock tracker and other instruments as many as you want, rename these watchlists to test your portfolio and invest strategies. Change the time frame of the mini chart on the watchlists to help you stock analysis on stock trends by using multi time frame approach.
—Premium Stock Signal
Locate stocks, penny stock with good reward risk set ups and double check with ticker volumes, technical analysis and fundamental analysis. Signals include swing signal, long term signal, day trade signal and penny stocks signal. Free version will have limited number of stock signal. Paid subscription is required to access all open stock, long term signals and get real time insight push. 
--Premium Option Signal
Get all the option movements and unusual flows that are occurring on options you like. Access stop loss, options profit calculator and buy & sell targets of low price high potential options, and set up relative options signals to leverage your investment. Free version will have limited number of option signal. Paid subscription is required to access all open option signal and get real time insight push. 
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at the confirmation of purchase. Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected subscriptions above. Subscriptions can be changed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of the term will be forfeited once purchased.
Privacy Policy: https://www.kyotocoltd.com/option_privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://www.kyotocoltd.com/option_terms.html

bluejetty:00165575:ios.description:
It’s Halloween Eve, and you’re hurrying to your uncle’s fair to play investigation games! But the family reunion with distant relatives the Sullivans ends in a disaster when you realize that an evil vampire named Walter started a hunt on them all, including you! The Lord of the Monsters, he wants to release his loyal servants from the basement of the Sullivan mansion. Can you disenchant your aunt, save your nephew and find the missing nieces to make sure they’re safe? Unite with you Uncle Pierre - an illusionist and secret magician – who will reveal the unknown mysteries and chilling details about your family and hidden objects! 
· STOP YOUR VAMPIRE EX-BOYFRIEND FROM RUINING YOUR LIFE IN THE BONUS CHAPTER! 
Your adventure doesn’t stop at the end of the main story! Play the bonus chapter and enjoy another round of thrilling hidden objects⋅ puzzles.
· ENJOY THE SPOOKY HALLOWEEN ATMOSPHERE!
These are special mystery adventure games for the Halloween season. Complete tons of intriguing mini-games hidden around the Sullivan mansion and plunge into the spooky atmosphere!
· TONS OF COLLECTIBLES AND MORPHING OBJECTS TO LOOK FOR! 
Replay your favorite hidden object adventure games in search of hidden objects and collectibles that we’ve cleverly hidden in this games’ colorful locations!
· COOL ACHIEVEMENTS, WALLPAPERS, CONCEPT ARTS, AND MORE!
Solve investigation games to earn achievements and get access to unique wallpapers, concept art, music, and more!
· NEVER GET LOST WITH A HELPFUL STRATEGY GUIDE!
If you ever get stuck while trying to find hidden items, use the strategy guide for help and useful tips!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00184873:ios.summary:
The official remote app for your Roku® device.
Roku Remote (Official) turns your phone into a feature-packed remote control for Roku players and Roku TVs. Enjoy convenient, easy control of your Roku devices, quickly launch your favorite app
bluejetty:00184873:ios.description:
The official remote app for your Roku® device.
Roku Remote (Official) turns your phone into a feature-packed remote control for Roku players and Roku TVs. Enjoy convenient, easy control of your Roku devices, quickly launch your favorite apps and channels, search with your voice, type with your phone’s keyboard, and listen privately with headphones — all from the device already in your pocket.
The free Roku Remote app features:
* Remote control — a full-featured Roku remote on your phone, with the same buttons as the one you lost in the couch
* Keyboard — type search terms, passwords, and Wi-Fi info with your mobile keyboard instead of the on-screen grid
* Voice search — say what you want and get to it faster
* Private listening — plug headphones into your phone so you can stream without waking the house
* Cast photos and video — share what's on your phone to the big screen
* Control your apps — easily add new apps to your Roku device, or quickly launch your favorites
* Free TV - stream a huge selection of free movies, live TV, and more right from your phone.
Works with Roku TV™ models and Roku streaming players.
To use certain features, connect your phone or tablet to the same wireless network as your Roku device. Some features require a compatible Roku device and may require signing into your Roku account.
Feature availability:
• Voice search is available in English in the US, UK, and Canada, and in Spanish in Mexico and the US.
• The Roku Channel can be viewed in the mobile app in the US and Mexico only. 
• Some channels require payment, can change, and vary by country.
For more information, go to http://support.roku.com
Privacy Policy: go.roku.com/privacypolicy
CA Privacy Notice: https://docs.roku.com/published/userprivacypolicy/en/us#userprivacypolicy-en_us-CCPA

bluejetty:00146709:ios.description:
Stick Battle Simulation is an action-packed stickman strategy game where you command an army of stick fighters in epic physics-based battles. Lead your red and blue stickman warriors through intense skirmishes, build your ultimate battle squad, and watch as the action unfolds in realistic battle simulations.
With a variety of stickman units, each with unique abilities and combat styles, every battle becomes a test of strategy and skill. Experiment with different unit combinations, create your own battle tactics, and dominate the battlefield!
Game Features:
- Diverse Stickman Fighters – Choose from a wide range of stick warriors, each with special skills and dynamic animations.
- Offline & Online Play – Enjoy battles anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection.
- Realistic Physics Engine – Experience smooth, physics-based combat where every move and action feels natural and unpredictable.
- Sandbox Mode – Customize battles, test different strategies, and create your own unique combat scenarios.
- PvP Multiplayer (Coming Soon) – Challenge other players in real-time battles and prove your tactical superiority.
Prepare for an intense stickman battle experience like never before! Build your army, master strategy, and conquer every fight.
Download now and start your stickman war!

bluejetty:00166030:ios.description:

經濟頻道每日捕捉香港股市以至環球財經新聞，多位專家分析市場走勢，讓您搶盡先機，包括地產樓市資訊及個人理財攻略。

【 多元化生活頻道 】
旅遊：為您搜羅機票酒店旅遊攻略、自助餐著數優惠、本地及內地好去處、介紹香港絕美秘境。
飲食：影片簡易示範多種家常菜式、湯水、甜品，附加詳盡食譜，還有本地美食及餐廳推介。
親子：入學面試攻略，提供工作紙等教材下載，搜集假日親子活動資訊，同時照顧兒童心理發展。
健康：拆解健康謬誤，簡介常見病、都市病等資訊。
hashTECH 科技玩物：最新科技產品開箱實測，第一手報道最新電子產品發佈，手機、電腦等周邊產品介紹，App 程式實用教學，更會分享多個手遊或其他熱門遊戲攻略。
此外，亦涵蓋寵物、音樂、女生穿搭、職場、哲學、文化等豐富內容。
【 其他生活服務 】
《香港01》提供自訂個人化內容，主頁可按您挑選的閱讀喜好推薦內容，讓您一 App 輕鬆掌握各類型活動、天氣和交通等資訊：
會員專區：註冊成為01會員，尊享驚喜優惠及獨家活動。並可從多項活動中賺取「01積分」，換取種類豐富的禮物及以分消費。
01升級版：隱藏廣告設定，更流暢閱讀體驗。
01空間：致力為香港人提供方便、快捷、優惠的多元化活動資訊及購票服務，包括網上講座、工作坊、展覽等等，塑造屬於您的個人活動空間，綻放生活無限。
01心意：香港首個結合線上線下的慈善配對平台，齊齊用心意成就好事。

bluejetty:00184092:ios.description:
Introducing FastPay App, with an elegant look, and exciting features, to make your life simpler and easier. Register a FastPay account right from the app in a few minutes, add money from your nearest agent or fast-link cash card, and get going. Recharge mobile balance, scan QR to pay at your favourite stores, send money to people, and get different lifestyle services, all in a highly secure mobile money app. Discover the best FastPay offers near you, get suggestions from FastPay on what services you can explore next, and use shortcuts for your most frequent transactions in FastPay App.
FAST ACCOUNT REGISTRATION
No FastPay account? No worry! You can now explore the FastPay App, its services, features, and offers a simple opening account. After you are done exploring, you can register a new FastPay account in a few minutes right from FastPay App, using your National ID, Passport etc.
SUPER FAST QR TRANSACTIONS
Use the Scan QR button in the home screen at stores and shops for Payment, at Agent points for Cash Out or with other FastPay users for Send Money – faster and error-free.
PROMOTIONS NEAR YOU
Get the best FastPay Promotions at your nearest payment points, all in one place under the promotions section in your home screen.
TRANSACTIONS & STATEMENT
Access notifications on your latest FastPay transactions and promotional offers.
RECHARGE
Recharge mobile balance, internet balance for all major operators very quickly 
HIGHLY SECURE MOBILE WALLET
We take the security of your FastPay account very seriously. We send you an OTP to verify your FastPay account during the first log-in. FastPay App also asks for your Password during log-in, and PIN during any transactions.
EASE OF ACCESS
Use the app in either Kurdish, Arabic or English, and change between the three whenever you want.

Watch live football matches on FIFA+ - Stream soccer matches, replays, highlights, scores, 
and exclusive content anytime, anywhere.
The FIFA+ app is your official home for live football, match replays and the game’s greatest 
stories. With a bold new design and powerful new features, FIFA+ brings you closer to the sport
you love – From FIFA World Cup™ moments to live matches across the globe. This autumn, 
you can stream the FIFA U-20 World Cup Chile 2025™, FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup 
Morocco 2025 and FIFA U-17 Men’s World Cup Quatar exclusively on Fifa+ in selected 
countries with many more competitions to come!
Live Football Streaming Worldwide
Stream thousands of live football matches from over 230 competitions and 100+ Football 
Associations. FIFA+ offers unrivalled coverage of men’s and women’s FIFA tournaments, youth 
competitions including the FIFA U-20 World Cup Chile 2025™ and FIFA World Cup™ Qualifiers
in selected countries.
 Watch live football and soccer matches from around the world
 Follow the road to FIFA World Cup 26™ with live qualifiers and match highlights
 The official home of Classic FIFA World Cup™ matches and original documentaries
 Get live match updates, scores and kick-off alerts instantly
Match Replays, Highlights & FIFA World Cup™ Archive

expert commentary. Re-watch iconic FIFA World Cup™ moments and explore the football 
archive to watch historic games and unforgettable goals! With in-depth highlights and detailed 
post-match analysis, you’ll never miss a thing.
Original Football Content & Stories
Go beyond the pitch with exclusive documentaries, player profiles and untold stories from 
around the world of football. Discover original series that dive into the stories of legendary 
players, rivalries and soccer teams from around the world.
Access premium content only available on FIFA+
 Match alerts & notifications: Never miss a goal or kick-off.
 Watch from the start: Rewind live tournament match streams so you can catch up on games at 
your convenience.
⚽ Watch next: Get automatic content suggestions tailored to your viewing.
⚽ Improved search & filters: Easily find teams, matches, tournaments and highlights.
⚽ Simple sign-in: Use your FIFA ID to unlock full access to the FIFA+ streaming app.
THE OFFICIAL FOOTBALL STREAMING APP BY FIFA
Stream live football, match replays and FIFA World Cup™ highlights right from your phone. 
FIFA+ is the only official FIFA app with exclusive access to tournaments and global 
competitions.
Download the FIFA+ app today and stream live football, match highlights, documentaries and 
FIFA World Cup™ content – All in one place. Experience the world’s game, your way.

bluejetty:00123402:ios.name: Crouton: Recipe Manager
bluejetty:00123402:ios.summary:
Crouton is simple feature packed recipe organizer & meal planner. The best place to store your favorite recipes from where ever you find them, websites, cookbooks or a handwritten note from your Grandma. 
IMPORT ANYWHERE
Crouton supports
bluejetty:00123402:ios.description:
Crouton is simple feature packed recipe organizer & meal planner. The best place to store your favorite recipes from where ever you find them, websites, cookbooks or a handwritten note from your Grandma. 
IMPORT ANYWHERE
Crouton supports importing recipes from almost everywhere! Pull recipes automatically out of websites and just save the bits you need. You can also scan recipes straight out of your recipe book using AI and OCR 
PLAN YOUR WEEK
With your favourite recipes on hand, Crouton makes it very easy to plan your meals for the week (or even long into the future). If you’re stuck for recipe ideas let Crouton automatically generate the meal plan from your organized dinner recipes.
STEP BY STEP MODE
Crouton offers a unique step by step mode. Focus on one recipe step at time as you cook, you can tap on ingredients within a step to get the quantity (saves you jumping back and forth between the steps and ingredients). With hands free mode you can move between steps without touching your device! Perfect for when you have messy hands.
TIMERS
Start timers with a tap. Crouton detects times within recipes and lets you start timers straight from the steps. A convenient heads up display keeps the times front of mind while you continue to use the app.
GROCERY LISTS
Create shopping lists directly from your recipes, easily copy just the ingredients you need to your list. Integrates with Reminders for convenient access. Your groceries have never been easier!
CLOUD SYNCING
All of your recipes are conveniently synced between all of your devices using iCloud. 
RECIPE FEEDS
Save your favourite recipe RSS feeds into Crouton to see new recipes as they’re published from your favourite blogs.
AI IMPORTING
Quickly import recipes using AI. Import a recipe from a single photo with no manual entry required. Also supports plain text and images. 
FAMILY SHARING
Share your recipes with friends and family using iCloud, so everyone knows what’s for dinner.
GUIDED WEIGHING
Pair to supported Bluetooth scales (such as the Acaia coffee scales) and have Crouton guide you through weighing your ingredients, avoid the mental juggling of recipe steps and amounts
COMBUSTION PROBE SUPPORT
Crouton pairs with Combustion's temperature prove to provide live updates on your cook
Crouton also offers a range of customization including custom icons and app colors.

bluejetty:00153343:ios.summary: Your empire faces relentless invasions from the savage Artronids, threatening its very existence. As Commander, you are the last line of defense against the deadly enemy onslaught. In this endlessly replayable experience, every battle prese
bluejetty:00153343:ios.description:
Your empire faces relentless invasions from the savage Artronids, threatening its very existence. As Commander, you are the last line of defense against the deadly enemy onslaught. In this endlessly replayable experience, every battle presents fresh challenges with unpredictable outcomes.
Build the ENEMY PATH
Take control of the battlefield by shaping the very ground your enemies march on. Expand and modify terrain tiles to create choke points, forcing enemies into lethal artillery fire or luring them into carefully laid traps. Height and pathing are your greatest weapons—use them wisely to dictate the flow of battle and secure victory.
Factions & HEROES
Each faction brings its own arsenal to the battlefield, featuring unique biomes, towers, and strategies. Their distinct playstyles shape how you build defenses, deploy units, and control the fight. With 10 unique heroes per faction, each possessing their own strengths and abilities, there are always new tactics to discover and strategies to master.
Adapting to WARFARE
War is unpredictable, but true Commanders adapt. After each wave, select from a set of upgrades and rewards to reinforce your strategy. Assess enemy strengths and weaknesses, adjusting your defenses to counter their advance. No two battles end the same way, as each new tile placement forces you to plan one step ahead.
Endless DISCOVERY
There's a wide variety of content to unlock as you progress through the game. Heroes are earned through achievements, building upgrades are discovered, and the Codex is packed with secrets to uncover. With four difficulty levels, an endless 'Frontier Mode', and every playthrough offering new challenges, Tower Dominion provides a highly replayable experience. 
Survival depends on constant innovation and adaptation. Every alien wave is a unique combination of Artronids that will test your ability to adapt. Are you ready to employ innovative tactics, build impregnable defenses and hold the line? Commander, your troops await your orders!
Play Tower Dominion GO for FREE and WITHOUT ADS! Play as much as you want, without any restriction. Then you can unlock the full content of the game with 1 single in-app purchase. No timers or virtual currency required!

bluejetty:00027045:ios.name: The Recipe Box To Go
bluejetty:00027045:ios.summary: Everything you love about The Recipe Box has been lovingly frosted with swirls of vanilla mirror glaze and dark chocolate ganache, making every pixel glisten. The joy of cooking with our app is infectious, bringing smiles and delight to hos
bluejetty:00027045:ios.description:
Everything you love about The Recipe Box has been lovingly frosted with swirls of vanilla mirror glaze and dark chocolate ganache, making every pixel glisten. The joy of cooking with our app is infectious, bringing smiles and delight to host and guest alike. We curated every mint sprig and dollop of raspberry purée to add elegant simplicity to the virtual plate. We hope you enjoy the scrumptious the new look, and of course we are tickled about our cheerful kitchen timer. It slices; it dices.
Ok, enough hyperbole (we're really excited!!). Our new timer feature will start a countdown with a tap on the recipe step. Control it from within the app, or from your iPhone's home screen. Switch between recipe timers with ease. We've been setting off timers just to listen to the chime.
Import recipes from the web (it's addictive!) - with expanded external browser support. Look for that signature ripe raspberry icon in any other web browser to import instantly.
You'll love sharing your recipes with friends and family, keeping those flavors of home circulating generation after generation.
Developed by foodies who love their Apple devices, this 21st-century cooking tool helps you get your recipes into a quickly-sorted, easily shared format that can’t be misplaced, covered in stains, or catch on fire. • AI Mode – Practice anytime offline against smart bots
• Online Multiplayer – Challenge players from around the world
• Pass & Play – Play with friends and family on one device
Ludo Quests – A Solo Adventure Mode
Step into a story mode filled with unique challenges:
• Rescue the princess and save the day
• Collect and build – gather wood, clear obstacles and manage resources as you advance

• Outsmart tricky AI guardians
• Complete special board objectives
• Enjoy the full mode offline with no internet required
Each mission adds a creative twist to the rules of Ludo and Parchis, offering a puzzle-like experience across handcrafted levels.
Customization and Personality
Make the game your own:
• Fun, animated game pieces
• Create a custom avatar
• Choose from a variety of board themes, from wood to fantasy
Why Ludo World Stands Out
This isn’t just a free board game. It’s a rich, family-friendly app packed with features to play anywhere, anytime – solo or with others.
Perfect for:
• Anyone wanting a quick Ludo game
• Competitive players climbing leaderboards
• Families playing together offline
• Fans of dice games, strategy games, and adventure challenges
Download Ludo World: A Parchis Game and start rolling. Classic gameplay meets a whole new adventure.

bluejetty:00182503:ios.description:
BUILD AND DEVELOP YOUR VERY OWN CITY
Global City is a city-building simulator that distinguishes itself from its peers with its high-quality graphics. Skyscrapers and residential houses, shopping malls and administration buildings, the port and the railway are bound to pleasantly surprise you with their unique and magnificent hi-tech designs.
DEVELOP AND CONTROL RESOURCE PRODUCTION
In this game, you can mine for various types of fossil fuels as well as produce higher-level materials and resources. Build a processing plant and a state-of-the-art factory. Sell ready-made commodities at the exchange and send off ships loaded with resources. Get blueprints, which you can use to upgrade buildings! Put all your skills and knowledge into building a bustling megapolis!
COMPLETE QUESTS TO MAKE YOUR CITY FLOURISH
Meet your city’s enthusiastic residents, who will always have all kinds of business propositions for you. Complete quests, earn items and resources by fulfilling orders, manufacture cars, and get rewards! All international business empires start small!
CHAT WITH FRIENDS
City development is essentially a joint venture. Luckily for you, in this game, you can create friendly communities, chat in English, trade resources, and provide support to each other. Your team spirit will strengthen your bonds when competing for the top places in tournaments, as well as amazing prizes!
COLLECT TAXES AND INCREASE THE POPULATION
Your city has to grow! Your ingenious managerial solutions and tax-savvy strategies will enable you to increase the population, expand the city limits, develop a business district, and eventually turn that small settlement of yours into a thriving megapolis.
Take the management and planning of Global City into your capable hands!
You can play the online simulator in English for free. If you encounter any problems, please contact tech support at support.city.en@redbrixwall.com 
Brought to you by MY.GAMES B.V.

Mythic Tools is the ultimate Magic: The Gathering companion app designed to enhance your experience. Create playgroups, add friends, list your decks, track life totals in all your duel and multiplayer games with a beautiful and full-featured life counter, save all your games and get meaningful statistics about your playgroups, your decks and your win rates.

EDHREC Integration: Discover related cards and build better decks with seamless access to EDHREC's extensive database of card recommendations.
Customizable Multiplayer Life Counter: Track life totals for multiple players with our intuitive life counter interface, perfect for multiplayer games like Commander. Quickly access the card scanner from the game for on-the-fly rulings and card information.

Transform your MTG experience with Mythic Tools, the all-in-one app that takes your gameplay and card management to the next level. Download now and unlock the full potential of your Magic: The Gathering games!

bluejetty:00140811:ios.description:
Take control of your diabetes with "Glucoly"—your all-in-one app for tracking, monitoring, and managing your health. Easily track your A1C, Glucose, Weight, Blood Pressure, Insulin, and Medications, and utilize our A1C Calculator to stay informed about your long-term glucose control.
Free Features
1.Comprehensive Tracking
- Glucose Logging: Easily record your blood glucose levels.
- Weight & Blood Pressure: Keep tabs on your weight and blood pressure over time.
- Insulin & Medication Logs: Track your insulin doses and medications.
- Insights: View averages for 3, 7 and 14 days to monitor your progress.
- Min/Max Levels: See the minimum and maximum glucose levels within a specific time range.
2.Custom Reminders: Set up reminders for glucose checks, medications, insulin doses, and more.
- Medicine-Specific Alerts: Never miss a dose with personalized medication reminders.
3.Personalized Experience
- Unit Preferences: Track glucose levels in your preferred units.
- Log Filtering: Filter your logs by type and time of day for better insights.
- Health Recommendations: Receive personalized health tips based on your data.
Pro Features
1.Advanced Reporting
- PDF Reports: Generate detailed PDF reports for A1C, Glucose, Weight, Blood Pressure, Insulin, and Medication logs to share with your healthcare provider.
- Extended Averages: Access averages for 3, 7, 14, 30, and 90 days to get a comprehensive view of your health trends.
2.Estimated A1C Calculation
-A1C Calculator: Get an estimated A1C based on your glucose readings to stay informed about your long-term glucose control.
Why Choose Our App?
- User-Friendly Interface: Designed for ease of use for all ages.
- Customizable Settings: Tailor the app to meet your specific needs.
- Reliable Support: Our support team is here to help whenever you need assistance.
Start Your Journey to Better Health
Empower yourself with the tools you need to manage your diabetes effectively. Download "Glucoly" today and take the first step towards a healthier you!
Download Now and Transform Your Diabetes Management Experience!
Disclaimer:
Glucoly allows you to record, track, and analyze your blood glucose information. A separate blood glucose meter is required to measure blood glucose levels, which can then be manually entered into the app.
Glucoly is not a substitute for professional healthcare or advice. Always consult healthcare professionals for medical guidance.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula
Terms of Use: https://glucoly.app/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://glucoly.app/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00157555:ios.description:
Discover the ultimate hidden objects game and embark on a journey through stunning locations, captivating puzzles, and mysterious adventures! This is not just another find objects game – it’s an immersive experience designed to excite and relax you at the same time. It’s perfect for anyone who loves to unwind while keeping their mind acфtive.
Step into the world of hidden secrets and surprises, where every location tells a story. From serene beaches and tranquil Japanese gardens to magical flying houses and rustic fishing villages, this game takes you to breathtaking destinations. Uncover the secrets behind each scene as you search and find hidden objects, solve the puzzles and collect rare treasures! 
Our Hidden objects game combine elements of puzzles, exploration, and storytelling, offering a relaxing yet engaging experience. Players enjoy hidden objects games because they stimulate observation skills, provide a sense of accomplishment with every item found, and feature captivating environments and intriguing mysteries. 
Game Features
Search and Find Hidden Objects – Explore beautifully detailed scenes to find hidden items and solve mysteries. With intuitive gameplay and helpful hints, you'll never feel stuck!
Multiple Stunning Locations – Discover settings such as:
- A peaceful beach, where the ocean hides its secrets.
- A mesmerizing Japanese garden filled with tranquility and mystery.
- A whimsical flying house, where every room tells a unique tale.
- A charming fishing village, where treasures await beneath the waves.
...and many more enchanting places waiting for you to explore!
Hidden Treasures Game – Search for rare artifacts and complete collections to unlock special rewards. Each treasure adds depth to the mystery and brings you closer to solving the adventure.
Relaxing Yet Captivating – The perfect balance of excitement and calm, making it ideal for unwinding after a busy day while keeping your mind sharp.
Hidden Object Mystery – Dive into an intriguing story filled with twists and turns as you uncover secrets and connect the dots in a thrilling hidden object puzzle adventure game.
Progressive Challenges – Start easy and gradually tackle more complex levels, designed to keep you entertained and motivated.
Hidden Items Game Modes – Experience different ways to play, from timed challenges to casual exploration.
Why You’ll Love This Game
- Relaxing Gameplay: A stress-free way to enjoy your free time while sharpening your observation skills.
- Variety of Challenges: Something for everyone – from beginners to experts.
- Immersive Graphics: High-quality visuals and detailed environments that transport you to another world.
- Frequent Updates: New locations, puzzles, and items to find added regularly to keep the adventure fresh.
How to Play
1.Search the Hidden Objects – Scan each scene carefully and find items from your list. Use hints if you need help.
2.Solve Puzzles – Unlock new areas and progress through the story by completing fun mini-games.
3.Collect and Unlock – Gather hidden treasures and artifacts to gain rewards and advance.
4.Explore New Locations – Progress through levels to unlock stunning new scenes.
This hidden things finding game is perfect for fans of adventure, puzzles, and relaxation. Whether you're new to hidden items games or a seasoned player, you’ll love exploring the diverse locations, solving intricate puzzles, and uncovering the hidden mysteries.
Can You Find Them All?
Get ready to dive into one of the most addictive hidden objects search and find adventures. With captivating locations, challenging puzzles, and calming gameplay, this game is a must-have for fans of the genre.
Explore, relax, and search for objects hidden in every corner. Will you find all the secrets?

bluejetty:00158394:ios.description:
This is a powerful app designed to enhance the user experience of WhatsApp. It supports multiple WhatsApp accounts, allowing the device to log in to multiple accounts simultaneously, making it easy to manage different accounts. Additionally, the built-in quick reply feature makes chatting more efficient, helping users quickly respond to important messages even when they are busy.
The app also offers file management capabilities, supporting the extraction of various compressed file formats, as well as providing file compression and encryption functions to ensure data security. Furthermore, the app integrates a direct messaging feature, enabling users to send messages quickly without adding contacts. Whether it’s communication management or file handling, this app provides a more convenient and efficient experience.
Main Features:
1. WhatsApp Multi-Account: Supports logging in to multiple WhatsApp accounts simultaneously, making it easy to manage personal and work accounts, with one-click switching to meet communication needs in different scenarios.
2. Quick Reply: Pre-set quick reply templates, perfect for customer service, business communication, and other scenarios, improving response efficiency and making communication more convenient.
3. Direct Messaging: Send messages to multiple contacts or groups with just one click, without the need to add contacts, saving time and improving communication efficiency.
4. File Management (Compression & Decompression): Supports decompression of various compressed file formats (ZIP, RAR, 7Z, etc.), and offers file compression and encryption features, ensuring secure and efficient data storage.
5. User-Friendly Interface: Features a simple and intuitive design that is easy to navigate, allowing even novice users to quickly get the hang of it.
6. Advanced Security Protection: The app uses advanced encryption technology to ensure that users' personal information and file data remain secure and reliable, providing worry-free usage.
7. Wide Compatibility: Supports various iOS devices, including iPhone and iPad, ensuring smooth performance and meeting the needs of different devices.
Disclaimer:
This is an unofficial tool for WhatsApp Messenger. 
We have no official affiliation or partnership with WhatsApp Inc. The use of this app is in accordance with the "Fair Use" guidelines.

bluejetty:00180307:ios.description:
The Gables Residential App is your partner in all things related to your community, especially when you’re on the go. With the Gables App you can now make monthly rent payments, submit maintenance requests, reserve amenities and more. This app is another extension of the Gables motto in “Taking Care of the Way You Live!”
Gables Residential Resident App features (options vary based on your community):
- Submit one-time rent payments in three easy steps with various payment methods.
- Set up monthly automatic payments to help you avoid late fees. 
- Submit maintenance requests with photos and voice memos and track the progress along the way.
- Reserve community amenities such as the resident lounge, meeting rooms, and pool area with just a few short clicks. 
- Track when your packages are delivered or picked up.
- Interact within your community through the Bulletin Board.
The Gables Residential Resident app has been designed for communities that use the RENTCafé platform as their Resident Portal. Some features may not be available at your community as options vary based on each community. If you have any questions about specific features, please reach out to your leasing office.

bluejetty:00120347:ios.description:
Unlock Your Full Musical Potential with Metronome ∞
Take your timing, rhythm, and technique to the next level with Metronome ∞ the all-in-one practice tool built for musicians of every level. Whether you’re a beginner learning your first chords or a professional refining precision, this app delivers the accuracy and flexibility you need.
Why Musicians Choose Metronome ∞
• Ultra-Precise Metronome
Stay perfectly in time with highly accurate BPM control for consistent practice.
• Tap to Set Tempo (BPM)
Quickly find your groove, just tap to match any song or rhythm instantly.
• Adjustable Tempo & Meter
Customize beats, subdivisions, and time signatures to fit any style.
• Visual Beat Feedback
Stay locked in with smooth, easy-to-follow visual beat indicators.
• Tempo Term Display
See musical tempo markings like Andante, Allegro, and more in real time.
• Custom Metronome Sounds
Choose from multiple sound styles or practice silently with visual cues.
Sharpen Your Timing with Practice Tools
Keeping time is the start. These tools test whether you can hold it.
• Bar Muting
Play a few bars, then let the click drop away. The beat keeps running in silence, so the moment it comes back you hear whether your timing held.
• Tempo Ramp
Climb a few BPM every few bars while you play. Start slow, end fast, and never reach for the dial.
• Presets & Setlists
Save a song's full setup, tempo, meter, sound and practice options, then step through your whole set in order.
• Count-In
Lead-in bars that always play first, so you begin locked in.
• New Beat Visuals & Panel Themes
Follow the beat with Orbit and Pendulum, and dress the panel in any of five themes.
Bar Muting, Tempo Ramp, Presets and the new visuals come with the full version.
Practice Anywhere with Apple Watch
Take your rhythm on the go with Apple Watch support:
• Start/stop your metronome instantly
• Keep time without reaching for your phone
• Perfect for practice, rehearsals, and live sessions
Stay in sync wherever you are.
**Upgrade Your Practice (In-App Purchases)**
Digital Tuner
Tune with confidence using a responsive and accurate tuner designed for real-world playing.
Guitar Suite
A powerful toolkit for guitarists of all levels:
• Massive Chord Library
• Essential Scales for Practice & Learning
• Play Mode with chord lookup & multitouch interaction
• Tune by Ear Mode for developing musical intuition
• Realistic touch-responsive strings
• Works with any tuning setup
Perfect for practice, teaching, songwriting, or quick reference.
Built for Every Musician
Whether you play guitar, piano, drums, or any instrument, Metronome ∞ helps you:
• Improve timing and rhythm
• Practice more efficiently
• Learn faster and play cleaner
• Build professional-level precision
Practice Smarter. Play Better.
From daily practice sessions to live performance prep, Metronome ∞ is the essential tool trusted by musicians everywhere.
Download now and take control of your rhythm.

bluejetty:00076639:ios.summary: The NBC San Diego app is your trusted source for local news, NBC 7 First Alert Weather forecasts and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, wildfire updates, traffic tracking and 24/7 news streaming tailored for
bluejetty:00076639:ios.description:
The NBC San Diego app is your trusted source for local news, NBC 7 First Alert Weather forecasts and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, wildfire updates, traffic tracking and 24/7 news streaming tailored for San Diego County and Southern California.
Get trusted local reporting, real-time weather updates and live coverage from NBC 7 San Diego in one app. Follow stories across San Diego County, including breaking news, politics, elections, public safety, severe weather, traffic, fires, earthquakes and urgent updates that affect your day.
Why use the NBC San Diego app?
If you live or work in San Diego or Southern California, the NBC San Diego app offers live local coverage, investigative reporting and real-time alerts to keep you informed throughout the day.
What can you do with the NBC San Diego app?
Follow San Diego local news and community
* Get instant push notifications for local, national and world headlines
* Read exclusive articles and watch video reports from NBC 7 San Diego journalists
* Catch up on stories you missed in the integrated Alerts Center
* Follow key topics including local economy, public safety, transit and education
Follow elections and politics
* Follow complete coverage of electoral races in San Diego, San Diego County, statewide California contests and local races
* Track primary and general election results, ballot measures and local proposals
* Watch live election debates and analysis with NBC 7 anchors
Stay ahead of the weather, wildfires and earthquakes with live radar
* Check current conditions, hourly forecasts, 10-day projections, air quality and UV index
* Access NBC 7 First Alert Weather live Doppler radar to track microclimate updates, wildfire threats, earthquake advisories and severe weather
* Add custom weather widgets to your Home Screen to quickly check forecasts for your area
24/7 live streaming and special coverage
* Watch live NBC 7 San Diego newscasts and special coverage on demand
* Follow investigative journalism from NBC 7 Investigates and consumer guidance from NBC 7 Responds
Personalize your NBC San Diego experience
* Sign in with an NBCUniversal Profile to save articles and videos to watch later
* Manage alert preferences and newsletter subscriptions all in one place
Who is the NBC San Diego app for?
It is designed for residents and commuters across San Diego, Chula Vista, Oceanside, Escondido, Carlsbad, El Cajon, La Mesa, Encinitas and San Diego County who need real-time weather tracking, traffic and local news updates.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I customize news, election, wildfire and weather alerts?
Yes. You can filter push notifications by topic and location, receiving only the severe weather alerts, wildfire updates, earthquake advisories, breaking news or election notices you choose.
Can I watch live newscasts inside the app?
Yes. You can stream NBC San Diego News 24/7, live NBC 7 San Diego newscasts, press conferences and special breaking coverage from anywhere.
NBC San Diego provides local news, NBC 7 First Alert Weather forecasts, live radar, wildfire tracking, traffic and 24/7 streaming for San Diego County and Southern California.

PLAY WITH ANYONE.
Cross-platform play is supported. Play with friends (or enemies?) between PC, mobile, or console!
If you have any issues, visit us at: https://www.innersloth.com/faq/

bluejetty:00077844:ios.description:
Dance cardio and sculpt classes with real results: meet the dance workout created by nice people dancing to good music. In 2013, our proudly small, female-founded business kicked off in NYC out of pure demand for effective, fun, challenging, community-oriented dance fitness classes.
Through DanceBody LIVE, you can stream multiple LIVE classes daily. Or, workout On Demand around your schedule with hundreds of dance cardio and sculpt classes, varying in length and level. No equipment necessary to start, but you can find everything you need to enhance your workouts on our DanceBody Shop.
Email us at streamteam@dancebody.com. Check us out socially on @dancebody on any platform and use the hashtags #streamteam #dancebodylive
DanceBody in-studio classes are available in NYC, Miami, Los Angeles, and seasonally in The Hamptons. Check out dancebody.com for more information.
The app integrates with Apple Health Kit to display your heart rate in real time, so that you can see the intensity of your workout and earn sweat points on the leaderboard. To access all features and content you can subscribe to DanceBody LIVE on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app*. Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
*All payments are paid through your iTunes/Google Account and may be managed under Account Settings after initial payment. Subscription payments automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24 hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: www.dancebody.com/dancebody-terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: www.dancebody.com/dancebody-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00131886:ios.name: Halide Mark III - Pro Camera
bluejetty:00131886:ios.summary: Halide unleashes your iPhone’s camera. Disable iPhone processing for natural photos, apply powerful film situations, access manual controls, and more. Halide has over 24,000 5-star ratings and is an App Store Editors’ Choice and Apple Desig
bluejetty:00131886:ios.description:
Halide unleashes your iPhone’s camera. Disable iPhone processing for natural photos, apply powerful film situations, access manual controls, and more. Halide has over 24,000 5-star ratings and is an App Store Editors’ Choice and Apple Design Award winner.
Halide’s Looks are built into the camera itself, changing how your photo is captured and processed - not just a color filter applied after the fact. These are the best photos you can get out of an iPhone. Start with Process Zero for natural, film-like results, without any AI or computational photography. Explore our rich set of creative Looks developed with Hollywood colorist Cullen Kelly, and powered by sophisticated film simulation. 
For nine years, Halide has set the standard for professional iPhone camera control. Nail your manual focus with Focus Peaking and the Focus Loupe. Compose your shots with intention using sophisticated framing guides, from a basic grid and rule of thirds, to the golden ratio and rabatment of the rectangle. Get perfect macro shots with Halide's dedicated Macro Mode.
Hate editing? Halide gives you amazing results straight out of the camera. But when you need to fine-tune, Photo Lab makes it fast and intuitive. Try dramatically different Looks, adjust framing and exposure, experiment with film simulation, or rescue details in highlights and shadows with Tone Fusion.
You can even import and load RAWs from other apps, such as Apple’s own camera app, or standalone cameras by Canon, Nikon, Sony, Leica, Fujifilm, and Hasselblad. Specific formats are listed below.
*Halide is a paid app. Try it free for 7 days with an annual membership, or buy it outright with a one-time purchase — no subscription required.*
Features:
- Shoot without Apple’s computational photography for stronger contrast and more natural results.
- Photographic Looks developed in collaboration with esteemed Hollywood colorist Cullen Kelly.
- Rescue details in shadows and highlights with a Tone Fusion slider inspired by darkroom dodging and burning.
- Try any Look on existing ProRAW files - including photos shot in Apple’s camera app.
- Become a better photographer by signing up for our 10-day tutorial directly from the app.
- Full manual exposure controls including shutter speed, ISO and white balance.
- Technical Readout to view all details of your iPhone camera hardware.
- Also runs on iPad, for an amazing Photo Lab experience.
RAW File Support:
- DNG (iPhone, Leica)
- CR2 (Canon)
- CR3 (Canon)
- NEF (Nikon)
- RAF (Fujifilm)
- ARW (Sony)
- FFF (Hasselblad)
Terms of Use can be found here: https://halide.cam/terms
Privacy: https://www.lux.camera/privacy/

bluejetty:00177131:ios.name: Ulti-Planner Calendar & PIM
bluejetty:00177131:ios.summary: Ulti-Planner is your modern calendar app with best-in-class features. We have spent years perfecting our flagship product with speed, power, and flexibility. Features include full year, month, timeline day, week, split day, and agenda list
bluejetty:00177131:ios.description:
Ulti-Planner is your modern calendar app with best-in-class features. We have spent years perfecting our flagship product with speed, power, and flexibility. Features include full year, month, timeline day, week, split day, and agenda list views to display your events and reminders, along with advanced tools like custom view filters, drag-n-drop, natural language parsing, and widgets to really take control. 
USE IT FOR FREE
The basic version is our “best in class” year, month and week calendar with great customizations and the features you will love to quickly access your event data in new powerful ways. And try the “premium” version free for 14 days to see if the integrations and advanced views take you to the next level.
FEATURES
• The most powerful and customizable month view anywhere
• Multiple high design widgets
• Modern card based Item display
• Birthdays with images
• Wallpaper(iPhone)
• Special Birthday filter
• Copy/Paste events
• Drag-n-Drop support
• Time zone support
• Full Year view
• Uses and expands on your native calendar data.
• Sync like you would with the default calendar (Google, iCloud, Exchange)
• Quickly jump to your Zoom, GotoMeeting, Skype, Webex, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams calls
• Universal support for iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Accessibility support
ADVANCED POWER
• Global search view
• Swipe the month view for full screen and week views
• Quick filtering by calendars 
• Advanced filters by calendar, participants, and tags and set custom view for each
• Save events as templates 
• Embed lists into events (and reminders)
• Show a day bar to highlight your day
• Share events (and reminders)
CUSTOMIZATION
• App Icon choices
• Dark and light theme support
• Many bright colored themes
• Solid color background themes
• If you need more room hide large titles
• Calendar has 9 view display types and 4 text sizes
• Week number, week start, and colored text calendar choices
• Choose default map and links apps
PREMIUM
• Powerful block week, timeline day, split day, and agenda list views
• Natural language ‘Quick Entry’ (English only)
• Even more app icons
• Weather support
• Hashtag/ Keyword support used in sorting, filtering, and icons
• Assign popular emoji icons to events, reminders, calendars, keywords, or hashtags
• Projects and Goals!
PREMIUM REMINDERS
• Integrate reminders in your calendar and widgets
• Reminder screen with pinning, recent lists, and custom views.
• Specialty views including a reminders map
• Three levels of sorting on each view
• Reminder templates
• Swap reminders to events quickly
PREMIUM CONTACTS
• Full Integrated Contact Screen with 3 layouts
• Favorites, Custom Views, and More
HISTORY
Ulti-Planner is the culmination of over 20 years experience in building mobile calendar and organizer apps. The original Ulti-Planner was conceived in 2004 on Windows Mobile. We have since made top level productivity apps including Extreme Agenda and The Grid Calendar, with great success. We have taken that experience and put over 1200 hours in to make our engine the most modern, fast, small, clean, and flexible calendaring system for iOS. The results are the new Ulti-Planner. 
SUPPORT
We are known for our technical support so contact us directly from within the app in the settings with any issues you may have. Or explore our website for answers you may want on how things work. A question that does come up a lot, is people think that our app is responsible for Apple Event data disappearing. Please check that you just don’t have the data filtered out but more importantly Apple has a setting in Calendar in the main Settings app that is called ’Sync’ that can hide older events from you.
Note that for some of the advanced features like icons, lists, and hashtags, info will be added to your event and reminder notes in order to save and sync this info.
The Ultimate in Organization. Your calendar evolved.

bluejetty:00028385:ios.summary: From the acclaimed Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six franchise, Rainbow Six Mobile is a competitive online tactical action shooter FPS built specifically for online mobile action. Engage in intense 5v5 multiplayer FPS matches inspired by Rainbow Six
bluejetty:00028385:ios.description:
From the acclaimed Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six franchise, Rainbow Six Mobile is a competitive online tactical action shooter FPS built specifically for online mobile action. Engage in intense 5v5 multiplayer FPS matches inspired by Rainbow Six Siege’s iconic Attack vs. Defense gameplay. Alternate roles every round as you play Attacker or Defender in fast-paced online combat. Experience close-quarter shooter action where teamwork, positioning, and map knowledge make the difference. Choose from a roster of elite Operators from Rainbow Six Siege, each designed for action tactical team play with unique abilities and gadgets. Every map offers new strategic possibilities, demanding coordination, precision, and smart decisions. 
Rainbow Six Mobile delivers a true FPS action shooter experience, adapted for mobile platforms. 
MOBILE ADAPTATION – Rainbow Six Mobile has been developed and optimized for mobile devices, delivering smooth online gameplay, intuitive controls, and shorter 5v5 FPS matches. Customize your HUD, adjust controls to your playstyle, and jump into tactical combat anywhere, anytime. This mobile shooter supports responsive touch controls and controller compatibility for competitive action on the go. 
RAINBOW SIX EXPERIENCE – Experience the authentic Rainbow Six Siege on mobile. Play on legendary maps such as Bank, Clubhouse, Border, Oregon, and Villa. Each map is designed for tactical team coordination and intense 5v5 online combat. Squad up with friends and players worldwide in thrilling multiplayer action FPS battles. 
TACTICAL SHOOTER GAME – Rainbow Six Mobile, like Rainbow Six Siege, is an action-tactical shooter focused on realistic combat. Clear angles, gather intel with drones and cameras, and adapt your strategy to every map. Smart decisions, teamwork, and preparation are essential to dominate this online action FPS. 
DESTRUCTIBLE ENVIRONMENTS – Use destruction to your advantage in close-quarter combat. Break walls, doors, and hatches to reshape the map and create new tactical opportunities. Every map becomes a dynamic battlefield where strategy and action collide in intense shooter gameplay. 
STRATEGIC TEAM-BASED PVP – Strategy and teamwork are the keys to success in Rainbow Six Mobile. Adapt your strategy to each map, role, and situation in competitive 5v5 online combat. Attackers gather intel and breach defenses, while Defenders fortify positions and control the map. True tactical action shooter gameplay rewards communication and planning. 
SPECIALIZED OPERATORS – Build your team with highly trained Operators from Rainbow Six Siege. Each Operator brings unique weapons, gadgets, and abilities to the battlefield. Mastering Operators is key to success in this competitive online shooter. 
NEW MONTHLY SEASON – Every month, discover new action with fresh Operators, Battle Pass content, limited-time online modes, events, and cosmetics. Keep your team ready for evolving combat challenges across new and familiar maps. 
This game requires an online connection (4G, 5G, or Wi-Fi).

Terms of Use: https://legal.ubi.com/termsofuse

bluejetty:00132022:ios.name: myPhonak Junior
bluejetty:00132022:ios.summary: The myPhonak Junior app allows you and your child to be more involved in the hearing journey in a way that fits into the child’s and the family’s needs. Working together with your hearing care professional is essential to determine which fe
bluejetty:00132022:ios.description:
The myPhonak Junior app allows you and your child to be more involved in the hearing journey in a way that fits into the child’s and the family’s needs. Working together with your hearing care professional is essential to determine which features of the app will be most beneficial.
The Remote Control function has been specially designed for children aged 6 years and above (with supervision when needed). It gives your child the ability to adjust the settings on their hearing aids to suit their listening preferences in more challenging environments. The myPhonak Junior app has been precisely designed to empower children in an age-appropriate without sacrificing hearing performance.
Remote Support* is suitable for families and children of all ages. It gives you the opportunity to stay connected with your hearing care professional remotely. Whether your child is still young and you are the main contact person, or your child is old enough to take on the responsibility for their hearing appointments, Remote Support provides the opportunity to have ‘hearing check ins’ which can be aligned with your busy lifestyle. Remote Support appointments can be combined with clinic appointments to provide minor adjustments to the hearing aids, or simply as a special consultation touch point.
* Speak to your hearing healthcare provider to see if this service is offered in your country
The myPhonak Junior app empowers your child (age 6 years and above, with supervision when needed) to:
- adjust the volume and change program of the hearing aids
- personalize and customize hearing programs to suit challenging environments
- access status information such as wearing time and battery state of charge (for rechargeable hearing aids)
- access quick information, FAQs, tips and tricks
Safety features in the app allow parents/guardians to:
- tailor the child’s experience according to their level of development and independence through Parental control
- configure Auto On when out of charger for rechargeable hearing aids
- change Bluetooth bandwidth configuration for phone calls
Compatible Hearing Aid models:
- Phonak Audéo™ E (EON) Sphere
- Phonak Audéo™ E (EON)
- Phonak CROS E (EON)
- Phonak Audéo™ Infinio
- Phonak Sky™ Lumity
- Phonak CROS™ Lumity
- Phonak Naída™ Lumity
- Phonak Audéo™ Lumity R, RT, RL
- Phonak CROS™ Paradise
- Phonak Sky™ Marvel
- Phonak Sky™ Link M
- Phonak Naída™ P
- Phonak Audéo™ P
- Phonak Audéo™ M
- Phonak Naída™ M
- Phonak Bolero™ M
Device compatibility:
The myPhonak Junior app is compatible with Phonak hearing aids with Bluetooth® connectivity. 
myPhonak Junior can be used on phones with Bluetooth® Low Energy (LE) capability running iOS® 16.0 or newer.
To check smartphone compatibility, please visit our compatibility checker: https://www.phonak.com/en-int/support/compatibility
IOS® is a registered trademark or trademark of Cisco Systems, Inc. and/or its affiliates in the United States and certain other countries.
The Bluetooth® word mark and logos are registered trademarks owned by Bluetooth SIG, Inc. and any use of such marks by Sonova AG is under license.

bluejetty:00126726:ios.description:
THE WHOLE REGION IN ONE APP
DOWNLOAD THE ZELL AM SEE-KAPRUN APP & ENJOY A RELAXED HOLIDAY
Want to know exactly what is going on when and where during your holiday? What the weather will be
like during the day, and what event is there in the evening? Where to find the best shopping addresses and
the top restaurants? What amount of fresh snow you can look forward to in winter and what lake
temperatures you can enjoy in summer? All this can be found at a glance with the Zell am See-Kaprun
App - it's the perfect companion for your holiday between glacier, mountain, and lake.
Top features:
• Your digital holiday companion
Adventure planner, restaurant guide and mobile info point. Daily updated information on opening
hours, weather & local events: the Zell am See-Kaprun App offers everything you need to know
about the region in one place and is your must-have for a relaxed holiday.
• Shopping for experiences directly in the app
With an existing user account, you can buy tickets for the region's mountain railway experiences
directly in the Zell am See-Kaprun App. The purchase is completed in just a few steps, with no
waiting time - and the tickets can be managed directly in the digital wallet of the app.
• Wallet with digital cards and tickets
After checking in at your accommodation and activating your user account, you will find your
personalised cards for your stay in the digital wallet.
• Digital regional map with route planner
The integrated digital route planner makes getting around easier and guides you from your current
location directly to your next desired destination - by public transport, car or on foot. The map
also includes all hiking, running, and biking routes in the region. Detailed descriptions,
information on the level of difficulty, distance and metres in altitude included.
• Season switch
By selecting from the menu bar, you can easily switch between the spring, summer, autumn, and winter seasons to keep track of all the offers in Zell am See-Kaprun at any time. This makes planning your future holiday in the region even easier.

• simplifica a forma como faz as operações, com preenchimento automático de dados, para que não perca tempo;

• possibilidade de personalizar as suas preferências de visualização, desde a forma como prefere ver a informação, mais gráfica ou textual, até ao tamanho de letra;

• E ainda, lhe permite propor novas funcionalidades ou customizações que são essenciais para si.

A app do novobanco tem ainda:

Um ecrã inicial com o resumo das principais opções; saldos e movimentos das suas Contas; a sua Posição Integrada; os cartões de crédito associados e acesso rápido à opção de carregamentos para que acompanhe a atividade das suas Contas de forma simplificada.

Visualização de movimentos de conta para todas as contas associadas com categorização de acordo com o tipo de despesa/receita, incluindo para contas de outros bancos.
Menu e uma navegação muito intuitiva, que lhe permite aceder a todas as opções de personalização e de utilização num único ecrã.

Com o Appe Pay faça as suas compras de forma fácil, rápida e segura. Realize comodamente pagamentos através do seu iPhone ou Apple Watch.
Adicione o seu cartão novobanco à Carteira do seu iPhone.

Em caso de dúvida ou sugestões, envie-nos um e-mail para mobile@novobanco.pt

bluejetty:00184493:ios.name: Word Search: Themed Puzzles
bluejetty:00184493:ios.summary:
Hunt for hidden words across hundreds of themed grids. No timer, no pressure, no connection required.
PICK A THEME, NOT JUST A PUZZLE
Most word games hand you random letters. Here every grid has a subject: Animals, Countries, Food, Pirates
bluejetty:00184493:ios.description:
Hunt for hidden words across hundreds of themed grids. No timer, no pressure, no connection required.
PICK A THEME, NOT JUST A PUZZLE
Most word games hand you random letters. Here every grid has a subject: Animals, Countries, Food, Pirates, Astronomy, History, Sports, Science, Comics, Art, Kitchen and dozens more. Choose what you feel like today and the words follow.
HOW IT WORKS
- Words hide across, down, backwards and diagonally
- Swipe across the letters to mark a word
- Clear the list to finish the grid and collect your reward
- Difficulty scales from a gentle warm-up to grids that make you work
RELAXING BY DESIGN
No countdown. No lives to lose. No streak to break. Put it down mid-grid and it will be waiting exactly as you left it.
GOOD FOR YOUR VOCABULARY
Every theme brings words you half-knew and words you did not. Players use it to keep sharp, to build vocabulary and to practise English.
PLAYS FULLY OFFLINE
No connection needed. On a plane, on the bus, in a waiting room or anywhere the signal drops.
FITS ANY SCREEN
Crisp, high-contrast letter grids that scale properly on both iPhone and iPad, in portrait or landscape.
FOR EVERY AGE
Simple enough for a child learning their first words, deep enough for a daily habit. Nothing in here is unsuitable for anyone.
WHAT YOU GET FREE
- Hundreds of themed grids, with new puzzles and events added regularly
- Full offline play
- Achievements and progress tracking
- Four difficulty levels
- No timers and no pressure
An optional VIP Pass unlocks every category and removes ads.
Download and find your first word in seconds.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Subscription Information
Optional VIP Pass subscription is available to enhance your experience.
Weekly USD $1.99 VIP subscription unlocks all word categories and removes all ads from the game. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account upon purchase confirmation.
The subscription automatically renews each week unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged USD $1.99 for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time via your App Store account settings.
Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription. Please note that an internet connection is required to access subscription features.
For more information on how to cancel subscriptions, please visit Apple Support at support.apple.com/HT207865. If you have any questions or need assistance, our support team is just an email away at contact@oneup.games.
Privacy Policy: https://oneup.games/privacy.html

bluejetty:00180109:ios.description:
The Trek Central app seamlessly connects with your bike so you can customize motor behavior, track your activities, get real-time range calculations, and use navigation features to figure out where you're going. You'll also get suspension set-up recommendations, service reminders, and more! 
YOUR PERFECT TUNE 
Use Trek Central to adjust how the assist from your motor feels. Adjust Max Power, Assist Factor, and Pedal Response to optimize YOUR ride. Turn it down to maximize range, get better traction, or make the bike easier to handle on tricky climbs. Crank it up if you want to go turbo-all-the-time. Note - Tuning options vary by model.
TRACK YOUR RIDE 
You can leave your phone in your pocket or pack and still get all the data you want from your ride. With Auto Start enabled, all you have to do is start riding, and Trek Central will record all the metrics including distance, speed, elevation, power output, and more. You can also export your ride data to Strava or Komoot, and you can even share your rides to other Trek Central users. 
HOW FAR WILL YOU GO? 
See how far your Trek or Electra eBike will take you with real-time range calculations. Trek Central shows you how far you can go in each assist mode and will adjust accordingly as you adjust assist modes. You can even find your destination on the Range Cloud map to make sure you have enough battery to get there. Trek Central calculates range using advanced algorithms that factor in not only rider weight and battery capacity, but also topographic terrain data as well as historical rider behavior. 
DIAL IT IN
Trek Central provides customized setup recommendations for your suspension settings and tire pressure. Select models like Fuel EXe 9.9 even incorporate Quarq TyreWiz and RockShox AirWiz sensors that let you know whether your pressure is high, low, or just right with a quick glance at Trek Central’s Ready to Ride screen. One-click connect pairs your sensors to your phone automatically when you connect to your bike. 
*Please note that the Trek Central app currently only works with Trek eBikes equipped with TQ or Hyena motors.
Find Trek Central FAQs here - https://www.trekbikes.com/trek-central-faq/
Having trouble? Contact our support team for assistance at RiderSupport@Trekbikes.com

bluejetty:00174000:ios.description:
"Are you shy? Then how will you do it on the first night?"
They live in the palace of deep sea, where no one know!
Unfold the secrets of those men in the dangerous yet tempting underwater!
In front of the hidden secrets of the sea, can you forge your destiny and protect your connections?
Solve the unsolved mysteries of the Palace of Mermaids and choose your own ending!
[ Game Introduction ]
Presented by Storytaco and E&P Games, "Aqua Romance" is a unique high-level romance otome game. 
It is a modern fantasy interactive choice game where you can immerse yourself in an enchanting universe filled with thrilling twists. 
Write your own romance story in """"Aqua Romance""""! 
(Note: Every choice you make changes the fate of the characters.)
[ Game Story ]
In a tranquil seaside village, the moist(?) proposals of the mermaids begin!
"...I'm the heir of the King?"
After failing in your career and returning to your hometown, four charming men and women appear in front of you.
Set aside the hope for a miracle.
Your promise to embark on a new path with excited hearts becomes meaningless,
as you find yourself at a crossroads of life-altering decisions.
A grand and beautiful palace beneath the sea strech out in front of your eyes,
slowly revealing secrets and hidden stories of the mermaid royal family...
And the mermaids who are vying for you start to reveal their true self!
"I will never let anyone take you from me"
#BrightSunshine #PuppyLike #Submissive
- Your First Love, Jayden
"C-can... you... love me... more?"
#UnexpectedCharm #ShyGuy #Redeeming Love
- Aristocrat, Arthur
"Right now, what matters is that I need you."
#Mysterious #BadBoy #ForbiddenRomance
- Mysterious Figure, Kai
"I'm unarmed in front of you!"
#ToughGirl #PassionateCharacter #GrowthRomance
- Childhood Friend, Chloe
It's too late to run away!
Choose your romance ending right now!
 [ Charming point! ]
- A tantalizing romance story for mature players!
- Various character costumes that lead to desired endings!
- A women-oriented otome text romance game.
- Increase character likability and collect high-quality illustrations with diverse romantic moods!
- Enjoy thrilling moments with a variety of choices and illustrations.
- Collect a wide range of endings with different strategic characters.
[Aqua Romance is recommended for...]
-Those who want to enjoy an immersive female-oriented dating simulation game full of realism.
-Those who want to meet a sexy mermaid character in a role-playing game.
-Those looking for handsome or innocent characters.
-Those who haven't found a satisfying yuri dating simulation.
-Those who want to enjoy a romantic relationship with charming characters.
-Those who want to try a female-oriented visual novel or multiple character game with furry.
-Those who want to experience surrogate satisfaction through sweet dating simulation.
-Those who want to see high-quality date illustrations full of immersion.
-Those who want to explore different endings based on their choices in story gameplay.
-Those who want to check and make various choices in the game.
-Those who enjoy uncovering plot twists and pondering choices in story gameplay.
-Those who want to enjoy an LGBTQ+ romance simulation game.
-Those who want to experience the refreshing feeling of beach romance.
-Those who can't give up on either bad or good guys.
-Those looking for a story with a blend of Eastern and Western elements.
-Those who enjoy the boundary between everyday life and fantasy.
-Those who like pure romance comics, web novels, and webtoons.
-Fans of dating story games like Day7, Storytaco, Maybe, and Storypick.
-Those who have enjoyed Arcana Twilight.
-Those who have had fun playing with Eternal AfterLife.

bluejetty:00160924:ios.summary: Scanner HD is portable and handy for people who want to replace a traditional physical scanner with a scanning app on iPhone. With smartphone camera, Scanner HD App can automatically or manually capture documents, auto crop edges, and scan
bluejetty:00160924:ios.description:
Scanner HD is portable and handy for people who want to replace a traditional physical scanner with a scanning app on iPhone. With smartphone camera, Scanner HD App can automatically or manually capture documents, auto crop edges, and scan multiple pages documents to one clean PDF or PNG file for editing, signing and sharing online. 
Scanner HD app is great at scanning varieties of paper or digital document types, including rebate forms, tax documents, business cards, photos, and even books. Anyone who wants free scanning with excellent text-recognition (OCR) results, Scanner HD, which can recognize 14 languages, is your best option. 
In addition to PDF, you are allowed to save, export, convert and share in PNG, TXT and word. Scanner HD App also offers features like custom folders for better organization, file renaming, iCloud syncing, and uploading to your cloud storage services. 
Do more with Scanner HD:
- Digitize important documents: ID card, photos, receipts, pictures, books, passport, handwritten notes, legal documents, or the occasional form
- Turn scanned image or pdf into text, so you can read, select, copy and export
- Create, add and save digital signature
- Enhance scan quality: Change scan type settings (Black & White, Original, Scans, Magic, Grayscale, Threshold); adjust Contrast and Brightness 
- Convert any scan into editable TXT, PNG, JPG, PDF for free
- Protect scans with password and share securely
- Recognizes the text in 14 languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Danish, Turkish
- Quickly sharing and saving unlimited pages to Dropbox, Box, Google Drive, OneDrive, WhatsApp, Facebook, LinkedIn for free 
This app contains subscription: 
- You can subscribe for premium account to remove ads
- Subscription is from $9.99 USD monthly, $4.99 weekly, $39.99 yearly
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original "one month"/"one week"/"one year" package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Privacy Policy: https://scannerhd.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://scannerhd.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00122955:ios.description:
Mitt Telenor gives you a full overview of all your subscriptions and services in Telenor! Stay in control of usage and costs, view your invoice or add extra data to your subscription - available both in Norway and abroad. 
Stay updated on new subscriptions and services so that you always have what suits you and your family's needs. You can easily change broadband speed, change channels and content in T-We, or change mobile subscription. Add more services to your subscription or order useful security services such as SAFE. With SAFE in Mitt Telenor you can also activate the VPN-service SAFE WiFi when using insecure networks. 
More features in Mitt Telenor:
• View, postpone or pay invoice
• Order extra data packages
• Change or order subscriptions
• Top up your pre-paid with Vipps
• View PUK-code
• Order, activate or bar SIM-cards
• Add or remove services
• Overview of SWAP-agreements and mobile devices
• Manage security services such as Nettvern and SAFE
• Overview of insurances
• Contact customer support
Nice to know: 
You must be a Telenor customer to get the full value of Mitt Telenor. As a new customer, some features might not be available to you in the first month. 
For login and optimal use of the app, we ask that you have an updated browser installed and use an updated version of your OS. You must be connected through mobile data or WiFi to use the services in Mitt Telenor.

bluejetty:00016747:ios.description:
The official 2026 app for the Melbourne International Film Festival allows you to explore, connect and streamline your Festival experience. 
The Melbourne International Film Festival app lets you: 
Explore the Festival program: 
 - Browse the program by name, date, venue
 - Browse ‘What's On Next' at the Festival 
 - View both free and ticketed events
Buy and download tickets: 
 - Go paperless: your tickets can be scanned directly from the screen
 - Buy tickets securely with your credit card anywhere, anytime 
 - Buy passes and redeem sessions immediately 
 - Add your tickets to Passbook
 - Add your sessions to iCal
Schedule your attendance and share with friends: 
 - Create a shortlist of events through your Wishlist and connect it to your calendar
 - Share events with friends 
Left your printed tickets at home? 
The app stores all your ticket barcodes on your device regardless of how you purchased (web, phone or in-person). Door staff can scan your ticket right from your device's screen.
About the 2026 Melbourne International Film Festival 
MIFF is an independent not-for-profit organisation that has been continuously running since 1952, making it the premier film festival in Australia and one of the world’s oldest film festivals, alongside Cannes and Berlin. Presenting a curated global program of innovative screen experiences and the world’s largest showcase of exceptional Australian filmmaking, MIFF is an accessible, iconic cultural event that provides transformative experiences for audiences and filmmakers alike.
About the developers: 
Ferve Tickets are proud to support this year's Melbourne International Film Festival program.
Whether you're buying tickets online or at the box office, knowing where to be for the next show, or having your tickets and passes when you need them, we're with you the whole way.

bluejetty:00120134:ios.description:
From the award-winning creators of Studycat for Schools, comes Learn Chinese! The #1 way for kids to learn 中文 (mandarin)!
From preschool and beyond, Learn Chinese by Studycat inspires children's innate love of learning with interactive games and activities.
Our bite-sized lessons will keep your child motivated while they discover a new language and build bilingual skills for a lifetime!
WHY STUDYCAT?
• Learn Chinese, in Chinese. All our activities focus on virtual language immersion, which means your child won't be hearing any English, only Chinese! This might be confusing at first, but trust us, it's the best way to learn.
• Everyday Language. Our lessons teach words and expressions that kids can apply in their everyday lives, so they can get a head start developing their bilingual abilities.
• Get Talking Fast. With our interactive speaking challenges, kids will be encouraged to speak entire words and phrases on their own! The earlier kids start their language-learning journey, the more likely they are to reach proficiency quickly.
• Vocal Variety. Our characters' voices use different tones, expressions, and accents so that kids can pick up on the subtleties of pronunciation from different speakers.
• Designed by Experts. All our activities are designed by language and early-education experts. Thoughtfully developed lessons will build your child's confidence with every step.
• Learner Profiles (coming soon). Create up to four personalized profiles for different family members, allowing tailored learning paths and individual progress tracking.
• Safe for Kids & Ad-Free. Parents can rest easy knowing that there are no pesky ads to distract children from their learning. All content is appropriate for ages 3 and up.
• Offline Learning. On a plane, at a restaurant, or in a park? No problem! Learn Chinese by Studycat is available for both online and offline use.
WHAT ARE PARENTS SAYING?
“As a parent trying to raise bilingual children at home, Studycat is a helpful app to start them off and create excitement about the language.” — Fluent in 3 Months
“Everything has been thought out carefully and the games and activities are really engaging.” — Bilingual Kidspot
“The concept is so simple but extremely effective. I even found myself learning at the same time.” — Bump, Baby & You
--
If you like Learn Chinese by Studycat, try it out for 7 days free! Empower your child to learn like never before, and get extras like printable worksheets.
If you choose to subscribe, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://studycat.com/about/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://studycat.com/about/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00172891:ios.summary:
