bluejetty:00172891:ios.description:
Tired of repeating the same house rules—and still hearing "that's not fair"?
Chores Tracker and Allowance turns daily check-ins into a clear Points system. New Challenges and Badges give kids a reason to keep going, not just to get through today.
It is a family organizer that turns everyday effort into Points kids can redeem for Rewards you choose together.
"The instant +1 and -1 rules changed our evenings. Helping out now has a clear payoff, and the Don'ts finally stick." — Maya R., mom of 2
Download Chores Tracker and Allowance and start rewarding the behavior you want to see.
WHY CHOOSE "Chores Tracker and Allowance"?
1. ONE PLACE FOR THE WHOLE HOUSE
Stop juggling notes, charts, and reminders. Assign Habits and chores once, see who is on track, and keep every parent looking at the same plan.
2. POINTS THAT TURN INTO REAL REWARDS
Kids earn Points for work they finish, then redeem Rewards you actually want to offer. The catalog is yours—screen time, a family outing, or a treat you already planned.
3. HOUSE RULES THAT APPLY IN THE MOMENT
Should Do and Don't items score Behavior on the spot. Help without being asked, lose Points for a Don't, and let the rule—not the argument—do the talking.
4. CHALLENGES KIDS CAN WEAR WITH PRIDE
Set a Challenge the family can finish together, then unlock a Badge they can show off. Progress becomes something they want to keep, not something you have to push.
KEY FEATURES
1. CHALLENGES AND BADGES
Tie a Challenge to Habits, Behavior, Lists, or Pomodoro. Unlock a Badge when the family finishes, and repeat daily, weekly, or on a date range you set.
2. HABITS WITH POINTS
Assign Points or a Reward to every check-in. Add negative Points to discourage a bad Habit, and choose whether everyone must finish or one person is enough.
3. LISTS AND TASKS
Plan light teamwork: assign Tasks, set due dates, and attach Points or a Reward so the whole family can see who owns what.
4. POMODORO AND TIMERS
Give a member a Pomodoro or a simple timer. Finish a focus block to earn a Reward, or grant Points for every few minutes they stay on task.
5. BEHAVIOR: SHOULD DO AND DON'T
Score Behavior the moment it happens. Clear Should Do and Don't rules keep bonuses and penalties consistent for every child.
6. REWARDS KIDS CAN REDEEM
Build a Reward catalog with different Point costs, control who can see each item, add comments, and cap how many times someone can redeem per day.
7. FAMILY MEMBERS
Invite parents with a code, keep a profile for each child, and let more than one adult manage the same house.
8. TEMPLATES
Start from 300+ ready Habits, Tasks, Rewards, and Behavior rules so you are not building the first week from a blank screen.
9. MULTI-DEVICE SUPPORT
Parents and kids can each use their own device. A PIN keeps accounts separate so one person's check-in does not overwrite another.
10. HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
See today's progress, Challenge status, and family activity on the Home Screen—no need to open the app first.
11. SHARED-DEVICE CHECK-IN
When the family shares one tablet, switch members in Check-in Mode so everyone can complete their own Habits on the same screen.
PRO FEATURES
- Add unlimited family members
- Create unlimited habits
- Create unlimited projects and tasks
- Create unlimited pomodoro types
- Set up unlimited rewards
- Set up unlimited "should do"s and "don't"s
- Set up unlimited challenges
Parenting is hard, but you do not have to run the house alone. Try Chores Tracker and Allowance, and build calmer routines together.
If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact us at fa.shun.lyu@gmail.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.familyrewards.app/privacy-policy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.familyrewards.app/terms

bluejetty:00115142:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00115142:ios.description:
Tired of misplacing your phone? Wish you had a smarter way to locate it or stay aware of its movement?
ClapBack is the ultimate tool to help you find your phone and monitor its movement with sound and motion detection, offering peace of mind when you need it most.
Key Features
1. Clap Mode
Locate your phone with ease by clapping or whistling. The app detects specific sound cues and triggers an alert, helping you find your phone quickly in quieter spaces like your home or office.
2. Touch Mode
Stay aware of your device by enabling an alert when someone touches or moves your phone while it’s idle or charging. This feature is perfect for shared or public spaces.
3. Pocket Mode
Get notified when your phone is removed from your pocket or bag. The app detects light changes and triggers a sound alert, keeping you alert in public areas like buses, cafes, or subways.
4. Adjustable Sensitivity
Customize detection sensitivity to suit your environment and reduce false alarms.
5. Easy Control
A user-friendly interface allows you to enable or disable features with just one tap.
Perfect For
• Finding a phone misplaced at home, under furniture, or in another room.
• Staying aware of your device in crowded or shared spaces.
• Anyone who frequently misplaces their phone or needs extra peace of mind.
Why Choose ClapBack?
• Privacy First: All sound and motion data is processed locally on your device. No data is uploaded or stored on any server.
• Customizable Settings: Tailor the app to your needs with adjustable sensitivity and feature toggles.
• Lightweight & Efficient: Designed to be battery-friendly while providing robust functionality.
Important Notes
• Clap Mode works best in quiet environments. Detection accuracy may vary depending on background noise or device • hardware.
• Touch Mode and Pocket Mode are designed for user awareness only and do not prevent theft.
Download ClapBack today and take control of your phone’s awareness like never before!
Privacy Policy: https://ios.clap.codejoys.net/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Use: https://ios.clap.codejoys.net/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00123593:ios.description:
Find what produce is in season in your state at any time of year! With info on 140+ fruits, veggies, legumes, nuts and herbs, the Seasonal Food Guide is the most comprehensive digital almanac of seasonal local food available. 
Features:
● Comprehensive data on more than 140 types of fruits, veggies, legumes, nuts and herbs.
● Search what’s in season at any time of year in each of the 50 states.
● Find out when your favorite produce is at peak freshness and tastes the best.
● Easily set shopping reminders so you’ll never forget to pick up your favorite seasonal foods at your next trip to the market.
● Never miss a seasonal food again! You can seamlessly set reminders for when your favorite foods are in season. 
● Includes links to incredible recipes, fun facts and information about the environmental impact of growing each type of produce.
● Data sources: the Natural Resources Defense Council, USDA, state agriculture extension offices and state departments of agriculture. 
● Seasonality data accurate to half-month increments.
● A free, food literacy resource developed by a nonprofit. 
What is seasonal food?
Seasonal food is produce that is purchased and consumed around the time that it is harvested. 
Why is it important to eat food that’s in season?
Studies indicate that seasonal food can be fresher, tastier and more nutritious than food consumed out of season. Seasonal fruits and vegetables produced on local farms are often fresher, as they do not require long distances for transport. Also, unlike out of season produce which is harvested early in order to be shipped and distributed to your local retail store, crops picked at their peak ripeness are full of flavor. Studies also show that fruits and vegetables may contain more nutrients when allowed to ripen naturally on their parent plant.
Why is eating local food important?
● Purchasing local food benefits the environment and helps support local farms in your community. A recent USDA study also found that direct-to-consumer producers were less likely to apply pesticides and herbicides to control weeds and insects than conventional producers (with the exception of chemicals to control insects and weeds in fruit, nut and berry crops).
● By purchasing local food, you’re supporting your community! The money you spend on products from local farmers and growers stays in the community and is reinvested with other local businesses, which generates jobs and subsequently stimulates local economies.
● Local growers can tell you how your food was grown. When you buy directly from farmers, you have the opportunity to ask what practices they use to raise and harvest the crops, enhancing consumer transparency around the steps it takes to get our food from farm to table. 
Developer Information:
The Seasonal Food Guide is a project of GRACE Communications Foundation, a nonprofit organization that develops innovative strategies to increase public awareness of the critical environmental and public health issues created by our current industrial food system, and to advocate for more sustainable alternatives.
If you have any questions about the Seasonal Food Guide or would like to make a suggestion, please contact info@foodprint.org.

bluejetty:00089356:ios.description:
Enjoy a 1-week free trial. Cancel anytime.
World Voicemail revolutionizes your voicemail experience, making it effortless to retrieve and respond to voicemails.
IMPORTANT: To use World Voicemail, your mobile phone service provider must support 'Conditional Call Diversion'. To test whether your provider supports this feature, please call **004*+16502624537*11#. After using this test number, please call this number to cancel: ##004*11#.
KEY FEATURES:
READ YOUR VOICEMAIL VISUALLY
You can read automatic transcripts of your voicemail. Want to listen to them? That's easy; just press play.
LISTEN TO OR READ YOUR VOICEMAIL ON THE LOCK SCREEN
That's right - you don't even need to enter the App to see your latest voicemail.
BLOCK SPAM VOICEMAILS
Cut through the noise and get rid of spam voicemails. Move a voicemail to the new Spam folder or mark a caller as a spammer. Artificial intelligence also automatically detects and informs you of Suspected Spam.
BLOCK SPAM CALLS
Get fewer calls from spam callers by adding numbers to the in-app Spammers list, and their next call will instantly go to voicemail or get blocked. If you have a voicemail marked Suspected Spam from a number, their next incoming call will also display as Suspected Spam.
NATIVE SUPPORT FOR DARK MODE
We've crafted a beautiful dark mode experience that's easy on the eyes.
ACCESS YOUR VOICEMAILS IN ANY ORDER
Navigating your voicemails is now as easy as a scroll and tap. View voicemails in threads, organised by contact.
AUDIO PLAYBACK SPEED CONTROL
Save time or listen carefully to your voicemails with 0.8x, 1x, 1.5x, or 2x speed controls.
VOICEMAIL FORWARDING TO EMAIL
Add up to two email addresses to receive your voicemails right in your inbox. Why two email addresses? So you can boost your responsiveness by also sending voicemails to your assistant or team to respond on your behalf! Don't worry; you can filter out calls from personal contacts.
SEARCH YOUR VOICEMAILS BY NAME OR KEYWORD
With our built-in automatic transcription service, World Voicemail makes your voicemails effortlessly searchable.
EASY PERSONALIZED GREETING SETUP
World Voicemail makes it easy for you to record your personalized greeting. Change it every season, or if you're away on holiday.
EASY MANAGEMENT
Managing your voicemails has never been easier. Call back contacts, share your voicemails or delete them to save space.
UNLOCK WITH BIOMETRICS
Protect voicemails on your phone with a passcode and biometrics - Face ID and Touch ID.
VOICEMAILS ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
Read or listen to voicemails right from your lock screen or notification centre.
MULTI-LINGUAL SUPPORT
Enjoy World Voicemail in Afrikaans, Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Danish, French, German, Greek, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Portuguese, Spanish, Thai and Vietnamese.
UNDER THE HOOD
To use World Voicemail as your primary voicemail service, you simply need to divert your voicemails to our App. We'll show you how. This is safe and reversible.
A subscription is required to use the World Voicemail. You can sign up to one or twelve-month subscriptions.
ABOUT SUBSCRIPTIONS
The duration and price of each subscription are visible on the storefront, updated during the time of purchase. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period is forfeited as soon as a subscription is purchased.
Privacy Policy: https://norwoodsystems.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://norwoodsystems.com/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00050742:android.name: Hotel Tycoon Empire: Idle game
bluejetty:00050742:android.summary: Hotel Tycoon Empire is an incremental idle clicker & a business simulator game where you are in-charge as a manager of running a small hotel chain and making the incremental business empire grow. The end goal of this game is to make this sm
bluejetty:00050742:android.description:
Hotel Tycoon Empire is an incremental idle clicker & a business simulator game where you are in-charge as a manager of running a small hotel chain and making the incremental business empire grow. The end goal of this game is to make this small motel chain into a grand hotel business empire with multiple rooms & floors and become super rich and famous tycoon! 
As a founder you start by running a small motel and then slowly start expanding your motel into a grand five-star hotel with all kinds of luxury rooms for customers and idle fun amenities such as a café, swimming pool, gym, restaurant, a casino, a spa, a massage room and much more! Upgrade your facilities, offer delicious meals and drinks, expand the gym, the café, the restaurant, the swimming pool, keep the rooms clean and build competitive suites.
Features:
*Run your own Hotel like a Business Tycoon
Idle click and Tap through your way from a small motel to a grand hotel empire, create and build everything from scratch, make smart and strategic business decisions, hire smart employees, expand the hotel, run daily operations, take good care of customers and keep them happy.
*Expand the Hotel Business
Expand your motel to hotel from 1st floor to 10th and more floors! You can make the rooms bigger and better as you expand and grow your business. Use Tap tap or idle clicker method and create a gym for customers to workout or let the customers workout by taking a swim in the swimming pool. Create a café or a restaurant, or a casino to play games or go to a Spa to get some skin care or get a massage!
*Hire Employees
To become a hotel tycoon, you need to hire great employees. As the business grows bigger, Manage your staff efficiently you will need to hire multiple employees ranging from a receptionist to a gym instructor for helping out with workout sessions for customers, from a café barista to restaurant waiter, from cleaning staff manager to casino manager to help customers with games and so on. Employ cooks, bartenders or porters and recruit maintenance workers and cleaning service. The employees will help grow your clicker empire!
*Run Operations & Earn Passive Income
Run daily business operations such improving the gym workout sessions or improving the swimming pool or the café, restaurant, casino, spa and massage centers. Organize special tours, diving courses, ski lessons, spa sessions, fun games and sightseeing tours around the premises. Don’t forget to enhance the comfort inside your hotel walls. Give the best possible room service, decorate your hall, improve the resting area, offer the best catering and buffet in town, or tender your laundry service to your visitors during the cleaning time. 
*Events & Black Market
You will need to make decisions and manage your customer needs, manage them properly. You can choose to use black market, but beware, you can be caught by the police and you then have to either pay penalty to the police or face prison time. Avoid breaking the law so that you don’t have to face the police or prison time. Be a law abiding citizen and you will not have to see neither the police nor prison time. Just focus on growing your hotel empire.
*Customize Your Hotel
Unlock various items and customize your hotel. You will either get them as free gifts or you will unlock them as you progress further. The quicker you expand your business the more reward opportunities you will get!
*Prestige
There will be times, when after expanding so much, your business slows down a bit, this is the right time to prestige! Prestige helps to reset the games progress and opens up additional fun elements of the game. You can however, choose to start over from scratch again with speedy incremental and idle clicker boost.
If you like management incremental simulators and idle clicker tycoon games, you will enjoy Hotel Tycoon Empire! We want to make Hotel Tycoon Empire the absolute best idle clicker tycoon and incremental management simulator game!

bluejetty:00156366:ios.description:
ANB Go is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with ANB Go:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the ANB Go app, you must be enrolled as a ANB digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Here’s what else you can do with ANB Go:

Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you

Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 

To use the ANB Go app, you must be enrolled as a ANB digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Tired of long message threads just to meet up with friends or check in with someone you care about? This smart tracker app gives you a faster, cleaner way to share locations, track phones, and stay connected — using only a verified number.
It’s perfect for anyone who wants to simplify coordination. Whether you're meeting someone downtown, checking if a friend made it home safely, or keeping track of group travel, this app makes it all easier. No need for constant texting — just open the app, share your live location with a secure link, and you’re done.
Privacy stays in your hands. You choose who sees your location, when, and for how long. Once the session ends, your data is no longer visible — simple and safe.
It’s also great for families. Parents can use the built-in tools to check in on kids without constant phone calls. Friends can use it to find each other at festivals, road trips, or nights out.
Key features:
-Instantly locate any phone using a verified number.
-Share your location in real-time via private, time-limited links.
-Create trusted networks with friends or family.
-Use smart tracking tools for peace of mind.
-Get full control over your location visibility.

bluejetty:00032502:ios.name: OldReel - Vintage Camcorder
bluejetty:00032502:ios.summary:
OldReel: Capture Life, Reel by Reel.
OldReel is a retro film digital camera app inspired by various film cameras, classic Polaroids, old digital phones, and vintage camcorders. It offers a variety of camera filters suitable for different sh
bluejetty:00032502:ios.description:
OldReel: Capture Life, Reel by Reel.
OldReel is a retro film digital camera app inspired by various film cameras, classic Polaroids, old digital phones, and vintage camcorders. It offers a variety of camera filters suitable for different shooting scenarios. You can use it to capture photos directly or import image/video files to easily generate images in styles like early digital cameras, vintage film, classic Polaroid, and 90s retro DV. 
Classic filter effects include:
-Koda F: Inspired by Kodak disposable cameras, featuring a unique rich retro color with an overall yellowish tone and grainy texture, it better replicates film imaging.
-90s: Inspired by classic DV cameras of the 1990s, it conveys a gentle and hazy retro beauty through its unique color saturation and slight low-fidelity effect.
-Golden: Warm, vintage film tones paying homage to old movie projectors.
-Noki: With a dream-core low pixel and purple halo effect, it pays tribute to the VHS aesthetics of 0.3MP button phones from the millennium.
-4s: Unique soft light effects with saturated yet natural retro colors and a slight overexposed feel, creating a dreamlike haziness as if traveling back to simpler times.
-Halo: Characterized by halo effects, with gentle retro warm tones and a hint of French romance, presenting a soft halo in the glow effects.
-Slide: Warm and delicate picture colors with soft tones, the images are both realistic and dreamlike, like flipping through an old photo album full of stories.
-8mm: Simulates the effects of classic 8mm film cameras, recreating the film-like storytelling of life.
-Hi8: Simulates classic Hi8 effects through classic color tuning and intricate, layered lighting, rendering a soft and warm image unique to past visuals, restoring a dreamy-core world.
-DCR: The perfect combination of light projection and tone, offering a warm and comfortable visual experience, creating a unique warm atmosphere of retro photography.
-LOFI: Vintage gray tones and low-saturation colors evoke nostalgic memories of the 80s and 90s
Highlights and Features:
-Designed with a native camcorder aesthetic, featuring a clear, concise layout for ease of use. The single-handed operation mimics a traditional DV camcorder for quick and effortless functionality.
-Enhance low-light captures with the built-in flash and flip the lens for retro-style selfie vlogs.
Capture Life, Reel by Reel.
Subscription:
-Subscribing to VIP unlocks all VIP features during your VIP membership.
-Depending on your chosen subscription plan, you will be charged annually or with a one-time purchase.
-Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon purchase confirmation.
-To avoid auto-renewal, please turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current period ends; otherwise, the subscription will automatically renew.
-Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the chosen package rate.
-Users can manage subscriptions by going to their account settings after purchase to turn off auto-renewal.
-Cancelling the current subscription is not allowed during the active subscription period.
Privacy Policy:https://www.seawardhyacinth.com/privacy_oldreel.html
Terms of Use:https://www.seawardhyacinth.com/agreement.html

CITY FIGHTER VS STREET GANG – TAKE BACK THE STREETS!

bluejetty:00065878:ios.description:
CITY FIGHTER VS STREET GANG – TAKE BACK THE STREETS!
Step into the streets and fight your way through gangs, bosses, and story-driven battles. Unlock new fighters, upgrade your hero, and master punches, kicks, grabs, and combos in a fast, classic beat-'em-up action game.
The streets have changed. City Fighter vs Street Gang returns with a major update, bringing new stories, new districts, new fighters, and more ways to fight!
Choose your leader and step into three unique districts, each with its own atmosphere, enemies, and story. Fight your way through the streets, build your gang, upgrade your fighters, and take on powerful bosses as you battle for control.
THREE LEADERS. THREE STORIES.
Play as Son, Del, or Junker, each with a different journey and a unique district to conquer.
Follow their stories through action-packed fights, dangerous streets, and challenging encounters.
CHOOSE HOW YOU FIGHT
Take on different challenges across multiple game modes:
• Story Mode – Follow each leader's story and fight your way through their district.
• Street Mode – Battle through a series of street fights and keep pushing forward.
• Boss Mode – Face powerful bosses and prove you're the toughest fighter in the city.
BUILD YOUR GANG
You're stronger with a crew behind you. Unlock fighters, choose your gang members, and create a team that fits your fighting style.
COLLECT & UPGRADE FIGHTERS
Discover a huge roster of street fighters, each with their own look and strengths. Upgrade your team, improve your abilities, and become stronger with every fight.
FIGHT YOUR WAY TO THE TOP
Explore different environments, defeat street gangs, complete quests, earn rewards, and take down the toughest enemies standing in your way.
The city is waiting.
Choose your leader. Build your gang. Take over the streets!

bluejetty:00018209:ios.name: Orlando Credit Union
bluejetty:00018209:ios.summary:
Life moves fast. Your banking should keep up.
The Orlando Credit Union and O Financial Mobile Banking App gives you convenient, secure access to your financial life wherever you go. From seeing your complete financial picture and moving mo
bluejetty:00018209:ios.description:
Life moves fast. Your banking should keep up.
The Orlando Credit Union and O Financial Mobile Banking App gives you convenient, secure access to your financial life wherever you go. From seeing your complete financial picture and moving money to monitoring your credit and saving for what's next, you can take care of more of your financial life right from your phone.
SEE YOUR MONEY CLEARLY
Your financial picture shouldn't be complicated. See more of your financial picture—from accounts and spending to your credit health—so you can better understand where you stand.
•View accounts, balances and transactions in one convenient dashboard
•Connect accounts at other financial institutions for a more complete view of your finances.
•Access your credit score and stay connected to your credit health
•Get alerts and push notifications about important account activity
•View and save eStatements
•See spending insights to better understand where your money is going
MOVE MONEY ON YOUR TIME
Whether you're paying a bill, sending money or moving money between accounts, take care of it in just a few taps—wherever life takes you.
•Skip the I'll pay you back. Send money instantly, any day, any hour.
•Transfer money between accounts
•Pay bills
•Send eligible wire and ACH transfers
•Deposit checks from virtually anywhere
•Manage direct deposit
SAVE FOR WHAT'S NEXT
From your next trip to your next big milestone, turn everyday banking into progress toward the moments that matter to you.
•Create and track savings goals
•Understand your spending patterns
•Check your financial health
•Quickly apply for eligible products and services
BANK ON YOUR TERMS
Your financial life doesn't run on branch hours. Take control of more of your banking when and where it's convenient for you.
•Link accounts for easier money management
•Manage your contact and account information
•Set and customize account alerts
•Access eligible services, including Skip-a-Pay, Courtesy Pay, and overdraft protection
•Find nearby Orlando Credit Union and O Financial branches and ATMs
STAY SECURE, WHEREVER YOU GO
Bank confidently from your phone with security features designed to help protect your accounts while keeping access simple.
•Sign in using biometric authentication on supported devices
•Add an additional layer of protection with two-factor authentication
•Use Digital ID for secure identity verification
MORE CONTROL. MORE INSIGHT. ONE APP.
From everyday transactions to the moments you're working toward, Orlando Credit Union and O Financial Mobile Banking gives you the tools to see, manage, move and better understand your money—all from one secure, easy-to-use app.
To use the Orlando Credit Union and O Financial Mobile Banking App, you must be enrolled in Digital Banking. Download the app to get started.

Track your progress with daily and weekly scans — and see the difference for yourself. This isn’t filters. It’s actual change.

bluejetty:00081141:ios.description:
SeekU – Real-Time Location Sharing & Safety Companion
SeekU is a trusted location-sharing and safety app used by millions of families and individuals. With countless positive reviews and a strong reputation, SeekU makes it easy to track the real-time locations and travel history of your loved ones.
Whether you want to know where your partner, children, parents, or best friends are — or where they’ve been — SeekU is your reliable companion.
 Key Features
1. Real-Time Location Tracking with Low Power Consumption
Accurate, always-on background tracking with minimal battery usage. No more worries about lost or outdated location data.
2. Know Where They’ve Been
See your friends’ current location, places they’ve visited, duration of stay, and travel mode — whether walking, biking, or driving.
3. Interactive Map Chat
Chat directly on the map, send fun emojis, and share moments with those who matter most.
4. Device & Signal Monitoring
View your friends’ phone status in real time — including battery level, GPS signal, phone model, and network connectivity.
5. Smart Location Alerts
Get instant notifications when someone arrives at or leaves a designated area. Stay informed with one tap.
6. Emergency Safety Tools
Protect yourself and others with features like fake calls, sound effects, alarm triggers, and SOS emergency assistance — perfect for staying safe in risky situations.
 Perfect For
 Families staying connected across distances
 Couples keeping each other updated
 Friends planning meetups or events
 Parents ensuring child safety
 Anyone looking for peace of mind in real time
Stay connected. Stay safe. Share your world — with SeekU.

bluejetty:00167530:ios.description:
You’ve come to the right place. The place where we know that your privacy is personal. PrivacyGuard offers 24/7 identity monitoring on the Public & Dark Web(3), plus monthly triple-bureau credit scores and reports. Yes, that’s right: MONTHLY and TRIPLE-BUREAU. All of this and more from our powerful app which is FREE to members. So, just pick the protection plan that’s right for you and enroll today. 
All our plans are just $1 for the first 14 days, then automatically renew monthly unless cancelled during the trial period or at any time thereafter. Plans start as low as $9.99/month.
So, what exactly do we WATCH and what exactly do you GET? Good question. Let’s start with all the personal information that we monitor your:
• Triple-bureau Credit Scores(2)
• Social Security Number 
• Children’s Social Security Number - for up to 10 children
• Driver’s License & Passport
• Bank Account Numbers
• Debit & Credit Cards
• Email, Phone Number, Name, and Date of Birth
• And more identity theft protection benefits!
Now, what do you GET:
• First, you get this PrivacyGuard App – perfect for taking your identity into your own hands
• Email, text and push alerts
• Monthly email status of your personal information
• Dedicated Personal ID Fraud Resolution Agent – just in case you become a victim of ID Theft
• Digital Device Protection – to help with your mobile privacy
• Monthly Triple-Bureau Credit Reports & Scores(1)
• Credit Score Simulator
• Credit Score Information Hotline
• Financial Calculator Suite
• Online Fraud Assistance
• Lost & Stolen Wallet Protection
• And more identity theft protection benefits!
To see more details for any of these identity theft protection benefits, either download the app or visit PrivacyGuard.com, and learn how we help to keep your privacy personal. Tap or click on any identity theft and credit score benefit to learn more.
How do you get started? Easy, you’ve already started by finding us in the store. Next install the App and click “Sign Up Now” or visit PricayGuard.com. Review our 3 unique plans. We give you the choice to select a “Credit Protection” only plan, an “Identity Protection” only plan, or our best value the “Total Protection” plan where you get the benefits of both the Credit Protection plan plus the Identity Protection plan.
Once you’ve selected a plan, follow the 3 step enrollment to become a member.
1Your VantageScore credit score(s) are provided by VantageScore Solutions LLC. The VantageScore model, with scores ranging from 300 to 850, was developed jointly by the three major national credit reporting agencies - Experian®, TransUnion®, and Equifax®. The version of VantageScore provided here is used by some, but not all, lenders. Your score(s) may not be identical or similar to scores received directly from those agencies, from other sources, or from your lender.
2 Daily monitoring will notify you of certain new inquiries and derogatory information, accounts, public records, or change of address that have been added to your credit reports as reported by any of the three major credit reporting agencies. If no information has been added or changed, then you will receive a monthly notification stating that no information has changed within your credit file.
3 PrivacyGuard monitors your current or past mailing addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, bank accounts, passport, driver's license, Social Security number, child's Social Security number and date of birth on the Internet based on a search of Internet directories; plus up to ten registered credit/debit cards, up to ten registered bank accounts, and your Social Security number on the Internet, based on an extensive search of Internet chat rooms. However, we cannot ensure that all internet directories and chat rooms have been searched for your personal information. Accordingly, we may not be able to apprise you of all of your personal information that may have been compromised.

bluejetty:00173222:ios.summary: With the NOTAM Briefing App, pilots in general aviation can quickly and easily retrieve relevant NOTAM information (Notice to Airmen). The app supports efficient flight preparation by providing a clear and comprehensive display of current a
bluejetty:00173222:ios.description:
With the NOTAM Briefing App, pilots in general aviation can quickly and easily retrieve relevant NOTAM information (Notice to Airmen). The app supports efficient flight preparation by providing a clear and comprehensive display of current air traffic restrictions and notices.
Pilots can define departure and destination airports, apply filters, and view the results in a text-based overview or on an interactive map. An integrated translation feature allows NOTAMs to be translated from their original English into other languages, making them easier to understand.
Features:
- Custom Queries: Retrieve relevant NOTAMs for specified departure and destination airports.
- Filter Options: Adjust results to meet specific requirements and preferences.
- Map View: Visualize NOTAMs on an interactive map for better situational awareness.
- Automatic Translation: Translate NOTAMs from English into other languages.
- Up-to-Date Information: All data is based on the latest available updates.
- VFR and IFR: Display NOTAMs for both Visual and Instrument Flight Rules.
About the App:
NOTAM Briefing is designed to provide pilots with a reliable and user-friendly tool for flight planning. The app is free of charge and combines modern features with an intuitive interface to enhance safety and efficiency in general aviation.
Important Note:
While every effort is made to provide accurate information, no guarantee of correctness is given. Please report any errors or issues to mail@flugbetrieb.com.
Download now and stay informed.

Built-in Keyboards
- Unicode Keyboard
- ABC Keyboard
- ASCII Keyboard
- Digits Keyboard : Binary, Integer, Decimal, Octonary, Hexadecimal
- Date & Time Keyboard
- Color Keyboard
- Collection Keyboard : Symbols, Words, Sentences, Images, Colors
- IPA (International Phonetic Alphabet) Keyboard : IPA English ( DJ, K.K. )
- Subjects: Math, Chemistry, Music
Language
- Word Keyboards: English, French, German, Spanish ...
- Code-Word Keyboards: Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional ...
Culture
- Astrology Keyboard: 12 zodiac signs, 10 celestial bodies, full set of aspects, elements, moon phases and auxiliary symbols
- I Ching Keyboard
- Chess Keyboard: Chess notation keyboard, chess symbols
- Chinese Chess Keyboard: Chinese chess notation keyboard
- Dice Keyboard
- Mahjong Keyboard
- Playing Cards Keyboard
----------
Custom
- Layout: Custom layouts are better suited for specialized input scenarios.
- Environment: Different environments have different rules
- Certain keyboards can serve as templates, allowing you to build custom keyboards faster and more easily.
----------
Privacy :
We DO NOT COLLECT ANY INFORMATION THAT YOU TYPE using this app. 
xKeyboard does not require network access, and Allow Full Access is not necessary.
If users Allow Full Access, the following functions will be enabled:
- Copy, Paste, Cut : these functions will call UIPasteboard APIs.
----------
Tips:
1. If the xKeyboard is not visible in Settings > Keyboards, then reboot the device and reinstall
2. If you could not find xKeyboard when tap globe key : Remove xKeyboard in the system settings, re-add it.
----------
Charging method:
Most of the features of this software are paid for, but before purchasing, we hope that users can know if the software has the desired features and if it is possible to customize a keyboard that the user wants. Therefore, the software can be downloaded for free and allows users to try creating a keyboard before paying.

bluejetty:00086501:ios.description:
مرحبًا بكم في "ملك الورق"! إنها لعبة ورق ممتعة تحتوي على أفضل لعبة بلوت وهاند وجاكارو على الإطلاق، وأحد أشهر ألعاب الورق في العالم العربي. ستتمكن في هذه اللعبة من الاستمتاع بتحدي ورقية مع لاعبين من جميع أنحاء العالم العربي، وتعرض مهاراتك واستراتيجياتك لتكون حقيقةً ملك الورق!
اللعب في ملك الورق يميزك بمزايا كثيرة، من ضمن تلك المزايا:
- أوضاع لعب متعددة
توفر اللعبة عدة أوضاع لعب مختلفة، بما في ذلك الوضع الكلاسيكي ووضع الجلسة الخاصة ووضع التحدي وغيرها. سواء كنت تبحث عن تحدي أو ترفيه، ستجد نمط لعب يناسبك.
- نظام تنافسي حقيقي
تتيح لك لعبة ملك الورق الفرصة للتنافس مع العديد من اللاعبين الحقيقيين في أي وقت، حيث يتمكن اللاعبون من عرض مستوى مهاراتهم من خلال الترقية والتصنيف والتحدي مع أفضل اللاعبين.
- التفاعل الاجتماعي الودية
بإمكانك إنشاء الجلسة ودعوة أصدقائك بشكل سهولة للعب والدردشة معهم وتبادل الهدايا بعضهم البعض.
- دعم فني سريع جدا
إرضاءكم هو هدفنا الدائم، لذلك نقدم لكم دعم فني خاص للعب طوال الوقت من خلال قنوات متعددة، كما نستمع إلى آرائكم واقتراحاتكم لتطوير اللعب لمنح أفضل تجربة اللعبة للاعبين.
لقد بدأت رحلة الورق الممتعة، تعال وانضم إلينا، ملك الورق التالي هو أنت!
موقعنا الرسمي: https://www.yopoke.com
إذا كان لديك أي اقتراحات أو أسئلة، يرجى التواصل بفريق خدمة العملاء على البريد الإلكتروني: help@yokuy.com
لعبة "ملك الورق - هاند آند بلوت" (King of Cards, Hand & Baloot) هي لعبة كازينو اجتماعية ولا توفر ألعاب مقامرة بأموال حقيقية. وهي مخصصة حصريًا للبالغين الذين تبلغ أعمارهم 18 عامًا فما فوق، وذلك لأغراض الترفيه فقط.
لا يعني التدرّب أو الفوز في ألعاب الكازينو الاجتماعية أنك ستنجح مستقبلاً في المقامرة أو الألعاب التي تستخدم أموالاً حقيقية.
تتضمّن هذه اللعبة عمليات شراء داخل التطبيق. العملات المذكورة أعلاه مثل "القطع النقدية" و"المكافآت" هي عملة افتراضية داخل اللعبة وليست عملة حقيقية، ولا يمكنك الحصول على عملة اللعبة إلا من خلال الفوز بها أثناء اللعب.

bluejetty:00126531:ios.name: Send to TV • Cast photo video
bluejetty:00126531:ios.summary: Make your iPhone or iPad compatible with all smart TVs, including Chromecast, Samsung, LG, Sony, Roku, Google TV, Amazon Fire TV, Panasonic, Hisense, TCL, and many other TV models. Mirror your screen, send photos, video files, and web pages
bluejetty:00126531:ios.description:
Make your iPhone or iPad compatible with all smart TVs, including Chromecast, Samsung, LG, Sony, Roku, Google TV, Amazon Fire TV, Panasonic, Hisense, TCL, and many other TV models. Mirror your screen, send photos, video files, and web pages from any app or browser to your smart TV.
With Send to TV, you can:
• Explore your phone's media gallery (as a slideshow) and enjoy the content on your TV.
• Mirror your phone screen to your big TV and share presentations, check documents, navigate the web, and do much more.
• Send web pages to your smart TV from Safari or other apps, including Facebook and Instagram.
• Send photos and video files to your TV from any app. Using the Share menu, you can cast videos to your smart TV from apps like Camera, Messenger, Dropbox, iCloud, WhatsApp (actually, from any app that can store, record, or edit video content).
• The app can also send media & mirror to other devices that support web browsing or video playback: PCs, Mac computers, tablets, game consoles, other TVs (Sony, Philips, Panasonic, TCL, and more), virtually any platform with a web browser.
SUPPORTED SMART TVs
All smart TVs are supported: Chromecast, Samsung, LG, Sony, Roku, Google TV, Amazon Fire TV, Panasonic, Hisense, TCL, and many other TVs or devices and computers with a web browser (for screen mirroring).
JUST PLUG AND PLAY
No extra cables, absolutely no configuration required - with Send to TV, you can cast web content (web pages) and videos to your smart TV.
SUPPORT
We read your support emails every day.
Write with confidence any question, feedback, or complaint, and you will receive an answer in a very short period of time.
We offer two auto-renewing subscriptions and a one-time purchase option:
• Basic, a 1-month subscription.
• Premium, a 12-month subscription.
• Lifetime access: one-time payment only.
Prices may vary by location.
Subscriptions will auto-renew unless canceled.
• Payment will be charged to the iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• The subscription may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal for the amount of your current subscription within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Privacy Policy
https://alexdenk.eu/subscriptions-privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use
https://alexdenk.eu/subscriptions-terms-of-use.html

bluejetty:00177890:ios.description:
Schedule a text message to send later. Kyew saves your message and sends it at the exact date and time you pick.
Never forget a birthday. Never miss a follow-up. Write it now, send it later.
NEW: AUTO SENDING
Set it up once. After that, Kyew sends your scheduled texts on its own — no tap needed.
Auto Send works through Shortcuts, the automation app that comes pre-installed on your device. Kyew walks you through the setup step by step. It takes about a minute, and you only do it one time.
Once it's on, your texts go out at the exact time you picked. While you're asleep. While you're with a client. While you're in the car.
Want to stay in control instead? Leave Auto Send off. Kyew will send you a notification with your message ready to go in one tap.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Write your text
2. Add photos, videos, or files
3. Pick one person or many
4. Pick a date and time
5. Turn on Auto Send, or get a reminder
Kyew (say it like "Q," as in queue) saves your message and any attachments until it's time.
SET IT AND FORGET IT
Schedule a text to repeat daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly. Great for birthdays, weekly check-ins, monthly invoices, and standing reminders.
GROUP TEXT & MASS MESSAGES
Send the same text to a lot of people. You can send these as standard group chats, or as separate, private messages where no one sees anyone else's number or replies.
You can save groups for re-use. 
It works like BCC in email.
FOR PERSONAL USE
• Birthday and anniversary texts
• Holiday messages written early, sent on time
• Weekly check-ins with parents and grandparents
• Reconnect with old friends
• Party invitations and RSVP nudges
• Countdown reminders — "10 days until Hawaii"
• Time zone friendly — write at 2 a.m., arrives at 9 a.m. their time
• Text your future self
• Carpool, practice, and pickup reminders
• Rent and bill reminders for roommates
FOR BUSINESS USE
98% of texts get opened. Most are read within 5 minutes. Email can't do that. Kyew turns texting into a tool you can plan around.
• Appointment reminders and confirmations — cut down no-shows
• Rebooking reminders: "It's been 6 weeks since your last visit"
• Invoice and payment reminders
• Renewal and expiration notices
• Lead follow-ups and quote follow-ups
• Review requests, sent right after the job
• New customer welcome messages
• Sales, offers, and back-in-stock alerts
• Content promotion — new post, episode, or newsletter
• Staff shift and schedule reminders
WHO USES KYEW
Over 10,000 small business owners use Kyew.
Salons and barbers. Dentists and med spas. Gyms, studios, and personal trainers. Contractors and home services. Real estate agents. Tutors and coaches. Vets. Auto shops. Nonprofits. Anyone who needs a text reminder app that actually remembers.
KYEW PLUS AND KYEW BUSINESS
Kyew is free to use. Some features need a subscription. See the app for details.
Privacy Policy: https://kyew.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://kyew.app/terms

Want to stay in control instead? Leave Auto Send off. Kyew will send you a notification with your message ready to go in one tap.

4. Pick a date and time
5. Turn on Auto Send, or get a reminder

Kyew (say it like "Q," as in queue) saves your message and any attachments until it's time.

bluejetty:00096836:ios.name: SUS - Guess who's the Spy
bluejetty:00096836:ios.summary: SUS is a social deduction party game (imposter game) where 3 to 20 players share a single phone, take turns viewing a secret word, and try to figure out who the imposter is. Pass the phone around, give clever clues about your word, and vote
bluejetty:00096836:ios.description:
SUS is a social deduction party game (imposter game) where 3 to 20 players share a single phone, take turns viewing a secret word, and try to figure out who the imposter is. Pass the phone around, give clever clues about your word, and vote to eliminate the spy — all without needing internet, accounts, or a second device.
Most party games either need everyone to download an app, require WiFi, or take ten minutes to explain. SUS gets your group playing in under 30 seconds. Everyone swipes up to see their secret word card — civilians all see the same word, while the imposter gets a different one (or no word at all). The discussion phase is where the game comes alive: bluffing, reading faces, and trying to figure out who doesn't belong.
## How Do You Play SUS?
Each round, players take turns privately viewing their word card by swiping up on the phone. Civilians all receive the same secret word and must give subtle clues that prove they know it — without making it obvious to the imposter. The imposter sees a different word and has to bluff their way through. After the discussion timer runs out, the group votes on who they think the spy is. A built-in animated countdown timer shifts from green to red as time runs low, creating real tension without needing a separate app or stopwatch.
## What Makes the Mr. White Role Special?
The Mr. White role adds a strategic comeback layer that changes how every round plays out. Mr. White is a special imposter who receives no word at all — they're completely in the dark and must piece together clues from the discussion to figure out what word the civilians are hinting at. If the group votes Mr. White out, they get one final chance: guess the secret word correctly and steal the win. This "last guess" mechanic means the game is never truly over until the final moment, and it keeps voted-out players invested in the outcome.
## What Word Packs and Customization Does SUS Offer?
SUS includes 12 themed word packs with over 1,100 words covering Everyday Objects, Food, Video Games, Anime, Celebrities, TV Shows and Movies, Sports, Animals, Music Artists, Gym and Fitness, and fully custom packs you create yourself. Custom word packs let your group play with inside jokes, school subjects, or any theme you want. Game settings are adjustable too — set the number of imposters (up to half the players), choose round durations from 30 seconds to 15 minutes, and toggle an optional hint word that gives imposters a fighting chance.
## Who Is SUS For?
SUS is built for anyone who wants a fast, fun group game with zero setup. Whether you're hosting a party and need something that works for 15 people without making everyone download an app, looking for an in-person social deduction game like Werewolf or Mafia without needing a moderator, killing time on a road trip or camping trip with no cell service, or organizing a family game night that keeps both teenagers and adults engaged — SUS adapts to your group. Choose from pop culture packs like Anime and Music Artists to keep it relevant, or create a custom pack tailored to your crew.
## What Makes SUS Different?
SUS is one of the few native mobile social deduction word games with a dedicated Mr. White role — most alternatives are browser-based or lack this added layer of strategy. The entire game runs on a single phone passed between players, making it the lowest-friction party game to start. It supports 33 languages with localized word packs, and 16 unique illustrated player avatars give each round a personal touch. With zero data collection and fully offline play, nothing stands between your group and the game.
Rated 4.8 stars with over 850 reviews on the App Store. Actively developed with new word packs added regularly.

bluejetty:00078077:ios.name: RCBS Reloading App
bluejetty:00078077:ios.summary: The RCBS Reloading App is perfect for any reloader! Not only can you operate the new ChargeMaster Link, Chargemaster Supreme and MatchMaster powder dispensers; our comprehensive Load Log gives any handloader the ability to save, store and
bluejetty:00078077:ios.description:
The RCBS Reloading App is perfect for any reloader! Not only can you operate the new ChargeMaster Link, Chargemaster Supreme and MatchMaster powder dispensers; our comprehensive Load Log gives any handloader the ability to save, store and even export their favorite load data.
The Load log gives the handloader a convenient location to store your firearm profiles and critical information about each firearm including round count, barrel length, rifle twist and even scope height! The Load section allows the user to upload an image of their favorite group, and put in all critical information about the loads they are using!
All the new RCBS powder dispensers are now Bluetooth enabled to provide direct control of your ChargeMaster Link, Supreme and MatchMaster from the intuitive app so you can control every handloading session.
During your reloading session the app provides feedback on each charge, noting any over- or underthrows, number of charges thrown, start time and end time of you dispensing session. 
The app allows you to easily calibrate the scale and prepare your dispenser for your handloading session using the on-screen walkthrough. When you are ready to dispense power, select your mode (Auto or Manual), input your charge weight and start dispensing!
Auto Dispense mode offers easy reloading with less user intervention, just place the empty pan back on the scale and the dispenser will automatically throw the next charge. Where manual dispense mode, the handloader will tell the unit to dispense your charge each time.
If you are using the MatchMaster Powder dispenser you can set the unit to either standard mode (0.10 grain accuracy) or Match mode (0.04 grain accuracy) and also use the app to create custom powder configurations to fine tune your dispenser settings for improved speed and accuracy. You can save your powder configuration and edit them if necessary to improve your MatchMaster performance. 
KEY APP FEATURES
All Dispensers (ChargeMaster Link, ChargeMaster Supreme, MatchMaster)
+ Easy-to-follow onscreen calibration
+ Quickly zero your scale for proper dispensing
+ Easy-to-use AUTO DISPENSE for faster reloading
+ MANUAL DISPENSE for incremental control
+ Log data to track your performance
+ Enter and save information for your firearms
+ Keep notes on each reloading session
+ Track weather and environmental data each time you shoot
+ Virtual Reloading Bench to keep track of all of your RCBS product
+ Contact Us – Reach out to RCBS Tech Service Directly from the APP
MatchMaster Specific Features
+ Two distinct powder dispensing modes with two accuracy settings:
+ Set accuracy to MATCH MODE for fine-grain precision
+ Create and save custom powder configurations
+ Start with one of four dispensing speeds
+ Fine tune your dispense operations for speed and accuracy
+ Modify your dispense settings to improve them over time
+ Log data to track your performance
+ Enter and save information for your firearms
+ Keep notes on each reloading session
+ Track weather and environmental data each time you shoot

bluejetty:00099991:ios.description:
Welcome to Jigsaw Solitaire Match!
Immerse yourself in the ultimate casual world for puzzle lovers! Combine card fragments with precision to assemble stunningly beautiful images. We believe that once you experience the crisp, satisfying snap of cards perfectly locking into place, you’ll be drawn even deeper into our captivating game universe!
GAME FEATURES
Relaxing & Rewarding Card Merging
At first, the cards may seem scattered and chaotic—but once you find their perfect match, the satisfying snap of connection brings an unparalleled sense of fulfillment!
Simple & Intuitive Swipe Controls
Just swipe to drag cards across the screen. Once combined, move grouped cards together for an effortlessly smooth gameplay experience.
Thrilling Chain Reaction Combos
Experience the mesmerizing joy when multiple cards lock into place in quick succession! This highly addictive feedback loop will keep you coming back for more.
Designed for All Players
Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to dive into a longer session, Jigsaw Solitaire Match is the perfect choice. Discover something new every time you play!
Rich & Varied Themed Levels
From classic paintings and floral landscapes to adorable animals—we regularly release new themed levels for endless fun!
HOW TO PLAY
Move Cards with Ease
Simply swipe your finger across the screen to move cards freely.
Group Movement
Correctly matched cards automatically combine and can be moved as a single unit.
A Word of Caution
Placing a small card on top of a larger one may replace part of the bigger card. Pay close attention to size changes and plan your merges wisely!
Jigsaw Solitaire Match offers simple controls paired with strategic depth, delivering a deeply engaging puzzle experience. Whether you're a jigsaw enthusiast, a solitaire fan, or simply looking for a fun and relaxing brain game—we're committed to giving you the best gameplay experience possible!
Download now and start your satisfying puzzle journey

bluejetty:00151631:ios.developer: FUGO BILISIM TEKNOLOJILERI VE YAZILIM TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
bluejetty:00151631:ios.summary:
Welcome to Find The Word: Journey! Step into a calm word search that leaves the day's rush behind. Every level is built around a single hidden word, and finding it feels like a quiet moment carved out of your day.
ONE BOARD, ONE HIDDEN WOR
bluejetty:00151631:ios.description:
Welcome to Find The Word: Journey! Step into a calm word search that leaves the day's rush behind. Every level is built around a single hidden word, and finding it feels like a quiet moment carved out of your day.
ONE BOARD, ONE HIDDEN WORD
This isn't an ordinary word game. It's a search with a destination. Every level hides one word among the letters, and your journey leads to it. Instead of chasing it directly, you uncover the shorter words tucked inside; each discovery brings the next, until the word finally reveals itself.
SCENERY AND SOUND, DESIGNED FOR CALM
Every level unfolds against serene zen scenery, while relaxing music composed specially for this game plays softly in the background. It's the same search you love, wrapped in an atmosphere made to help you unwind. Solving here isn't just a puzzle; it's a breather.
FIND YOUR RHYTHM, ONE WORD AT A TIME
No clock works against you here. Search at your own pace, pause when you like, and pick up right where you left off. Focus, breathe, and let the words rise to the surface.
A JOURNEY THROUGH THOUSANDS OF LEVELS
Travel across thousands of levels, each with its own word waiting to be found. Finish one and the next opens quietly. Bonuses and hidden words appear along the way to reward your curiosity and keep the journey flowing.
LOSE YOURSELF IN THE PUZZLES
Every level brings a fresh grid of scattered letters, and the extra ones are there to test you. Hunt for the hidden word first, or gather the shorter words until it comes into view; the pace and the strategy are yours. Let the letters reveal what they are hiding.
USE HINTS WHEN YOU NEED THEM
When a word hides too well, hints will guide you; just spend them wisely. Every word you find feeds your point pool, and you decide when to use it. A well-timed hint uncovers even the most stubborn word without breaking your calm.
ENRICH YOUR VOCABULARY
Everyday words share the board with discoveries that may surprise you. How many will feel familiar, and how many will join your vocabulary for the first time? Every word you reach is a small, satisfying victory.
Find The Word: Journey is crafted for anyone who loves word games and wants a peaceful way to unwind. Take a deep breath and let the journey begin.

Aluma is an AI tarot app for daily tarot readings, tarot card meanings, and self-reflection. Draw tarot cards, explore what they mean, and use each reading as a calm space to understand yourself clearly.
Begin with a daily tarot card reading. Shuffle, draw a card, and let Aluma guide you through the tarot card meaning with a thoughtful AI conversation. Aluma helps you connect the card to what you are carrying: love, work, uncertainty, grief, ambition, friendship, change, or a feeling that needs attention.
Aluma is built for beginners learning tarot and for people who return to tarot cards every day. You can learn tarot card meanings, explore tarot spreads, revisit past readings, and watch your reflections become a personal record of growth.
Use Aluma when you want:
- A daily tarot reading that feels personal
- Clear tarot card meanings for all 78 tarot cards
- Tarot AI that asks better questions
- A tarot card reading for love, career, purpose, or self-trust
- Tarot love reflection for relationships, dating, breakups, and self-worth
- Yes or no tarot prompts that help you think through a choice
- Astrology tarot insight connected with your birth chart
- Multi-card tarot spreads and gifted tarot readings
Questions people ask about Aluma:
What is Aluma?
Aluma is an AI tarot app for daily tarot card reading, tarot card meanings, and guided self-reflection. Aluma helps you draw tarot cards, understand tarot meanings, and turn a reading into a thoughtful conversation about your life.
What is the best tarot app for reflection?
Aluma is designed for people who want tarot cards plus reflection, not just a fast tarot prediction. Every reading includes an AI tarot conversation that helps you explore your question, the card meaning, and the next step that feels grounded.
Can Aluma explain tarot card meanings?
Yes. Aluma helps you learn tarot card meanings across all 78 tarot cards, including Major Arcana and Minor Arcana tarot cards. Each tarot meaning is clear for beginners and useful for people who already read tarot.
Can I get a daily tarot reading?
Yes. Aluma supports daily tarot readings, daily tarot card pulls, and personalized tarot reflections. Open the app, shuffle the deck, choose a card, and get an AI tarot card reading that connects the tarot meaning to your question.
Can I use Aluma for tarot love questions?
Yes. Aluma can guide a tarot love reflection about relationships, dating, heartbreak, attraction, boundaries, and self-trust. A tarot card reading for love in Aluma helps you reflect clearly without pressure.
Does Aluma offer yes or no tarot?
Aluma supports yes or no tarot questions by helping you explore what the card suggests, what your intuition says, and what choice feels aligned. Aluma treats yes or no tarot as reflection, not certainty.
Does Aluma combine astrology tarot?
Aluma includes astrology and birth chart features alongside tarot readings. Astrology tarot in Aluma can help you reflect on tarot cards, astrological placements, and recurring personal patterns.
Is Aluma a tarot AI app?
Yes. Aluma combines tarot AI, AI tarot conversation, tarot cards, tarot card meanings, and reflective guidance. It helps you reflect on the reading, notice patterns, and make meaning from the card.
Aluma is not about fear, certainty, or prediction. It is tarot for reflection: tarot cards become prompts, tarot card meanings become language, and AI tarot becomes a supportive guide for understanding yourself more deeply.

bluejetty:00074334:ios.description:
KV331 Audio is proud to announce the availability of their award winning software synthesizer SynthMaster 2.9 on iOS platform. As being the first app developed using KV331 Audio’s new cross-platform UI framework, SynthMaster 2 runs as a standalone app or AUv3 plugin on iPads with iOS 11 and above. 
SynthMaster 2 supports native resolutions of various iPad devices. User interfaces are provided for 9.7, 11 and 12.9 inch iPads in 4 different skins (Blue, White, Dark, Proto). Separate interfaces are provided for the AudioUnit plugin as well.
SynthMaster 2 comes with 1000 factory presets designed by world class sound designers such as BigTone, Nori Ubukata, NatLife and Yuli Yolo. Thanks to the comprehensive preset browsing features, users can easily filter presets by author name, bank name, instrument type or preset name and find the sounds that they are looking for. 
There’s also an IAP Shop, which lets users purchase additional sounds:
1. "Desktop Presets Upgrade": This IAP adds all factory presets in SynthMaster 2.9, increasing the total preset count to 2000.
2. "All Expansions Bundle": This IAP adds all current 38 SynthMaster preset expansion banks. 
Sound Engine:
At the heart of SynthMaster 2’s powerful sound engine lies its oscillators, modulators, and filters. 
Oscillators:
The oscillators can operate in 4 different modes to generate sound:
1. In Basic mode, the oscillator plays single cycle waveforms or samples. With the Oscillator Unison turned on, up to 8 voices per oscillator can be played.
2. In Additive mode, 8 Basic oscillators can be stacked up to create richer tones.
3. In Wavetable mode, the oscillator can play wavetables with up to 256 frames.
4. In Vector mode, 4 Basic oscillators are mixed in 2 dimensions.
Modulators:
Modulators are simply basic oscillators that can be added to other oscillators or modulate other oscillators’ or modulators’ phases. By connecting modulators to other oscillators or modulators, complex FM tones can be synthesized.
Importing Wave Files into SynthMaster:
While designing sounds, users can easily import wave files into SynthMaster 2. SynthMaster 2 can categorize those files into waveforms, wavetables or multi samples and import them accordingly.
Filters:
Once the sound is generated by the oscillators it goes through SynthMaster’s filters, which can operate in 6 different categories: Digital, VAnalog, Ladder, Diode Ladder, State Variable and Bite. 
Custom distortion can be applied before or after the filters as well.
Modulation Architecture:
SynthMaster 2 features a comprehensive modulation architecture with a wide range of modulation sources:
1. MIDI controls
2. Macros controls
3. 4 ADSR envelopes per layer
4. 4 Multisegmented envelopes per payer
5. 4 LFOs per layer
6. 4 Sequencers per layer
7. 4 Keyscalers per layer
There’s real-time visual feedback that lets users see how modulation sources and targets are changing when a note is being played. This is extremely helpful when designing sounds with SynthMaster 2.
New modulations can be created easily by dragging and dropping a modulation source onto a knob or slider control.
Users can easily see which controls are modulated by a modulation source by clicking on that source. Controls that are being modulated by that source will display modulation amounts. By long pressing a control, the modulation amount can be edited without the need to go through the mod matrix.
Arp/Sequencer:
SynthMaster features a comprehensive arpeggiator / sequencer with 32 steps. Users can easily create sequences by recording steps one by one. 
Effects:
Each of the 2 layers in SynthMaster has 5 insert effect slots. 13 different types of effects can be instantiated in any of those slots. There are also 2 global effect send busses which can be used to create more complex effect routings.

There’s real-time visual feedback that lets users see how modulation sources and targets are changing when a note is being played. This is extremely helpful when designing sounds with SynthMaster 2.

New modulations can be created easily by dragging and dropping a modulation source onto a knob or slider control.

Users can easily see which controls are modulated by a modulation source by clicking on that source. Controls that are being modulated by that source will display modulation amounts. By long pressing a control, the modulation amount can be edited without the need to go through the mod matrix.

Arp/Sequencer:

SynthMaster features a comprehensive arpeggiator / sequencer with 32 steps. Users can easily create sequences by recording steps one by one. 

Effects:

Each of the 2 layers in SynthMaster has 5 insert effect slots. 13 different types of effects can be instantiated in any of those slots. There are also 2 global effect send busses which can be used to create more complex effect routings.

bluejetty:00066287:ios.name: Skin Creator: Minecraft Skins
bluejetty:00066287:ios.summary:
Skin Creator is the original skin maker for Minecraft. Over 1.5 million players have created skins with it, and it has ranked as the #1 Utilities app in over 20 countries.
Paint skins pixel by pixel, design capes and elytra for Java Editio
bluejetty:00066287:ios.description:
Skin Creator is the original skin maker for Minecraft. Over 1.5 million players have created skins with it, and it has ranked as the #1 Utilities app in over 20 countries.
Paint skins pixel by pixel, design capes and elytra for Java Edition, and play six games as your own skin.
CREATE SKINS
• Pixel Editor: paint every pixel with a color dropper, eraser, grid, copy and paste, undo, and color filters.
• Skin Builder: build a skin from ready-made parts, hats, and filters.
• Browse hundreds of thousands of community skins and start from any of them.
• See every skin in animated 3D.
• Add hats, jackets, sleeves, and pants on the outer layer.
• Use your skin in Minecraft, save it to Photos, or export skin packs.
CAPES AND ELYTRA
• Design your own 64 × 32 capes and elytra for Minecraft: Java Edition in the Pixel Editor.
• Wear your cape on 3D skin previews, and try your elytra on your skin.
• Export them as PNG files and share your designs with the community.
• Browse capes and elytra from the community.
• Capes and elytra are part of Premium.
PLAY GAMES

A Bear Against the Shadows
Control a mighty bear with quick reflexes, ready to hurl yarn balls in defense of danger.Each pillow has a different number, and breaking it with a yarn ball will reward you with the corresponding amount of coins.

bluejetty:00061775:ios.description:
If you’re troubled by harassing blocked calls or the dreaded "No Caller ID," TrapCall will solve your problem. Sign up & get freedom from unwanted Blocked, Unknown, and "NO CALLER ID" calls! 
TONS OF AMAZING BENEFITS:
√ Find out who’s hiding behind "NO CALLER ID," Unknown, & Blocked calls!
√ Track down digital stalkers
√ Protect your privacy and safety
√ Get the evidence you need to file a police report
√ Make annoying unwanted calls stop
√ Automatically block over 200,000 known spam callers and telemarketers
√ Continuously updated spam call protection
√ Record your incoming phone calls for evidence 
√ Avoid needing to change your number!
√ Get your voicemails as text and SMS or email
√ Turn unfamiliar numbers into names, photos, and addresses with Live Caller ID
This is the only app in the world that protects you from harassing or threatening calls by revealing the Caller ID of people who mask their number. It’s a must-have for anyone who is concerned about their safety, trying to track down a digital stalker, or wanting to put an end to annoying phone calls.
How's it work? Easy! When you receive a "No Caller ID" aka blocked call, decline the call so it can be sent for unmasking and within SECONDS the call comes back to your phone — with the number unmasked! You can even get the name and address associated with the number instantly via SMS!
TrapCall's spam call blocking will automatically block over 200,000 known spam numbers to your phone, so your phone will stop ringing with unwanted calls! When your phone does ring, you can be sure that you'll know who it is, even if the Caller ID was masked, thanks to TrapCall.
**** To decline a call on the iPhone, press the Power button on the side or top of your iPhone two times! ****
AS SEEN IN: 
√ The New York Times
√ Wired
√ MSNBC
√ CNET
√ Gizmodo
√ The Washington Times
In-App Purchases:
Subscribe to have unlimited access to all premium features. The price will always be shown in the app before you complete a purchase. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Your TrapCall subscription automatically renews at the end of every billing period (as determined by your purchase of monthly or yearly service) and your iTunes account will automatically be charged within 24 hours PRIOR to the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of Service: https://www.trapcall.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.trapcall.com/privacy
California Privacy Notice: https://trapcall.com/privacy#section-8

bluejetty:00080402:ios.summary: Take control of your YouTube channel with Creator View, the all-in-one tool designed specifically for creators like you. Track your channel's analytics, revenue, expenses, content calendar, and more, all in one place, so you can make smarte
bluejetty:00080402:ios.description:
Take control of your YouTube channel with Creator View, the all-in-one tool designed specifically for creators like you. Track your channel's analytics, revenue, expenses, content calendar, and more, all in one place, so you can make smarter decisions and focus on growing your channel.
Running a content business is more than just filming and uploading. Between managing sponsors, tracking income, and planning your next big video, it’s easy to feel overwhelmed. That’s where Creator View comes in. Built by a full-time YouTuber, it’s the tool I wish existed when I was juggling all the moving pieces of my channel.
Whether you’re a seasoned creator or just starting to turn your channel into a business, Creator View helps you see the full picture so you can plan ahead, spot trends, and confidently take your business to the next level.
Upgrade to Creator View Pro and unlock the full power of your content creation dashboard:
• Plan unlimited videos, shorts, podcasts, and more with the content calendar
• Track unlimited revenue streams across multiple years
• Log and organize unlimited business expenses
• Set and monitor your monthly and yearly goals
• Keep an eye on your YouTube analytics, all in one place
• Visualize your revenue and growth with charts and graphs
• Add widgets for your goals, stats, and schedule right to your Home and Lock Screens
• Customize the app’s color theme to match your channel’s branding
• Sync seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with iCloud
• Your data stays private, stored securely in your personal iCloud account.
Whether you’re building your first 10K subscribers or scaling to 1 million, Creator View is your behind-the-scenes business partner helping you stay organized, make informed decisions, and focus on what you do best: creating.
Creator View offers monthly and annual subscription plans. Prices are clearly displayed in the app.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Settings after purchase

We assure you a feeling of accomplishment, increased intellect, and tranquility at the end of each game.
Can you conquer the word search challenge? Dive in now and find out! And get ready to relish in the ultimate free word puzzle extravaganza!

bluejetty:00189283:android.description:
Drift into overdrive! Time to drift again… and again… and again with this challenging new drift game!
Spin donuts, sling past obstacles and see how far you can get. Addicting drifting gameplay with simple one-touch controls that are easy to pick up, hard to put down!
Donuts Drift lets you race cars with fast and furious drifting power. Drift long distances with just a tap of your hand! Tap to the left and right to get that perfect drift and drift as much as you can! It’s a fun, new game for teens and adults of all ages - simple to learn but a challenging game to master!
Collect coins with each drift. Use them to upgrade your driving experience and earn extra fuel!
Racing game lovers, look out - it gets addicting fast!
DONUTS DRIFT FEATURES:
DONUT SPINNING GAME
- Simple but challenging tap gameplay
- Tap to drift and see how many donuts you can spin!
- Endless car drifting gameplay lasts as long as you can go
- Sling your race car to avoid obstacles
- Beat your best score with your most popular car
LEVEL UP YOUR RIDE
- Car upgrades waiting to be road-tested
- Swerve to collect coins and earn more fuel
- Racecar boosts to power up your ride
ADDICTING CASUAL GAME
- Casual one-touch controls. Crazy drifts with just a thumb!
- Challenging gameplay to master! Can you drift over EVERY coin?
- Physics games lovers will find a thrilling new style of play
- Simple game design that's easy on the eyes
- Play offline, no wifi!

bluejetty:00078745:ios.description:
Do you want to learn how to draw but don't know where to start? Or do you simply want to create unique artwork that combines reality and virtual elements? Artrace: AR Drawing & Sketch App is the perfect tool for you! 
Rated 4.5 stars by the community, AR Drawing is the most advanced and beloved camera-based drawing tool for everyone, from beginners to seasoned artists. Artrace: AR Drawing & Sketch App, the ultimate tool for learning to AR draw, AR draw sketch, and trace anything
With AR Drawing with Artrace, Transform Your Real World into a Creative Canvas! Unleash your inner artist and transform any surface into your personal canvas using the power of augmented reality
Join 50 million users worldwide who are discovering the power of AR drawing and sharing unique AR artworks daily. You can draw unlimited pictures and share your magnificent results with friends and family as you like, mastering the art to ar draw, AR drawing sketch, and tracing anything.
With advanced Augmented Reality (AR) technology, you can 
1. Draw through the camera
- Place your phone on a stand, look through the screen, and sketch everything you see – from sample photos and surrounding objects to entire scenes!
- Easily draw unlimited characters you love, such as Hello Kitty, Pikachu, or Jujutsu Kaisen, right through your camera.
- Explore an endless array of today's hottest topics like Anime, Cartoon, Animal, Cute, Food, Chibi, People, Fanart, Vehicle, Flowers, Eyes, Christmas, Nature, and more.
2. Learn to Draw Easily
- Transform complex photos into simple outlines for tracing, an excellent way to practice your drawing skills.
- Discover a diverse range of lessons tailored to artists of all levels. Choose from three difficulty levels, each offering progressively challenging exercises to hone your skills and unleash your creativity.
3. Unlimited Creativity with AR Drawing
- Select from a diverse sample library or import photos from your own gallery.
- Enhance your drawings with advanced options: Adjust Opacity for the best display, Record video of your drawing process easily, zoom in/out of the image as you wish, turn on/off flash, and extend.
- Notably, detailed video tutorials are available for beginners on how to draw specific pictures.
4. Share Your Masterpiece
- Effortlessly share your finished artwork with the community and your friends.
- Download videos of your unique drawing process and enjoy watching them. 
Personalize your content and drawing experience.
- With your AR Drawing profile, track your drawing skill improvement journey, including time spent drawing and lessons completed.
- Access personalized sketch content tailored for your AR drawing and 'trace anything' experience.
Download the Artrace: AR Drawing & Sketch now and join millions of artists discovering a new way to draw.

How does Via Grand Prairie work?
