bluejetty:00089270:ios.description:
The Via Grand Prairie app makes it easier than ever to move around Grand Prairie, TX — with a few taps, book a ride using the app and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. 
How does Via Grand Prairie work?
- Via Grand Prairie is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. Using the app, input your address and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up on a nearby corner and drop you off within a short walk of your chosen destination. Now for the clever bit; our algorithms provide journey times that are comparable to a taxi and much more convenient than other modes of travel, making on-demand transportation easier than ever before!
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our tech matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
AFFORDABLE.
Rides are priced comparable to public transport and you can add people to your bookings for even less.
Questions? Head to www.gptx.org/ViaGP or reach out at support-grandprairie@ridewithvia.com
Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00185858:ios.description:
Grow as fast as you can! 
Multiplayer online game where you play as a blob that consumes literally everything in its way!
 Start the game being a tiny blob and eat the smaller ones to grow rapidly. It takes a lot to survive as you should avoid attacks of bigger blobs as they are eager to eat you as well. When your blob is big enough to pose a danger for other players, start hunting them!
 The game is quite immersive: you should constantly grow but don't forget to escape from your rivals, as all of them are real people. Every player can become significantly bigger or lose all the progress in a moment, be careful :). 
 After every game session, you get experience points depending on the finite size of your blob and session time. With these points, you can get the level up and unlock some additional features (e.g. bigger initial mass or exclusive skins). 
 The more actions you make during a game session, the more experience you get, so don't lapse into despondency, you will be rewarded for all your efforts!
If you die at the very start, be patient, improve your skills and try again :)

bluejetty:00028193:ios.summary:
A remodeled 2D take on the fifth game in the world-renowned FINAL FANTASY series! Enjoy the timeless story told through charming retro graphics. All the magic of the original, with improved ease of play.
The King of Tycoon has sensed a dis
bluejetty:00028193:ios.description:
A remodeled 2D take on the fifth game in the world-renowned FINAL FANTASY series! Enjoy the timeless story told through charming retro graphics. All the magic of the original, with improved ease of play.
The King of Tycoon has sensed a disturbance in the wind. When the crystals that balance the powers of the world are threatened, the king hastens to the rescue...only to go missing. Somewhere a young man and his Chocobo find themselves drawn toward friends that will change their destiny.
Building on the job systems of previous games, FFV includes a diverse selection of jobs to try, and a unique ability system that lets you combine skills.
Develop your characters with free reign, and master your battle tactics in the fifth installment of the FINAL FANTASY series!
----------------------------------------------------------------------
■ Beautifully revived with new graphics and sound!
・Universally updated 2D pixel graphics, including the iconic FINAL FANTASY character pixel designs created by Kazuko Shibuya, the original artist and current collaborator.
・Beautifully rearranged soundtrack in a faithful FINAL FANTASY style, overseen by original composer Nobuo Uematsu.
■Improved gameplay!
・Including modernized UI, auto-battle options, and more.
・Also supports game pad controls, making it possible to play using a dedicated gamepad UI when connecting a gamepad to your device.
・Switch the soundtrack between the rearranged version, created for the pixel remaster, or the original version, capturing the sound of the original game.
・Now possible to switch between different fonts, including the default font and a pixel-based font based on the atmosphere of the original game.
・Additional boost features to expand gameplay options, including switching off random encounters and adjusting experience gained multipliers between 0 and 4.
・Dive into the world of the game with supplemental extras like the bestiary, illustration gallery, and music player.
*One-time purchase. The app will not require any additional payments to play through the game after the initial purchase and subsequent download.
*This remaster is based on the original "FINAL FANTASY V" game released in 1992. Features and/or content may differ from previously rereleased versions of the game.
[OS Compatibility]
iOS 13.0 or higher
[Applicable Devices]
iPhone 7 Plus, iPad (7th generation), iPad Air (3rd generation), iPad mini (5th generation) and higher

bluejetty:00022087:ios.description:
Coffee Inc 2 - Build Your Global Coffee Empire
Coffee Inc 2 is the next generation of the hit business simulation game. Start as the founder of a small cafe and grow into a world-class coffee empire. From brewing your first blend to managing thousands of employees, every decision is in your hands.
Hire and inspire great talent, develop new products, run marketing campaigns, manage your finances, and expand into major cities around the world. Compete with rival shops, dominate new markets, and prove yourself as the ultimate coffee entrepreneur.
What’s New in Coffee Inc 2
• Expand into real-world cities: San Francisco, Chicago, New York, Tokyo, Osaka, London, Paris, Berlin, Amsterdam, Rome, Madrid, Sydney, and Seattle.
• Play globally with multiple currencies: USD, EUR, JPY, and GBP.
• Customize store interiors, exteriors, and equipment - or design your own layouts.
• Set menus and pricing, and create brand-new coffee products.
• Run smarter marketing campaigns, from local promotions to city-wide brand awareness drives.
• Hire staff, keep them happy, and delegate daily operations to store managers.
• Handle unexpected incidents from both employees and customers.
• Build offices and create departments in HR, Finance, Marketing, Products, Engineering, Executive, and Investment.
• Track detailed financials with income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
• Develop online services and apps to expand beyond the cafe walls.
• Hire C-level executives like COO, CFO, CTO, and CMO - and reward them with stock options.
• Hold board meetings, set executive compensation, and decide on dividends.
• Work with investment banks to pursue IPOs and acquisitions.
• Enter the plantation business: grow your own coffee beans, manage harvests, and control quality from farm to cup.
• Diversify into real estate and stock markets through your investment division.
• Keep personal wealth separate from company wealth.
• Save and sync your progress across devices with iCloud.
• Always ad-free.

■ 사장님 홈 
상품, 서비스부터 각종 혜택까지 
사장님을 위한 모든 것을 사장님 홈에 담았어요.
* 확인해주세요
[금융 상품 및 금융 서비스 이용 안내]
- 계좌개설, 상품가입 등 모든 금융 서비스 이용은 케이뱅크 앱에서 가능합니다.
- 각 금융상품 가입 전에 상품설명서와 약관을 읽어보시기 바랍니다.
- 회원 가입 시 주민등록증 또는 운전면허증을 꼭 준비해주세요.
[단말기 및 인증수단 정책]
- 안전하고 편리한 금융서비스를 위해 등록한 하나의 앱에서만 이용 가능합니다.
- 보안카드를 대체하는 휴대폰 OTP로 안전하고 편리한 서비스를 제공합니다.
- 안전한 금융거래를 위해 '루팅' 단말기에서 서비스 이용이 제한됩니다.
[앱 이용 시 필요한 접근 권한 안내]
- 카메라(선택): 비대면 실명인증 시 신분증 촬영, 필수 서류 제출을 위해 사용
- 연락처(선택): 기기에 저장된 주소록의 연락처로 송금 시 사용
- 사진앨범(선택): 프로필에 사진 등록 및 필수 서류 제출, 이미지/사진 저장 시 사용
- Face ID(선택): 로그인, 이체 등 인증 시 사용
- 추적(선택): 맞춤 서비스/혜택 제공 시 사용
- 위치(선택): 사업장 주소 일치 여부 확인 및 비대면 현장 실사를 위해 사용
- 마이크(선택): AI 어시스턴트 시 음성 녹음을 위해 사용
- 음성인식(선택): AI 어시스턴트 시 녹음한 음성을 텍스트로 변환하기 위해 사용
[고객센터 안내]
- 은행업무 : 1522-1000 (매일 09~18시 단, 보이스피싱 및 사고신고 문의 : 매일 24시간)
- 카드업무 : 1522-1155 (평일 09~18시)
- 톡상담 : https://s.kbanknow.com/J75dj7f (24시간)
- 이메일 문의 : help@kbanknow.com

bluejetty:00073797:ios.name: Lawfully Case Tracker
bluejetty:00073797:ios.summary:
Lawfully is the US immigration case tracker for USCIS, NVC, DOL and immigration court cases. Track your case status online, get processing times, and check the visa bulletin — all in one app.
▶ 6M+ cases registered ▶ 200K+ community posts
bluejetty:00073797:ios.description:
Lawfully is the US immigration case tracker for USCIS, NVC, DOL and immigration court cases. Track your case status online, get processing times, and check the visa bulletin — all in one app.
▶ 6M+ cases registered ▶ 200K+ community posts
▶ Available in English, Spanish (Español), French (Français), Russian (Русский), Korean, Chinese
------------------
TRACK YOUR USCIS CASE
- USCIS Case Status: Check your case status online with your receipt number. See updates as soon as they are available.
- Case History Timeline: Every update saved as a timeline, so you can see how far your case has progressed.
- Instant Alerts: Push notifications the moment your case status changes. Track multiple cases at once in one USCIS case tracker.
- Visa Bulletin: Personalized visa bulletin tracking so you know when your priority date becomes current.
- NVC, DOL & Consular Cases: Track your National Visa Center (NVC) and DS-260 status, plus Department of Labor (DOL) PERM certification — beyond USCIS.
-------------------
TRACK YOUR IMMIGRATION COURT CASE (EOIR)
Enter your alien number (A-Number) to follow your immigration court case from hearing to appeal.
- Next Hearing Information: Know the date, time, and location of your next immigration court hearing.
- Court Decisions & Motions: Check decisions issued in your case and the status of motions filed.
- BIA Case Information: Track your appeal at the Board of Immigration Appeals (BIA) — not just the immigration court.
- Court Contact Information: Find the contact details for your immigration court.
- Court Alerts: Get notified when your hearing information changes.
-------------------
KNOW WHAT HAPPENS NEXT
Knowing your case status is not the same as knowing what comes next.
- Case Analysis Pro: See where you stand in line. Your case joins a boat of applicants like yours, ranked so you know when your turn is coming.
- Compare With Similar Cases: See how your case is moving against others with the same form type, service center, and filing date.
- Approval Trend Chart: See how many cases were approved this month versus last month, and whether approvals are speeding up or slowing down.
- Processing Time Trends: Real US immigration processing times by case type, from actual user data.
-------------------
GET HELP
- Talk to an Immigration Lawyer: Book a 1-on-1 video consultation with an experienced attorney — family, employment, non-immigrant visas, and RFE responses.
- Mock Interview: Practice with former consular and government officers with 20+ years of experience and 100K+ interviews. In the US or abroad.
- Community: Ask questions and share updates with 200K+ posts from applicants like you.
-------------------
CASES YOU CAN TRACK
USCIS and green card cases including I-485 (Adjustment of Status), I-130 (Family Petition), I-140 (Employment Petition), I-765 (EAD / work permit), I-131 (Travel Document), I-751 (Remove Conditions), I-90 (Green Card Renewal), N-400 (Naturalization), I-129 (H-1B and other work visas), I-821D (DACA), Asylum, DS-260 and NVC consular cases, and PERM labor certification.
Immigration court cases including hearings, motions, and BIA appeals — all in the same immigration case tracker.
Family-based green card • Employment-based green card • Non-immigrant visas • Citizenship and naturalization • NVC & DOL • Immigration court
-------------------
Disclaimer: Lawfully, Inc. does not represent, and is not affiliated with, any U.S. government entity. We do not offer legal advice, as Lawfully, Inc. is not a law firm. Lawfully provides case status information that is publicly available at https://egov.uscis.gov/casestatus/landing.do, https://ceac.state.gov/ceac/, and https://acis.eoir.justice.gov/. The app uses advanced technology to track and predict cases as accurately as possible based on case data registered in Lawfully, but results are not guaranteed.
Terms of use: https://www.lawfully.com/terms-of-service
Privacy policy: https://www.lawfully.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00132762:ios.name: Steam City: Town building Sim
bluejetty:00132762:ios.summary: The city's residents and workers are waiting for you! Create your own city in the retrofuturistic style and develop it with unique infrastructure. You'll be able to bring your most creative dreams about technological progress to life in a V
bluejetty:00132762:ios.description:
The city's residents and workers are waiting for you! Create your own city in the retrofuturistic style and develop it with unique infrastructure. You'll be able to bring your most creative dreams about technological progress to life in a Victorian-era setting.
DEVELOP RESOURCE PRODUCTION
Resources are crucial to the development of your city. In the game, you'll have to start extracting natural resources and producing the necessary materials in your factories. As mayor, you'll have to decide which resources to sell on the market and which ones to send to other cities in order to increase your city's income.
COMPLETE TASKS THAT BENEFIT YOUR CITY
You'll have your own journal in which you can keep track of all urgent tasks and the issues faced by your city. Complete tasks in order to receive a reward and improve your status as mayor. The higher your status, the more opportunities you'll unlock.
CHAT WITH FRIENDS
Often, developing your city will require you to collaborate with others. You can create a union and invite other mayors to join it in order to develop your cities together. A friendly union will allow you to freely discuss issues faced by your cities, exchange resources in a mutually profitable manner, and help each other with challenging situations.
COLLECT TAXES AND GROW YOUR POPULATION
A city is a living organism that needs resources in order to develop. Build commercial buildings to ensure that city life remains bustling and that taxes get paid on time. Collecting taxes will allow you to expand the territory of the city, construct new buildings, and grow the city's population.
Take matters into your own hands and create your own unique city!
If you encounter any issues in the game, please contact support: support.steamcity.en@redbrixwall.com
Brought to you by RED BRIX COMPUTER SYSTEMS

bluejetty:00068742:ios.summary: WorkForce Suite is an enterprise-grade workforce management app designed to support the modern deskless workforce. With capabilities like time tracking, schedule visibility, and mobile accessibility, the app empowers employees to manage the
bluejetty:00068742:ios.description:
WorkForce Suite is an enterprise-grade workforce management app designed to support the modern deskless workforce. With capabilities like time tracking, schedule visibility, and mobile accessibility, the app empowers employees to manage their work from anywhere, all while adhering to their organization’s security and compliance policies.
Key features include:
Clock in/out and track time securely
View your personal and team schedules (depending on configuration)
Check leave balances and submit time-off requests
Stay compliant with labor and IT access policies
Designed for use by mobile and deskless employees
Please note:
The WorkForce Suite requires your employer to use WorkForce Software Time, Scheduling, or Absence.
Feature availability is determined by your employer and may vary by organization.
Some settings, such as login timeouts, access restrictions, or shift visibility, are configured by your company’s IT or HR administrators.
If you experience issues accessing the app, please contact your organization’s WorkForce Software administrator.
WorkForce Suite is not a consumer app. It requires an active account provided by your employer and is intended for enterprise use only.

bluejetty:00132078:ios.summary: Get ready to transform your body, mind and energy with the Align App and your personal Pilates instructor, Bailey Brown. Bailey’s expertly designed Pilates workouts help you tone and lengthen your body, support your hormones and deliver las
bluejetty:00132078:ios.description:
Get ready to transform your body, mind and energy with the Align App and your personal Pilates instructor, Bailey Brown. Bailey’s expertly designed Pilates workouts help you tone and lengthen your body, support your hormones and deliver lasting results. Combined with healthy recipes, nutrition guidance and positive mindset practices, the Align method will keep you lean, toned and thriving.
Inside Align you will find:
• Energizing Workouts: Tone and lengthen your body with hundreds of uplifting Pilates routines that deliver lasting results. 
• Motivating Programs & Monthly Challenges: Stay inspired and motivated with our guided monthly workout challenges that help you take the guesswork out of your workout routine and see results faster.
• Diverse Movement Styles: Keep your fitness journey fresh and exciting with a variety of Pilates-based movement styles including Mat Pilates, Strength Pilates, Reformer-style Pilates and Cardio Pilates, with new classes added weekly. 
• Hormone Balance & Cycle Syncing: Align brings you a new and intuitive approach to women’s fitness by supporting your hormones, embracing your body's natural rhythms, and promoting overall wellness. 
• Recipes & Nutrition: Enjoy delicious healthy recipes to fuel your workouts and nourish your body, as well as nutrition guidance to help support you in reaching your goals. 
Take the guesswork out of your routine by following our monthly workout challenges. Each month we create a new challenge for you to complete, with daily Pilates workouts to help you stay motivated and reach your goals faster. Each week includes a balanced routine with our signature class styles – Mat Pilates, Strength Pilates, Cardio Pilates, Reformer, stretching and self-care. Stay inspired and join the amazing Align community as you make your way through each challenge together. 
If you are looking to improve your hormone health or just want to feel more aligned with your body, our signature cycle-syncing program, Align Your Cycle, includes 28 Pilates classes tailored to each day of your cycle. This program helps you align with your body's hormonal rhythms, providing the right exercises for your body in each phase. Accompanied by delicious recipes that offer essential nutrients for each phase, this program is perfect for anyone looking to balance their hormones and live in harmony with their cycle.
Whatever your fitness level, you will feel supported, connected and empowered as Bailey guides you through each Align class and program. Start your Align journey and join our community today!
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://www.align-app.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://www.align-app.com/privacy

bluejetty:00119309:ios.description:
LiveTrack is for customers of companies using Magaya Software for their logistics operations. It can be used as a full logistics portal, or just for quick tracking without login.
The app will detect and let you know should you try to connect to a non-supported version. If that happens, you or your logistics partner should contact Magaya for help with updating the system.
---
Is this app for me?
The answer is YES if the following applies to you:
1. Are you already using LiveTrack on the web? Great! Simply enter your logistics partner's 5-digit Company ID to connect. Your username and password are the same as in the web version. Hint: The partner's Company ID is displayed in your LiveTrack web portal by the company name.
OR
2. Are you using the Track2Go mobile app? LiveTrack is the faster, better replacement for Track2Go.
OR
3. Are you a customer of Magaya looking to improve customer service? Eliminate emails and phone calls by giving your customers visibility whenever they need it with LiveTrack - the tracking app and logistics portal integrated into Magaya's software products. It will work with any Magaya system on version 11 or newer. Not sure if that means you? Contact Magaya and we’ll help you get started.

The government names them “shadow cyborg”, and allows every sector to have their own shadow security force (S.E.F), but all
bluejetty:00019304:ios.description:
In the future, a strong, outstanding species is created from the combination of humans, technology and black metal.
The government names them “shadow cyborg”, and allows every sector to have their own shadow security force (S.E.F), but all of theme have to be controlled by the Headquarter placed in Century city.
Everything seems so perfect, til the day Headquarter is under attacked by a Dark Clan.
CORE, a senior cyborg soldier discovers the plot too late.
The Lord Commander of S.E.F is hacked, he slays his soldier and replace them by new shadow cyborg generation to take over the government.
After the attack, CORE joins the rebel and heads to the city seeking revenge for his comrades and destroying the Dark Clan. 
Overdrive is a combination hack n slash and action platformer with many weapons available: sword, buster sword, spear, twin dagger...with unique built-in combos.
Starting from the Dark Forest, you will face dangerous enemies and traps. In the fight, use your skill to avoid attack and make extraordinary combos.
FEATURES of Overdrive - Ninja Shadow Revenge game:
- Tutorial for newbie makes sure every player can know how to play 
- Playable OFFLINE
- Smooth game control experience
- Discover poweful combos in each weapon, make game full of fun and suprising.
- Upgrade, customize & equip your hero with epic weapons & armor suits and more!
- Ultra-stunning scifi graphic & effect 
- Giant boss with unique attack.
FIGHTING of Overdrive game:
- The screen’ll locked when enemies appear in the screen & you need to destroy numerous waves of enemies to continue going ahead.
- Using avoiding skills to survive? Killing enemies madly?
- Exploting traps & platforms to kill them?
- There are many strategies to handle them.
ADVENTURE & STORY:
- Not only combat but also challenge your self to complete each level with many dangerous platforms. 
VARIOUS WEAPONS:
- Using different weapons ( Sword, Buster Sword, Spear,...) with their perfect combos bring unforgetable hack and slash game experience.
- Players can pick their best weapons and also upgrade weapons to unlock new stronger combos. 
GRAPHIC & SOUND:
- Amazing scifi high quality graphic makes sure you will be suprised.
- It’s 2 available modes to set suitable graphic for your phone.
SO YOU GONNA BE THE HERO WHO SAVES THE WORLD? ENJOY NOW!
Have any question or feedback to make the game better? Please let us know.
Contact us via: 
Email: gms.mobilegame@gmail.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Mobile-Adventure-Game-461699647363707/

bluejetty:00200017:ios.description:
Find and collect sculptures across Portland while unlocking exciting rewards and milestones along the way. Discover the design inspiration and vote for your favourite. Share your photos to the sculpture photo galleries while tracking your steps and miles. Keep up to date with the latest trail related news and events. 
Art trail app includes: map, sculpture listings, artist bios, design inspiration, sculpture and milestone rewards, sculpture photo galleries, voting, trail stats, social sharing and event listings.
Wildwood: Follow the Crows is a Wild in Art event presented by LAIKA, benefiting OHSU Doernbecher Children’s Hospital.
Wild in Art is a leading creative producer of spectacular, mass-appeal public art events, which connect businesses, artists and communities through the power of creativity and innovation.
For 20 years, LAIKA has pioneered the field of animation--creating award-winning films, handcrafted by visionaries and artists. We're raising the bar, pushing boudaries, and redefining the kinds of stories this artform can tell. 
For 100 years, OHSU Doernbecher Children’s Hospital has changed young lives through expert care and the unwavering support of its community. From the very beginning, Doernbecher made a simple but powerful promise: to care for every child in need.
For 38 years, Downtown Portland Clean & Safe has worked to help create a cleaner, safer, and more welcoming downtown. As some of downtown’s biggest champions, the organization also leads the Visit Downtown campaign, inviting people to experience all that Portland’s central city has to offer.

bluejetty:00013841:ios.description:
A aplicação Banco do Nordeste Mobile do BNB para dispositivos móveis é um canal de atendimento para realização de consultas e operações financeiras pela Internet, proporcionando assim maior comodidade aos clientes.
A aplicação conta ainda com uma maneira fácil de descobrir qual terminal de autoatendimento do Banco do Nordeste está mais próximo a você. Utilizando a funcionalidade de localização de terminais, você tem acesso à localização exata de agências e terminais da rede credenciada. A funcionalidade indicará a melhor opção para você de acordo com a sua localização. Contando com um mapeamento total da rede de atendimento do Banco do Nordeste, o aplicativo localiza agências, postos bancários, Banco 24 horas e terminais compartilhados do Banco do Brasil.
Esta aplicação pode ser instalada em smartphones e tablets na plataforma iOS.
* Observação: A funcionalidade de leitura de código de barras para pagamentos diversos está disponível em dispositivos que possuam câmera com foco automático.

bluejetty:00083543:ios.description:
Chair Yoga for Seniors is designed to bring gentle, effective movement within easy reach of seniors — all from the comfort and safety of a chair or stable standing position. Created with the unique needs of older adults in mind, the app offers personalized wellness programs that adapt to each user’s fitness level, mobility, and goals.
Whether you want to improve flexibility, strength, balance, coordination, or simply enjoy a calm and mindful way to stay active, the app supports your journey with two complementary practices: Chair Yoga and Tai Chi for Seniors.
Programs Included
Chair Yoga for Seniors
A gentle, accessible form of yoga performed primarily while seated. Chair Yoga helps improve flexibility, joint mobility, posture, and relaxation — ideal for beginners or anyone with limited mobility.
Tai Chi for Seniors
A complete Tai Chi program designed specifically for seniors, focusing on slow, flowing movements that enhance balance, coordination, stability, and mental calm. This low-impact practice is excellent for fall prevention and overall well-being.
KEY FEATURES
Personalized Wellness Programs
After a short assessment, the app creates a tailored Chair Yoga or Tai Chi plan based on your abilities and objectives. Your program adapts over time as you progress.
Progress Tracking
Track improvements in balance, flexibility, mobility, and overall wellness. Visual progress indicators help you stay motivated and celebrate milestones.
Expert Video Instruction
All exercises are guided by certified instructors experienced in senior fitness, ensuring movements are safe, clear, and easy to follow.
Wide Variety of Sessions
Choose from calming, meditation-focused routines or more active sessions. Both Chair Yoga and Tai Chi libraries are regularly updated with new content.
ACCESSIBILITY FIRST
Designed with seniors in mind, the app features large text, simple navigation, and voice-friendly controls to ensure a smooth and comfortable experience for everyone.
Whether you’re new to mindful movement or looking for a safe way to stay active as you age, Chair Yoga & Tai Chi for Seniors offers a comprehensive, enjoyable path to better health and vitality.
Download today and experience the combined benefits of Chair Yoga and Tai Chi — at your own pace, on your own terms.
Terms of Use: https://www.theapp.studio/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.theapp.studio/privacy

The majority of personal finance app users quit tracking expenses after only a few days. The reason is that most expense tracking apps are complicated and frustrating to use. • Low-Impact & Joint-Friendly
Safe for knees, back, shoulders, and anyone returning to exercise.
• Gentle Weight-Loss Support
Burn calories and boost metabolism through slow, mindful movements safe for all levels.
• Improve Mobility & Flexibility
Loosen stiff hips, lower back, and shoulders with guided mobility flows.
• Feel Calmer & Sleep Better
Breathwork and mindful practices help reduce stress and support deeper rest.

7–15 minute routines designed for busy adults and long-term consistency.

Tai Chi, Qigong, Baduanjin, meridian stretching, and breathing techniques made simple and modern.

Download sessions for home, travel, or outdoor practice.

• Gentle, sustainable weight loss
• Better balance and stability
• Improved posture and mobility
• Reduced joint stiffness and tension
• More energy throughout the day
• Lower stress and deeper relaxation
• A calmer, healthier daily routine
Perfect For:
• Adults 40+ wanting gentle, effective weight loss
• People with stiff joints or limited mobility
• Anyone seeking low-impact, beginner-friendly routines
• Users wanting Tai Chi or Qigong made easy
• Those looking for calm, steady, holistic fitness
• Anyone building long-term health and wellness habits

bluejetty:00179504:ios.name: Sex Tracker - xTracker
bluejetty:00179504:ios.summary: xTracker is a smart, feature-rich app designed to help you privately and thoughtfully track your most intimate moments. Whether you're focused on sexual health, relationship insights, or simply want to maintain a personal history of your en
bluejetty:00179504:ios.description:
xTracker is a smart, feature-rich app designed to help you privately and thoughtfully track your most intimate moments. Whether you're focused on sexual health, relationship insights, or simply want to maintain a personal history of your encounters, xTracker offers a powerful yet elegant solution.
At its core, xTracker is a detailed calendar of your most private events and occasions. You can log the details of each encounter — including when, where, how, and with whom — creating a clear and useful timeline of your intimate life. The intuitive calendar and event views, combined with detailed statistics, help users see patterns, deepen connections, and reflect on their personal experiences.
Why track sexual activity?
In addition to fertility tracking (or avoidance), maintaining a private sexual journal can support your sexual wellness. For example, if a health screening reveals an STI, having accurate records can help you pinpoint possible exposure windows, providing useful context for both you and your healthcare provider.
Core Features:
- Calendar and event views
- Shared calendar
- Statistics and partner-based insights
- STI/STD tracker
- Period tracker
- Positions, toys, outfits, and other custom data
- Interactive map of events and locations
- Ability to add custom notes
- Catalogs with filters to explore your data easily
- Passcode protection
- Support for Apple Watch
Social & Private Sharing:
xTracker supports a group calendar feature, allowing you to share selected entries with trusted partners. Shared calendars can be collaboratively updated — each participant can add their own details or notes, making it a powerful tool for communication and shared reflection.
Privacy & Integration:
xTracker integrates with Apple HealthKit, securely reading and storing data in line with HealthKit permissions and privacy standards.
Looking back on your shared moments — where, when, and how they happened — can be both fun and revealing. xTracker gives you a beautiful and insightful way to do just that.
Subscription terms:
Subscription unlocks all content, calendar features and secure backup.
Information about the auto-renewable nature of the subscription:
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
• You can terminate your subscription via the URL: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
To find out how we protect your privacy you can read our Terms of service and Privacy Policy below:
http://xtracker.app/legal/en/privacy.html
http://xtracker.app/legal/en/tos.html

bluejetty:00179033:ios.description:
Tired of daily challenges? Now it’s the time to relax yourself with Word Universe! 
While the beautiful scenery backgrounds and music smoothes you, you will learn new words, challenge your brain and improve your vocabulary by finding hidden words. Unlock stunning landscape backgrounds to escape from home and relax your brain. we promise you'll say WOW!
This crossword puzzle starts easy and becomes challenging fast! Word Universe will test your vocabulary as you discover the wonders filled with challenging levels. It's a great fit for fans of word connect, word hunt and word anagram games.
WORD UNIVERSE FEATURES:
- You need to connect letters within the word wheel to find all the hidden words by filling the horizontal and vertical gaps in the puzzle.
- To create words, you can swipe between the letters located in the word wheel on the lower portion of the game. 
- If you get stuck, you can use hint or auto-solver. When you press the bulb button, it will give you one letter to help you to solve the puzzle and when you press ""magnifying glass"" icon, it will give you one word to help you to solve the jigsaw. 
- You can receive extra coin for each bonus word you find! 
- You can learn engrossing information within the Academy. Complete Academy to get new rewards. 
ALSO: You can get hints by watching rewarded videos or making purchase.
Word Universe is FREE to play word find game. Download and find hidden words!
Privacy Policy and Terms: https://www.librasoftworks.com/privacy-policy

Put the outside world aside as you immerse yourself in this relaxing word search game!
Improve mindfulness and relieve stress with the brand-new word search game, Word Tiles: Relax n Refresh. Relax and find all the words from stacks of letter tiles set in front of a tranquil landscape background with gentle music and peaceful sounds of nature. Take things one step at a time and clear your mind as you solve the puzzles word by word.
Word Tiles: Relax is a perfect twist of the classic word finding and anagram puzzles for anyone who loves words and needs a little more serenity in their day. Download for FREE!
HOW TO PLAY
• Connect scrambled letters to rearrange them into words!
• Swipe in any direction, vertically and horizontally.
• Each level has a clue to which all words are related! Use it to find words!
FEATURES
• EASY TO PLAY - It starts easy but gets challenging in leaps and bounds!
• DAILY CALM - Find words of famous quotes about life, friendship, and love.
• TONS OF UNIQUE LEVELS - Over 300+ puzzles with fun and amazing challenges!
• STUNNING GRAPHICS - Soothing soundtrack and gorgeous visual effects
NOTES
• Word Tiles contain ads like banners, interstitials, videos, and house ads.
• Word Tiles is free to play, but you can purchase in-app items like AD FREE and hints.

bluejetty:00015514:ios.description:
Buckle up and enter the world of My Town : Cars! If your child is showing signs of being a car enthusiast, there is no limit to the adventures they can have. Do they like working with you on the family car? Then they can work in their very own My Town : Cars garage. They will get to fix cars and even soup them up with endless car upgrades so they can have the coolest car on the road.
Or, children can start out by choosing from any of the fifteen characters and set off to purchase their very own first car at the My Town car dealership! They can drive off the lot (but don’t forget to gas it up first!) and explore the world in My Town : Cars. 
FEATURES
*Save game mode: You can exit or log out of the game, and when you pick it back up none of your progress is lost- you can continue on your adventure. 
*Multi Touch function: children can play alone, or with parents and friends on single device. 
*7 locations to explore including the car wash, dealership, gas station and more!
If you can imagine it, you can make it. Everything is possible in My Town : Cars!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. 
TELL US WHAT YOU THINK!
 You can easily contact with us on Facebook or Twitter at any time to let us know what you would like changed or added. Maybe you’ve come up with a new My Town game all on your own – let us know! We promise to read all messages and reply. We love to hear YOUR ideas, so please connect with us! 
Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
 Twitter – https://twitter.com/mytowngames
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

bluejetty:00075176:ios.description:
A powerful and comprehensive app for childbirth which covers all eventualities from natural birth to c-section and how to help your baby arrive if overdue. You can try our introductory Relaxation Visualisation for free right now and if you enjoy this you can access all the other recordings along with the digital version of the book “Birth Made Easy” via a subscription.
1. Enjoy your pregnancy, having all the energy you need to do all that you have to do
2. Have a wonderful birth experience, being relaxed and in control, working with your body and allowing your muscles and skin to stretch easily and naturally in a pain-free way
3. Promote your own rapid healing and recovery with minimal blood loss
4. Bond easily with your baby, enjoy breastfeeding (if you choose to do this) and be confident in your abilities as a mother
5. Get back to pre-pregnancy weight, shape and dimensions very soon after the birth.
6. Free access to all Harmony Hypnosis apps when you subscribe. – This allows you to continue to use Harmony Hypnosis to improve your life in all kinds of ways for as long as you want.
7. Integrates with HealthKit to record the physiological benefits of self hypnosis.
Created by renowned hypnotherapist and author Paola Bagnall who has a degree in biology and is a qualified teacher with over thirty-five years’ experience, giving her an excellent understanding of the beautifully designed female body. She retired from teaching in 2004 to take up hypnotherapy full-time.
Paola’s book, ‘Birth Made Easy’, is a comprehensive manual on her unique method, embedded in the app and a perfect accompaniment to the audio sessions.
Dr Robert Overton, MBBS DRCOG
"As a GP with an interest in hypnotherapy I found this a fascinating book. I was fortunate to benefit from Paola’s teaching and her clear communication skills make this an easy read. Techniques she describes and teaches could benefit expectant mums both during pregnancy and beyond."
Lucia Montesinos, Midwife, expert in homebirths
"This book by Paola Bagnall is a very comprehensive and easy approach to the use of self-hypnosis in childbirth. The book will take you through all the tips that you need to know for a safe and natural birth. It will also give you an insight into pregnancy, birth, and the postnatal period, and how hypnosis can help you in those different stages."
Emma Johnson – a Hypnobirthing mum
"Paola Bagnall’s method is revolutionary. It transformed my second pregnancy from dread to joyful anticipation and gave me a wonderful natural childbirth. Her empowering approach gives control of the birth process back to women, and minimises the need for medical intervention and pain relief."
Sarah Findell – a Hypnobirthing mum
"In this modern technology-driven age it’s a relief to have straight forward, practical and reassuring advice on childbirth, and it works! I am so grateful to Paola Bagnall and her techniques for helping me to experience two wonderful and natural births."
Hypnobirthing – Birth Made Easy Premium is an auto-renewing subscription which opens all locked sessions in the app as well giving access to all sessions in all Harmony Hypnosis Apps.
Download now, tap into the power of your mind, and experience pregnancy and birth with confidence and positivity.

Terms: http://hypnosisappstore.com/terms/
Privacy: http://hypnosisappstore.com/privacy-policy/
Payment is charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless cancelled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, the cost of renewal depends on which subscription you have. You will not be able to cancel an already purchased subscription during the active period, however you may turn off auto-renewal at any time. Subscriptions may be managed & auto-renewal turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00023787:ios.description:
With UploadCam the photos and videos that you take are automatically stored and organized on your Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or Box account. This means that you can access them anywhere, organize them quickly and share them easily!
Features:
► Use your existing Google Drive, Dropbox, Box or OneDrive Account - no need to create yet another service account!
► NEW: Draw on top of the images you take!
► NEW: Annotate photos by adding a custom description, date/time, location and other parameters. They will appear as an overlay in your photos
► Save space on your device by uploading your photos and videos to the cloud instead of taking memory from your iPhone or iPod touch
► Organize your photos automatically: UploadCam let's you choose or create folders to upload your new and existing photos
► Import and upload photos and videos from your 'Camera roll': You are not limited by the photos you take with UploadCam, if you take photos with the default camera app you can import them to UploadCam to send them to the cloud
► Quickly share photos with others by selecting a shared folder to save your photos
► Keep your photos and videos on your own cloud storage, no need to create new accounts or setup new services that you don't trust
IMPORTANT:
► The FREE version of this app allows you to upload up to 10 photos a day. Please consider upgrading to the full version of the app for unlimited uploads. Thanks!
► If you choose to purchase the PRO Upgrade subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.

Terms of Service: http://uploadcamapp.com/terms/app/
Requirements:
A valid Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or Box account is required to use this app

Can You Outlast the Competition?
Have you ever been told you have a dead stare? Do you have some freakish condition where you don't need to blink? Maybe you're part of the living dead? Even if you're not, StareDown Match is your chance to get some rewards.
How to Play:
Press Record: See how long you can hold that epic stare (watch as a timer taunts you, letting you know how far you have come).
Build Your Legacy: Record an epic stare-off video and submit it to the StareDown Match network (it's okay if it sucks, not everyone can be a winner).
Power Up: Boost your chances of winning with awesome power-ups like a Cherry Bomb, Thunder, 'Second Chance,' and (when you want to wuss out) a 'Breather' (a 5-second blink grace period, to blink if you need that kind of thing). Strategically place power-ups to make sure YOUR video outlasts every opponent it comes up against.

Win Big: Choose your stakes—want to test your video first (too scared to challenge)? Test it with coins on our practice match network. Or (if you have the stones for it) go all-in with our PRO matches to win.
Real-Time Results: Track your success live, see your earnings grow, and know instantly when your video wins or loses.
Analyze and Improve: Replay your losses, tweak your strategy, and resubmit for another shot at glory.
Redeem Prizes: Collect coins and tickets to redeem for amazing real-world prizes.
Challenge Friends: Link up for real-time stare-down matches against friends and family. Just for fun, no money involved—bragging rights only!
Why StareDown Match?
Because You're Awesome: Finally use that weird creepy stare you got made fun of for in school.
Real Rewards: Use your coins and tickets for REAL prizes.
Strategic Gameplay: Use power-ups and strategies to dominate your opponents.
Community: Join a network of fierce competitors (or freaks like yourself) and rise to the top.
Get Ready to StareDown and Conquer!
Are you ready to take on the world with your unblinking stare? Download StareDown Match now and prove you're an absolute freak. Only the strongest will win. Will it be you?
Download StareDown Match and start your journey to become the ultimate StareDown Champion!

The Nitrado app makes managing your Nitrado Game Servers easier than ever! Directly from your phone access your gaming server settings, your server status, and have full control over your server. Nitrado strives to provide top-quality services to all to ensure you have only the best experience when creating your very own server.

- Monitor and control server activity

- Instantly switch between 100+ different games
- Change and update your server version in seconds
- Reinstall your server files at any time
File Browsing and Management
- Full access to your server files
- Add, delete, edit, and restore server files
- Manage your server worlds with ease
- Install mods, plugins, addons, or DLC in a single click
Server and Player Monitoring
- View the total online players
- See current server runtime
- Check out server resource usage
Billing Management
- Extend your service in a few clicks
- Upgrade and downgrade instantly
- Add funds to your account
Enjoy Your Nitrado Server!

bluejetty:00037793:ios.description:
Welcome to immowelt – your all-in-one app for renting, buying and advertising properties in Germany and Austria! Find your new flat, house, flat share or new build project – from thousands of homes to rent or buy. Want to advertise a property? With our smart AI features, you can list it quickly and easily.
immowelt at a glance:
• Find a wide selection of properties – apartments, houses, flat shares & more
• Use the map or list and personalise your property search with filters
• Collect & compare all your favourites with the memo
• Save your search and be the first to get notified
• Order your SCHUFA credit report – official, digital & affordable
• My Immo: evaluate property prices, manage listings & find estate agents
Trust the award winner: The immowelt app was named the best real estate app in 2025 by the German Institute for Service Quality and ntv.
Properties for rent
Browse through a wide range of rental properties! Find apartments, houses, flat shares or commercial properties that are tailored to your needs. To ensure a smooth rental process, you can order your official SCHUFA credit report digitally at a reasonable price. immowelt helps you rent your dream home quickly and conveniently.
Flat hunting with map, filters & memo
Say goodbye to endless flat hunting! With immowelt, you can quickly find the perfect flat, flat swap or flat share. Our smart filters make your flat search easier than ever. Use the map search to see how well a flat's location suits your lifestyle – so you can find exactly what you're looking for!
Activate notifications so you never miss any new properties, and save your favourites with the memo so you can compare them easily. Try our smart property search now – your new home is just a click away!
Buy a house or flat
Discover a wide range of homes for sale and new-build projects – from charming apartments to spacious detached houses. Our intuitive property search makes it easy to find your perfect home. You can also use the mortgage calculator to make informed decisions about your property investments.
List your property
Create your property listing effortlessly and with just a few clicks – thanks to smart AI. Get in touch with interested parties directly via chat and keep track of all enquiries. Need professional advice? Use the agent search to quickly find a qualified agent. List your property today with immowelt!
Evaluate the price of your property
With the online valuation tool, you can easily calculate the value of your property free of charge. Based on the location, size and specific details of your property, you will receive a precise estimate. You can also compare current selling prices of similar properties in the neighbourhood to help you make an informed decision.
Download the immowelt app now – your smart companion for finding and advertising properties!
Follow us on social media for the latest updates and property news:
• Facebook: @immowelt
• X: @immowelt
• Instagram: @immowelt
Please share your experience with us and leave a review. If you have any questions, please contact us at support@immowelt.de
immowelt, immoweb, immonet, SeLoger, MySeLogerPro, Meilleurs Agents, Belles Demeures, LogicImmo and Yad2 are part of the AVIV Group, one of the largest digital real estate tech companies in the world.

bluejetty:00187949:ios.description:
For all your plans!
"Conquer your calendar" - The Daily List (App Store)
"Our Favourite Apple Watch Apps" - Editor's Choice (App Store)
"My Must-Have iOS Apps" - Federico Viticci (macstories.net)
Appointments and to-dos, meetings and deadlines, birthdays and dates - make the most of your time with Calendar 366!
Anything a calendar can do... Calendar 366 can do better - and all of its functions can be adjusted easily and intuitively.
A dentist appointment is not a friend’s wedding, and your calendar should know the difference.
How and how often do you want to be reminded about what’s important?
Create a calendar that matches your preferences and priorities.
INDIVIDUAL DISPLAY
Pick your preferences – year or month, week or day, list or agenda, from light red to dark to darkest blue...
EASY USE
Create your dates by natural text input, for example:
"Meeting tomorrow 10am Melrose Ave /work", or "Sauna! next Sunday 3pm -360", or simply "time to read tomorrow" – any way you like it.
Easily find and change events and reminders, repeat them, add attachments* and create notes without any hassle.
ENDLESS APPLICATIONS
Sync documents and attachments easily with all devices via iCloud*.
Easily send, accept or decline invitations.
Find a location on the go: simply search, save, and open in Apple, Google maps, HERE WeGo, Waze or maps.me.
Find your events via Spotlight. Organise your events & to-dos with Calendar Sets...
TOTAL OVERVIEW
See all that’s important today with the Calendar 366 Today widget.
APPLE WATCH-ABLE
Of course, Calendar 366 also works on the Apple Watch - giving you your complete calendar overview on your wrist.
Simply use voice input to create new events or reminders.
SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE
Calendar 366 is fully localized in English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Dutch, Italien, Polish and Chinese.
MAIN FEATURES AT A GLANCE
• Apple Watch app (iPhone)
• Apple Watch Complications: Modular (Small & Large), Utilitarian (Small, Small Flat & Large) & Circular, Extra Large, Graphic (Corner, Bezel, Circular, Rectangular)
• 10 Home Screen Widgets
• 5 Lock Screen Widgets (2 variations each)
• Join meetings with a tap
• Notifications for invitations and shared calendar changes
• Siri Watch Face support
• Siri Shortcut support
• All events and reminders at a glance
• 8 views, 9 themes
• Spotlight integration
• Calendar Se

Welcome to Match Triple Goods: Sorting 3D – The Ultimate Triple Puzzle Game!
Ready for a fresh twist on match-3 puzzle games? Dive into the most addictive and visually satisfying 3D matching experience! Pick, sort, and match your favorite goods from shelves full of 3D snacks, toys, and all kinds of fun goods. It’s fast, fun, and perfect for anyone who loves a challenge!

* Tap 3 identical items to add them to your cart.

bluejetty:00032299:ios.description:
Turn your Apple device into a simple, yet powerful digital clock with seconds, date and battery display with the MY CLOCK app. Now your phone or tablet will make a beautiful, functional and reliable tabletop clock! 
Lots of features to enjoy:
• Accessible and easy-to-use app — no sign-up required.
• Fully customizable digital clock face appearance: Seconds, Date, Battery Percentage, Color — you name it.
• Fully supports Portrait and Landscape orientations — makes a nice nightstand on any device, big and small.
• Support for OLED displays — this means richer blacks and higher-contrast colors with top-notch fidelity.
• Multiple vibrant clock colors to choose from!
• Adjustable brightness without leaving the app — just swipe left or right on the slider to decrease or increase your device's backlight illumination level!
• Flip to Save Battery mode — simply place your device face down to turn off the screen and extend your battery life!
• Built-in Flashlight — sets your screen to full brightness and turns on the torch. Never get lost in the dark again!
• Interactive Clock Widgets — so that you can get a quick glance at the latest time right on the Home Screen.
My Clock sets you up for both good night sleep and good morning wake ups — both offline and online, anytime, at any weather!

bluejetty:00152071:ios.description:
Behind the neon-lit modern metropolis, evil forces are quietly spreading. Now, the legendary ninja and elite operative known as "K" comes in full force, vowing to slash through the darkness with his blade, eradicate the sources of evil, and restore peace to the city.
Gameplay:
* Main missions: Follow K's path of protection, gradually unlock new areas.
* Side missions: Multiple mission modes including bounty hunting, special missions, armed conflicts, bounty lists, shooting ranges, etc.
* Various weapons: Bows for long-range enemy elimination with powerful damage; dual crossbows for rapid continuous fire to suppress enemies at medium range; throwing weapons capable of damaging multiple targets, ideal for eliminating groups
* Weapon upgrades: Region-limited weapons can be strengthened and upgraded, significantly improving combat effectiveness
* Talent system: Unlock exclusive skill combinations to break through combat limits
* Archive achievements: Complete hidden missions and ultimate challenges to unlock exclusive rewards
Game Features:
* 3D fps for immersive assassination experience
* Realistic physics engine accurately reproducing bow trajectories and dynamic lighting effects
* Diverse weaponry including bows, dual crossbows, throwing daggers - choose your specialty
* Multi-chapter story missions for in-depth exploration. Each region presents a new battlefield with unique styles
* Boss challenges to test your extreme operational skills
* Rich daily activities and achievement system: beginner missions, daily check-ins, limited-time events to earn free resources
Ninja's Creed 2 presents a dark world full of dangers and opportunities where every stealth operation means life or death, and every arrow determines victory or defeat. You will transform into the legendary ninja "K", moving through the neon-drenched city shadows, using exquisite archery skills and deadly assassination techniques to launch the ultimate challenge against evil forces. Every mission you complete will forge your ninja legend.
Now grab your weapons and infiltrate this conspiracy-filled shadow world. Complete thrilling main missions, accept challenging bounty quests. Upgrade your equipment, unlock powerful talent abilities, and challenge the ultimate BOSS. Are you ready to become the next shadow legend?

bluejetty:00063787:ios.description:
*Note: This app is meant for entertainment purposes only. The thumb print scan is only a simulation, and it does not actually have the ability to tell if you have been naughty or nice!
Will Santa be bringing you presents or coal this year? Have you been naughty or nice? There is only one to find out!
Naughty or Nice is a novelty prank thumb print scanner app that tries to determine if you have been naughty or nice based on a mock fingerprint scan. Simply place your thumb on the scanner and the app will tell you if you have been naughty or nice! Great app for Christmas parties or for the kids!
Naughty or Nice also contains a couple of customization options. You can adjust the speed of the scan simulation, and you can even set your own custom response, so that you can play the ultimate prank on your friends and family!

Give hope to the silent cry of innocent children and peasant women!
Control your pets, train your wolf and eagle, expand your farm!
Find deer in a lush green land full of dense trees, prepare your arrow and catch your prey!
72 rise up against the corrupt order that has broken the nation, protect your people with your art of defense!
Get justice and get fame all over the world!
Expand your army and its borders. Rule the entire world!
from a tent with 400 tents, lead the saga of the Ottoman Empire, founded with the love of the state!

Improve your fighting, horse riding, archery, swimming, climbing and swordsmanship skills!

Conquer and manage territories!

bluejetty:00200116:ios.name: Stay On Target 1138
bluejetty:00200116:ios.summary:
Some pilots, at the critical moment, switch off their targeting computer and go with their gut. Yours now tells the time — so maybe leave it on.
A wireframe tunnel. Red range lines closing in. A crosshair that locks on and holds. Stay On T
bluejetty:00200116:ios.description:
Some pilots, at the critical moment, switch off their targeting computer and go with their gut. Yours now tells the time — so maybe leave it on.
A wireframe tunnel. Red range lines closing in. A crosshair that locks on and holds. Stay On Target turns your Apple Watch into a 1970s vector targeting display, with the time underneath in a big angular red readout. It is, technically, a clock.
Spin the crown and the radio crackles — short pilot callouts, recorded for this app.
Tap the date and your week scrolls away into the distance as a text crawl: today, tomorrow, and every day after that with something on it. Drag it with a finger or spin the crown to move through at your own pace. Nothing booked? It says so, and it sounds pleased for you.
FOUR UNITS
- ANq 3.6 — the tunnel: receding frames and rays, a twelve-second loop of range sweep, lock-on and chevrons. Amber or phosphor green.
- T-s7b — the range grid: two gridded gates swinging through space, gold on crimson, a ship marker between them, contacts curving past. The gates fill with your rings.
- DS-1 — the orbital approach: a red planet edge to edge, a green moon coming out from behind it as your Move ring fills, stars lighting with Exercise, a reticle filling with Stand. Close everything and it locks on.
- YV-4 — the base tracker: the war room's plotting table. A planet dead centre, a tracker coming round it with a flashing red cone of sight that eats into the green as your Move ring fills, until it lands on your moon. Stand lights the rim scale, Exercise grows the moon.
Long-press for SYSTEMS to switch units. KEY shows what each readout means.
ON IPHONE TOO
The iPhone app is the console the display is mounted in: each unit on its own screen shape, with the date, clock, ring bars and your next appointment around it. Turn it sideways for the full console, or press FULL and keep only the display. The Mission Briefing crawl plays across the whole screen. One purchase covers both.
TWO GAMES
Tap GAMES on the iPhone console. Both are included.
Dust Runners: haul relief cargo across a desert world on a hover speeder. Twenty runs over a day shift and a night shift. Keep right, dodge the haulers, hop the rocks, blind raiders with dust and deliver on time. Three speeders, a garage of upgrades, three stars on every run.
Pilot training simulator: take the controls. Twenty short missions: dogfights, convoy escorts, carrier strikes and low runs down a narrow channel, each with its own sky and its own twist. Earn up to three stars on every mission, replay for the ones you missed, and open the next. The cockpit's targeting computer is the ANq 3.6 from this app.
WHAT IT DOES
- Always-on display: the clock keeps time while the animation rests
- Amber or phosphor green on the tunnel — tap to switch cockpits
- Radio callouts on the crown — every unit has its own, and two of them read the dial to you — silenced with one tap when you're in a meeting and your wrist starts talking
- Mission Briefing: your week's appointments as a receding crawl — drag or spin to scrub through it
- Rings, steps, resting heart rate and last night's sleep, read straight off the watch
- Countdown timers on the watch: turn the crown to set, tap the clock to start
- 12 or 24 hour, whichever way you were trained
- The watch app runs on its own; the iPhone app is optional. No account, no setup
- Collects nothing. We genuinely have no idea who you are
Tip: Settings → General → Return to Clock → 1 hour. Now it stays up like a real watch face every time you raise your wrist.
Don't get cocky.
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00124383:ios.description:
BeReal is the simplest photo-sharing app where you and your friends post once a day to show what you’re really up to.
Every day at a random time, everyone gets the same two-minute window to take and share a photo. The camera snaps both the front and back simultaneously, capturing the real moment. No filters — just real life, as it happens.
You won’t find influencers here. You’ll find your friends making coffee, walking to class, lying on the floor, laughing at nothing, or stuck in traffic. It’s not about looking perfect. It’s about being present and staying connected in a way that’s honest, unfiltered, and sometimes unintentionally hilarious.
Post on time or post late—it still counts. Comment, react with your face using RealMojis, or just scroll through your circle’s day. Your BeReal feed is private by default, unless you choose to go public and see what others are up to around the world.
If you’re tired of chasing clout and scrolling endless edits, BeReal is your once-a-day reset. One daily notification. Two minutes. Real friends, real moments.
Download BeReal and join the social network that’s not trying to be one.

bluejetty:00174845:ios.description:
Your ultimate live scores and sports news app. Goals, scores, and stories, all on Flashscore. Follow all the latest highlights across the world of sport, including soccer, tennis, basketball, ice hockey and much more. Choose from 30+ sports and 6000+ competitions and our tailored notifications will let you know about every important action of the match. 
Download Flashscore now and read the game like no one else!
Key features:
• Fastest live results: Get real-time updates with detailed statistics, xG data, unique player and team ratings, live standings and match updates.
• In-depth sports news: Stay informed with exclusive interviews, transfer news & rumors, and in-depth data analysis.
• Multimedia content: Enjoy video highlights, audio commentaries, and embedded social media updates.
• Personalized favorites: Receive top news notifications, goal alerts, and customized reminders for your favorite teams, competitions or matches.
Follow your favorite players: Add them to your list and allow notifications so that you never miss their presence in the starting lineup, goals, bookings or ratings.
• Expert match previews: Access selected opportunities and stats to enhance your sports prediction accuracy.
• Predicted lineups: Stay one step ahead and find out who is likely to start in the upcoming match given current form, unexpected injuries or lineup changes.
• Detailed player stats - Check out expected goals (xG), expected assists (xA), the number of shots, passes, touches, chances created, tackles, saves and other key data for all the players who appeared on the pitch.
LIVE SPORTS SCORES, FAST AND ACCURATE
• SPEED: Whether a goal is scored, red card issued, set or period is over, you will know at the same time as the live audience.
• GREAT COVERAGE: You can find soccer live scores, tennis scores, ice hockey results, basketball results, golf leaderboard, baseball live scores and more than 30 other sports (american football, volleyball, rugby, ...) in our app. 
Coverage of major global events & local competitions: 
Soccer: Premier League, MLS, USL Championship, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Liga MX, MLS Next Pro, Champions League (UCL), Copa Libertadores, Europa League, Copa América, Club World Championship, Club World Cup
Tennis: ATP/WTA Tour tournaments including Grand Slams (Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, US Open), ATP Finals, Davis Cup
Basketball: NBA, Euroleague, WNBA, NCAA, BSN, CBA, World Cup, Eurocup
Hockey: NHL, AHL, ECHL, USHL, NCAA, KHL, IIHF World Championship, WJC
Baseball: Major League Baseball (MLB), LIDOM, NPB, KBO, LVBP, World Baseball Classic, Carribean Series
American football: NFL, CFL, NCAA, AFL, UFL
Golf: Brittish Open (The Open), Masters, US Open, PGA Championship, Ryder Cup, Players Championship
Volleyball: Nations League, European Championship, World Championship
Darts: PDC World Championship, Premier League Darts, PDC Grand Slam, World Matchplay, UK Open, World Grand Prix
Rugby Union: TOP14, Six Nations, World Cup
NO MORE MISSED MATCHES OR UPDATES
• FAVORITE TEAMS AND MATCHES: Don’t waste your time, and follow only your favorite matches, teams and competitions.
• NOTIFICATIONS AND ALERTS: Match starts, line-ups, goals - you will not miss any of it again. Just select your favourite matches and wait for your mobile device to let you know.
LIVE RESULTS, TABLES AND MATCH DETAILS
• LIVE COMMENTARY: Unable to watch the match on TV? No problem: stay up-to-date with our detailed live text commentary.
• LIVE TABLES: One goal can change a lot. Our live standings will show you if a scored goal has changed the league ranking, as well as the current top scorers table.
• MATCH PREVIEWS AND RECAPS: Scores and numbers are important, but they don't tell everything. This is why you can find a detailed preview for every match in the most popular leagues - and also the post-match report.
Terms of Use: https://livesport.eu/terms-of-use/en
Privacy Policy: https://livesport.eu/privacy-policy/en

AlertMedia enables organizations to rapidly identify threats that impact their people or business and communicate faster to impacted
bluejetty:00188067:ios.description:
NOTE: This app is for employers and employees already using AlertMedia’s emergency communication software.
AlertMedia enables organizations to rapidly identify threats that impact their people or business and communicate faster to impacted individuals. Perform under pressure and protect your people from anywhere with our intuitive, full-featured mobile app.
For administrators:
AlertMedia’s mobile app gives you agility and visibility during critical events, wherever you are. In just a few clicks, you can send a multi-channel notification from your phone using the same intuitive screens you’re familiar with from the web or by leveraging your pre-built templates. In addition to sending notifications, you can easily manage your incoming messages and responses, connect with stakeholders via conference call, update event pages, and receive real-time warnings for any local threat that may impact your people or business.
For employees:
If your organization uses AlertMedia, download the app to ensure you never miss important communications. From the app, you can easily view new notifications, reply with helpful information, respond to surveys, and check event pages for updates from your organization. In the event you need to report an incident to administrators, you can quickly signal for help with your location attached.
NOTE: This app may use your location even when it isn’t open, which can decrease device battery life.

bluejetty:00151968:ios.description:
Welcome to Card Queen: Duel – a fantasy card world brimming with strategy and charm!
Here, you will collect cards embodied by powerful and beautiful queens, build an unbeatable deck, and engage in thrilling duels against rivals. Your wisdom and tactics will determine who is the one true Card Queen!
Core Gameplay
 Collect Legendary Queens:
Use Gold and Gems to tear open card packs and summon Queens with unique designs and dazzling skills. From divine warriors to enchanting mages, hundreds of beautiful cards in various styles await your command. Build a legendary collection that belongs only to you!
The Wisdom of Three-Card Victory:
In each battle, you will deploy three carefully selected beauty cards. Every card possesses unique Attack, HP, and Skill stats. Plan your strategy wisely: will you overpower your opponent with brute force, or outsmart them with clever skills? Victory lies at your fingertips.
Fair Strategic Duels:
Before each match begins, a coin toss will decide who goes first – ensuring every duel is fair and exciting. Strike first or counter your opponent’s moves: this tests not only the strength of your deck but also your ability to adapt under pressure!
Dive into this captivating adventure that combines card collecting, tactical planning, and a test of luck!

bluejetty:00044507:ios.summary:
"See something Say something” for smartphones   
The MBTA See Say App offers riders a quick and discreet method for reporting suspicious activity directly and instantaneously to Transit Police. Using this app, riders can send the MBTA Tra
bluejetty:00044507:ios.description:
"See something Say something” for smartphones   
The MBTA See Say App offers riders a quick and discreet method for reporting suspicious activity directly and instantaneously to Transit Police. Using this app, riders can send the MBTA Transit Police pictures, text messages, and locations of suspicious activity. 
From the App home screen, riders have two easy options for contacting Transit Police:
* The “Report a Problem” button allows riders to send text or photos directly to Transit Police. To ensure discretion, the camera flash is automatically disabled when photos are taken through the app. When reporting an issue, riders can select station locations and report categories to assist transit police. 
* The “Call Transit Police” button will connect customers directly to Transit Police.
The application is designed for the T. If you send a report in an area without cellular connectivity, it will be stored and sent when connectivity returns. The system is also design to send text before pictures so that Transit Police get reports as quickly as possible.  
Additional Features
Riders can sign up to receive MBTA T-Alerts through the app to be notified of service delays and disruptions.
BOLO alerts. (Be On the Look Out) SeeSay may also display alerts from the MBTA. For example, SeeSay may display information about a missing person, such as where they were last seen. If you see this person you may call or send a report to Transit Police.

Empower your ambitions with the Financial Times’ unrivalled, globally focused journalism.

• Accurate, independent, and insightful journalism since 1888.

• Go beyond free access with discounts and offers in the app 
• Choose from access levels based on your content needs
• Current subscribers log in for seamless access
IS THE FT FOR YOU?

From Wall Street to Hong Kong, from New York to London, FT covers not just markets and finance, but also global affairs, technology, climate policy, and industry leading social research. Whether you're unpacking the impact of elections, exploring cultural shifts, or following scientific breakthroughs, our innovative approach to news brings you deeper analysis and fresh perspectives.
With reporting from over 50 countries, opinion pieces, long-form features, and expert commentary on everything from diplomacy to digital transformation, FT is for those who think beyond the headlines. Whether you're planning your next departure to a cultural capital, exploring new culinary experiences, or seeking fresh literary insights, stay ahead of the conversation with FT.

We respect your privacy. Read our privacy policy at ft.com/privacy

bluejetty:00017802:ios.summary:
Getting out of debts is the first step on the journey towards financial freedom, and Debt Payoff Box (formerly Debt Free Box) is your companion on that journey.
Debt Payoff Box is the easiest to use Debt Payoff management app – no need to
bluejetty:00017802:ios.description:
Getting out of debts is the first step on the journey towards financial freedom, and Debt Payoff Box (formerly Debt Free Box) is your companion on that journey.
Debt Payoff Box is the easiest to use Debt Payoff management app – no need to track every transaction or detail – just set up your payoff plan once and app will help you follow it through until you are fully Debt Free.
Do you have a mortgage, car loan, student loan or any other debt that you’ve struggled with for years or months trying to clear it? You are not alone. The Debt Payoff Box will ease your mind by helping you plan to pay off your debts on time.
You no longer need to be overwhelmed by debts when there’s an app that will organize all debts in one place and help you clear them fast.
This app is FREE, so you can as well hit the install button now!
Why You Will Love Debt Payoff Box:
Snowball method and extra payment strategy:
- Define in which order you want to pay off your debts - smallest first? or highest interest first? 
- Use released monthly funds to pay off subsequent debts faster (like a snowball)
- Add extra payment every month and see how much you will save interest and time
 “Fast forward”:
- No need to manually enter your transactions! Just tell app to fast forward for you
- Fast forward allows app to update your debt to current status as if you were following initial plan
- You can manually update your debts or change your payoff plan any time 
Simple and clean user interface with no ads 
– This helps you to see results clearly and quickly.
New/Edit debt option – Allows you to edit:
- Name
- Category of the debt (auto, bank, credit card, student loan, medical, mortgage, computer, bill consolidation and others)
- Remaining balance
- Loan amount
- Interest rate 
- Next due date
- Minimum monthly payment
Shows payment schedule details:
- Balance
- Pay off debt
- Interest
- Payment amount made
- Principal
- Remaining balance
Fastest payoff - The app calculates the cheapest and fastest method of paying off your entire debt.
It gives you total control – You can go through your debts and decide which debts you should pay off first and the extra amount to pay. The app helps you to remain focused on your plan.
Supports all types of debt - The Debt Payoff Box supports different types of debts including credit card, cash loan, student loan, car loan, mortgage and more.
What-if analysis – You can try out different ‘What-if’ scenarios such as a change in the interest rate or extra monthly payments. 
Extra payment option – Helps to calculate interest and time savings.
Super compatible – It’s optimized to work on all your preferred mobile devices.
Regular updates – No more bugs or annoying crashes. The app has periodic updates to ensure it works flawlessly. The updates may also come with some new, awesome, bonus features.
Feel free to drop us a line! We’re always listening to your suggestions to improve Debt Payoff Box. If you have any issues with the app, just contact us and we will help you!
** Are you loving our app? We’d love to hear about it! Please take a moment to leave us a nice review. It really helps! **
While you’re in the sharing mood, go ahead and throw us a like on Facebook too, THANKS. 
We appreciate your support greatly! You inspire us to make more great apps like Debt Payoff Box. Start leaving debts behind by installing the Debt Payoff Box on your mobile device!

bluejetty:00098986:ios.description:
STEP INTO ALTHEA: A WORLD OF HEROES AND BATTLES
World Eternal Online is a next-generation fantasy game focused on thrilling PvE combat, boss battles, and hero progression. Join thousands of players in real-time missions, explore a vast world, and build your legend through strategy, cooperation, and skill. Take part in weekly changing events that bring fresh challenges and rewards every time you play.
FACE EPIC BOSSES AND PvE CHALLENGES
Dive into intense PvE encounters where teamwork and tactics are key. Battle colossal bosses, complete story-driven quests, and conquer escalating missions with increasing difficulty. Survival-style extraction challenges add variety and high-stakes decision-making.
COLLECT AND CUSTOMIZE POWERFUL HEROES
Unlock a diverse cast of heroes with distinct abilities and playstyles. Equip them with legendary gear, customize their appearance with unique skins and mounts, and craft powerful weapons to shape your strategy.
JOIN GUILD AND TOGETHER CLIMB THE RANKS
Form a guild to take on cooperative missions, share resources, and tackle high-level challenges together. Compete with others and climb both solo and guild leaderboards to earn exclusive rewards and recognition.
EXPLORE A LIVING FANTASY WORLD
Journey across the diverse landscapes of Althea—from enchanted forests to forgotten ruins. Discover hidden treasures, unlock lore, and experience a constantly evolving world filled with secrets and seasonal updates.
FIGHT BOSSES, CHALLENGE PLAYERS
While the heart of the game lies in PvE content, competitive players can test their skills against other players. Whether you enjoy working with others or proving yourself in head-to-head duels, there's a path for every type of adventurer.
FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS
- Strategic real-time combat with a focus on boss battles
- Hero collection, gear crafting, and progression
- Extraction-style survival missions and event challenges
- Guild-based cooperation and leaderboard competition
- Frequent recurring events and seasonal content updates
WHY PLAY WORLD ETERNAL ONLINE
Whether you're here for deep PvE experiences or light competitive play, World Eternal Online offers a flexible adventure that evolves with you. With regular game updates and a world shaped by player actions, there's always something new on the horizon.
DOWNLOAD NOW AND BEGIN YOUR JOURNEY
