bluejetty:00165937:ios.description:
Unleash your creativity with TrimCut: your all-in-one video editing studio and pro retouching app. Use our powerful AI tools, slow-motion effects, auto captions and background removal to transform your ideas into captivating stories for Reels, YouTube and FaceBook!
Powerful AI Tools
• AI Retouch: Smooth skin, eliminate blemishes and wrinkles, whiten teeth, you can easily create flawless videos for social media.
• Auto Captions: Generate accurate subtitles or lyrics with a single tap. Perfect for making your YouTube stories or Instagram Reels accessible and engaging.
• AI Remove Background: Instantly remove your video's background with one tap.
• Slow-motion effects: Transform your moment into smooth and cinematic sequences that heighten the drama and emotion.
• Auto Adjust: Automatically balances colors and lighting to make your videos or vlogs look their best.
Basic Video Editing
• Trim & Merge: Seamlessly stitch multiple clips together.
• Speed Adjustment: Precisely control the pace of your video with customizable speed curves.
• Easy Reordering & Deletion: Manage your clips intuitively with drag-and-drop.
• Draft Saving: Save your projects anytime and undo/redo with confidence.
Advanced Video Editing
• Picture-in-Picture (PIP): Layer multiple video clips to create dynamic content.
• Multi-Track Timeline: Easily overlay videos, photos, stickers, and text on a user-friendly timeline.
• Blur Video: Artfully blur the background to make yourself stand out, or add a dreamy haze to a memory, turning ordinary clips into professional-looking scenes.
Text & Brush Tools
• Use playful texts and draw directly on your video to highlight a moment, wish someone a happy birthday, or create a unique viral clip.
Trending Filters & Effects
• Professional Effects: Access a rich library of glitch, transition, VHS, and FX effects.
• Cinematic Filters: Apply movie-style filters to your videos to set the perfect mood.

• Turn your favorite photos into stunning videos in seconds. 
• Choose from trending templates with cinematic transitions, stylish effects, and perfectly synced music.

• Music Beat Detection: Automatically add markers to sync your edits with the music's rhythm, taking your videos to the next level.
• Adjust sound: Easily make your voice clear over the music, or emphasize a key moment with a sound effect boost.
Easy to Share
• 4K HD & GIF Export: Save and share your creations in stunning 4K quality or as fun GIFs.
• One-Tap Sharing: Directly share your masterpieces to your favorite social platforms.

- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- An account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan.

bluejetty:00015249:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00015249:ios.description:
“Fruits and Vegetables for Kids” is a free educational game for children between 1 and 4 years of age. 
Together with your child, you can watch wonderful images of fruits and vegetables, all while learning their names!
After the child has looked through all the flashcards, he or she can take a fun quiz to see how many of the words he or she knows. Regardless of the number of correct answers given, and of stars earned, the child's developing skills will be fostered by enthusiastic applause and floating balloons!
Does the youngster have an older brother or sister in grade school? They can also use this educational game! Besides English, this app also supports the German, Russian and Ukrainian languages. 
While playing with flashcards in a foreign language, a school-age child can effortlessly learn many new words with which to surprise their foreign language teachers and classmates. An A+ is sure to follow! 
In order to use this educational app, the youngster does not need to be able to read. The simple interface and spoken clues allow even the youngest of children to play and learn independently!
Experience has shown that children love to look through a series of colorful pictures with sounds, and they will ask to see them again and again. According to Glenn Doman, an American physical therapist and the founder of The Institutes for the Achievement of Human Potential, participating in these kinds of educational activities (for 5-10 minutes a day) stimulates the development of various regions in the brain. As a result, the child's photographic memory takes shape, the child develops much faster than his or her peers, and, beginning at infancy, the child gains access to a world of encyclopedic knowledge. 
The main point, in which Doman is undoubtedly correct, is that the younger a child, the more easily he or she can absorb new knowledge. It's important to make use of this ability while it's available!
The app can be used as a supplementary teaching aid in foreign language instruction. Supported languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Polish, Ukrainian.

bluejetty:00033918:ios.name: Chess Remix: Chess Variants
bluejetty:00033918:ios.summary:
A new way to play the world's oldest game
Love chess but tired of memorising openings? Our competitive online play is focused on thinking fast not learning patterns. Challenge yourself to overcome opponents in a randomly selected Chess Rem
bluejetty:00033918:ios.description:
A new way to play the world's oldest game
Love chess but tired of memorising openings? Our competitive online play is focused on thinking fast not learning patterns. Challenge yourself to overcome opponents in a randomly selected Chess Remix. The games all use the standard chess pieces with alternate rules. Can you think quickly and find new ways to win?
The whole world's Chess in one place
Chess Remix contains Chess games from around the world. You can try Shogi (Japanese Chess), Xiangqui (Chinese Chess), Janggi (Korean Chess), Makruk (Thai Chess) and more. These games have all been styled to look like the Chess you are used to, making it easier to learn for beginners.
A journey through the history of Chess
Travel back to where it all began, 6th century India, and try Chaturanga, the original Chess. See the games it developed into as it spread across the globe. Play Courier Chess like a 12th century European or test your skills at Tamerlane Chess.
Delve into ancient Shogi and experience the progression through different eras of Japanese history. Enjoy a marathon game of the massive Dai Shogi or a quick game of Mini-Shogi.
You can even play Hnefatafl, the Chess of the Vikings.
Chess 2.0
Chess Remix lets you change the rules and make your own game. Will you invent the next Chess?
It's your game play by your rules. You could win by losing the game,
start in random places or just have En Passant be a forced move. Don't like casting? You can turn it off. Want a Rook that also moves like a Knight? You got it. There are limitless possibilities (okay technically there is a limit, but there are so many options you could never play all of them).
Not just Chess
We have so many options to customise your Chess game you can even play Checkers. The app comes pre loaded with a variety of Checkers games from around the world and some ancient versions of the game. You can even play some other abstract board games like Three Men's Morris or even Tic-Tac-Toe.
Become more than a Chess Master
A standard Chess game has 6 pieces. Chess Remix starts with more than 100. To help you learn them we have hand designed levels to help you understand and use every piece in Chess history and the new rules you might encounter.
Unleash your creativity
Have you created the next great board game? Or just something cool you would like to show off. Share your creations with the Remix community.
Want to play unique games? Need some inspiration? Check out our discover section to see what other players have made.
Features:
- Competitive online play
- Create your own original board games
- Levels to help you learn and master Chess
- Play against ai
- Highly customisable app that reflects your style
- Share your creations or play other people games

bluejetty:00157890:ios.description:
Supercharge Your TelePlus Experience with Advanced Features!
Take your messaging experience to the next level with powerful tools designed for seamless multitasking, privacy, and enhanced communication. Whether you're managing multiple accounts, engaging with communities, or improving productivity, this app provides everything you need for a more efficient and secure chat experience.
FEATURES & ADVANTEGE:
1.Multi-Session Support – Seamless Switching Without Reloads
Tired of reloading TeleWeb every time you switch between accounts? With this app, you can run multiple TeleWeb sessions simultaneously, allowing you to switch between different accounts effortlessly without interruptions.
2.AI-Powered Smart Replies – Craft the Perfect Message Instantly
Enhance your messaging with AI-generated responses based on your preferred tone. Choose from:
• Formal – Perfect for professional conversations.
• Casual – Ideal for friendly and relaxed chats.
• Expand – Add more details to your message.
• Shorten – Make messages concise and to the point.
With AI assistance, crafting the perfect response has never been easier.
3.Lock & Secure Specific Chats – Protect Your Privacy
Maintain privacy and security with chat lock functionality. Restrict access to specific chats, ensuring private conversations remain confidential. Whether it’s work-related discussions or personal messages, you have full control over who can view them.
4.Direct Messaging Without Saving Numbers – Quick & Easy
Send messages instantly on iMessage, WhatsApp, and TeleChat without needing to save a contact. Ideal for quick interactions, customer support, or one-time messages, this feature helps keep your contact list clutter-free.
5.Discover & Join Groups – Connect with Like-Minded People
Explore an extensive collection of TeleChat groups based on your interests and preferred language. The smart filtering system makes it easy to connect with like-minded individuals, communities, and professional networks.
6.Explore Popular Channels – Stay Updated with Your Interests
Find the best TeleChat channels, neatly categorized for different topics like news, technology, entertainment, business, and education. Stay updated with high-quality content tailored to your interests.
7.Smart Bot Collection – Automate & Enhance Your Chats
Access a selection of TeleChat bots to automate tasks, retrieve useful information, and add more functionality to your chats. Whether it’s managing tasks or enhancing conversations, these bots make messaging even more powerful.
8.Private Notes – Securely Save Important Information
Need to quickly jot down something important? With Private Notes, you can securely save reminders, to-do lists, passwords, ideas, or any other information in one place—without needing a separate notes app.
9.Express Yourself with a Huge Collection of Stickers
Make your conversations more engaging with a vast library of stickers! Whether you want to add humor, emotions, or creativity to your chats, the sticker collection has something for every mood and occasion.
ABOUT SUBSCRIPTION:
Our app offers weekly, monthly, and yearly subscriptions.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled 24 hours before the next billing.
• Payment is charged to your iTunes Account at purchase.
• Manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings.
Download Now & Elevate Your Chat Experience!
Whether you're looking for a more efficient way to manage TeleWeb, enhance messaging with AI, or explore a rich collection of groups, channels, and bots, this app has it all. Upgrade your chat experience today!

bluejetty:00137531:android.description:
Rev up your engines for a whole new adventure with "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing" – the ultimate thrill ride that transforms the world of drag racing into an extraordinary exploration of power, agility, and raw speed across diverse terrains! In this groundbreaking racing game, you're not just confined to asphalt; you'll tackle the rough and tumble of off-road trails, the slick and unpredictable paths of snow-covered landscapes, the high-speed thrill of cutting through water with hydroplanes, and even the quirky challenge of racing lawn mowers. It's a game where the adrenaline never stops pumping, and every race is a test of your skill, strategy, and determination to win.
Join the Community
LIKE US ON FACEBOOK for the latest news, updates, and community events:
https://www.facebook.com/OffroadOutlawsGame
Your Experience Matters
Launching "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing" is just the beginning of our journey together. Your feedback is crucial to us; it helps pave the way for improvements and enhancements. If you stumble upon any hurdles on the track, amidst the snow, or over the waves, please let us know. Your input will help us refine the game, ensuring a smoother and more exhilarating racing experience for everyone.
FEATURES
UNLIMITED CUSTOMIZATION
Embark on a customization journey that breaks all boundaries. Whether you're gearing up a hydroplane for aquatic dominance, tuning a snowmobile for precision on snow, enhancing an off-road vehicle's resilience, or boosting a lawn mower's speed for sheer novelty, the sky's the limit. Personalize your machine to mirror your racing ethos and stand out in every challenge.
CAR SHOWS
Showcase your beautifully designed racer in our diverse vehicle exhibitions. Challenge enthusiasts from around the globe, demonstrating your vehicle's supremacy in handling dirt, snow, and water. Victories in these shows bring not just glory but also rewards that highlight your engineering and design skills.
COMPETE ONLINE
Dive into the competitive spirit of online multiplayer races. With "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing," every terrain becomes a battleground for supremacy. From navigating treacherous dirt paths, snow-laden tracks, to slicing through the waves, your adaptability and skill are your tickets to the leaderboard.
DEEP TUNING SYSTEM
Master your vehicle's performance with an in-depth tuning system. Adjust everything from the suspension for snowy terrains to gear ratios for quick sprints on dirt tracks. Utilize our comprehensive dyno testing to ensure your vehicle is tuned to perfection, ready to take on any challenge thrown its way.
CRITICAL MODIFICATIONS
Progress means pushing your vehicle beyond its limits. Strategic upgrades are key to maintaining a competitive edge across all terrains. Enhance your machine with the latest technology and modifications, ensuring it's always ready to face the diverse challenges of "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing."
FREE TO PLAY
"Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing" is freely accessible and supported by ads. For those seeking an uninterrupted experience, any in-game purchase will disable ads, letting you focus solely on the race.

listings.name: Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing
listings.description:
Rev up your engines for a whole new adventure with "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing" – the ultimate thrill ride that transforms the world of drag racing into an extraordinary exploration of power, agility, and raw speed across diverse terrains! In this groundbreaking racing game, you're not just confined to asphalt; you'll tackle the rough and tumble of off-road trails, the slick and unpredictable paths of snow-covered landscapes, the high-speed thrill of cutting through water with hydroplanes, and even the quirky challenge of racing lawn mowers. It's a game where the adrenaline never stops pumping, and every race is a test of your skill, strategy, and determination to win.

Join the Community
LIKE US ON FACEBOOK for the latest news, updates, and community events:
https://www.facebook.com/OffroadOutlawsGame

Your Experience Matters
Launching "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing" is just the beginning of our journey together. Your feedback is crucial to us; it helps pave the way for improvements and enhancements. If you stumble upon any hurdles on the track, amidst the snow, or over the waves, please let us know. Your input will help us refine the game, ensuring a smoother and more exhilarating racing experience for everyone.

FEATURES

UNLIMITED CUSTOMIZATION
Embark on a customization journey that breaks all boundaries. Whether you're gearing up a hydroplane for aquatic dominance, tuning a snowmobile for precision on snow, enhancing an off-road vehicle's resilience, or boosting a lawn mower's speed for sheer novelty, the sky's the limit. Personalize your machine to mirror your racing ethos and stand out in every challenge.

CAR SHOWS
Showcase your beautifully designed racer in our diverse vehicle exhibitions. Challenge enthusiasts from around the globe, demonstrating your vehicle's supremacy in handling dirt, snow, and water. Victories in these shows bring not just glory but also rewards that highlight your engineering and design skills.

COMPETE ONLINE
Dive into the competitive spirit of online multiplayer races. With "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing," every terrain becomes a battleground for supremacy. From navigating treacherous dirt paths, snow-laden tracks, to slicing through the waves, your adaptability and skill are your tickets to the leaderboard.

DEEP TUNING SYSTEM
Master your vehicle's performance with an in-depth tuning system. Adjust everything from the suspension for snowy terrains to gear ratios for quick sprints on dirt tracks. Utilize our comprehensive dyno testing to ensure your vehicle is tuned to perfection, ready to take on any challenge thrown its way.

CRITICAL MODIFICATIONS
Progress means pushing your vehicle beyond its limits. Strategic upgrades are key to maintaining a competitive edge across all terrains. Enhance your machine with the latest technology and modifications, ensuring it's always ready to face the diverse challenges of "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing."

FREE TO PLAY
"Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing" is freely accessible and supported by ads. For those seeking an uninterrupted experience, any in-game purchase will disable ads, letting you focus solely on the race.

bluejetty:00152954:ios.description:
Offline Mode Added!
A new offline play mode has been added, allowing you to play without a network connection.

Join the community!
https://discord.com/invite/jqUKG7bFxV
Smash your limits in VolleyGirls, the high-energy volleyball game where every rally counts.
Lead an all-girl roster from school gymnasiums to national championships, sharpen their signature moves, and feel the thrill of real-time play-by-play commentary that keeps every spike, block, and dig electric.
Key Features
Intense 4-on-4 Volleyball Action
Take full control of all 4 positions: Wing Spiker, Middle Blocker, Setter, and Libero!
Experience the thrill of real volleyball with responsive button controls for serving, setting, and spiking.
Lead the game with quick-attack tosses and pinpoint spike targeting using precision aim guides.
Build Your Dream Team
Scout uniquely skilled players from multiple schools, collect position-based card packs, and trigger powerful School Buffs when you field four teammates from the same alma mater.
Story, League & Tournament Modes
Experience the journey of first-year Ji-su Han as she discovers her passion for volleyball and rallies a team of rookies into contenders. Climb seasonal leagues, fight through high-stakes playoffs, and conquer knockout tournaments to earn exclusive rewards.
Dynamic Skill System
Master flaming spikes, lightning serves, iron-wall blocks, and more than a dozen elemental techniques that can double damage, extend combos, or drain opponents with damage-over-time effects.
Accessible for All Skill Levels
Choose from Normal or Pro control modes. Whether you’re a casual fan or a competitive player, VolleyGirls has the gameplay for you.
Live Commentary & Broadcast Atmosphere
A professional announcer and color-commentator react to every play, while unique gym intros set the stage for each match.
Train, Customize, Dominate
Boost player stats, customize ball skins and lobby backgrounds,
and outsmart tough rivals with strategic attribute combinations.
More Than a Game: A Story of Friendship & Growth
Follow Ji-su and her teammates as they forge bonds, overcome obstacles, and chase championship glory together.
Step onto the court with VolleyGirls and discover how high you can soar.

bluejetty:00174465:ios.name: Helios - Sun & Moon Tracker
bluejetty:00174465:ios.summary: Discover the magic of perfect skylight with Helios - your essential companion for capturing stunning outdoor photos and videos. Whether you're a professional photographer, an avid hiker, a traveler seeking the perfect shot, or just someone
bluejetty:00174465:ios.description:
Discover the magic of perfect skylight with Helios - your essential companion for capturing stunning outdoor photos and videos. Whether you're a professional photographer, an avid hiker, a traveler seeking the perfect shot, or just someone who loves taking photos with your phone, Helios helps you find those magical moments when natural light transforms the ordinary into the extraordinary.
WHAT ARE MAGIC HOURS?
The golden hour casts a warm, glowing light shortly after sunrise or before sunset, perfect for portraits and landscapes. The blue hour bathes everything in a serene, twilight blue just before sunrise or after sunset, ideal for moody and atmospheric shots. These magic hours are when your photography truly shines, and Helios makes sure you never miss them. The app works anywhere in the world, even without an internet connection, making it an indispensable tool for anyone who cares about lighting.
BEAUTIFUL DESIGN
Helios embraces modern design with its refined liquid glass aesthetic that feels right at home on your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac. The interface is intuitive and elegant, featuring a sophisticated dark theme that's easy on the eyes while planning your shoots. Every detail has been carefully crafted to make exploring light and time as beautiful as the moments you're planning to capture.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED
Helios brings together everything you need in one streamlined experience. The main screen shows you a complete outlook of today's sun and moon events with a stunning realistic visualization, alongside a built-in calendar for planning ahead. Your current location and all your saved places live together in one convenient view, so you can quickly check conditions anywhere you've bookmarked.
The integrated Map Explorer lets you search for new locations and explore sun and moon positions anywhere in the world at any time. See exactly where the sun will rise or set, track golden hour and blue hour times, and plan your shoots with precision using detailed line-based visualizations.
For real-time guidance, the Live View provides a spatial experience that overlays celestial information directly on your camera view, so you can track the sun and moon's path through the sky in augmented reality. The Light Meter tool helps you nail the perfect exposure with detailed information right alongside your camera feed.
When you're checking out the outlook for a place, you'll see helpful information cards including map views and Look Around (subject to availability), giving you a better sense of the place and helping you plan the perfect spot for your shot. Set up personalized notifications to stay informed about upcoming magic hours, so you're always ready when the light is just right.
TRUSTED BY THOUSANDS
With over 50,000 downloads and a 4.7 average rating worldwide, Helios has been featured on the App Store Today page and recognized as one of the best iOS apps by TechnoBuffalo and Apple User. Join the community of photographers, travelers, and outdoor enthusiasts who rely on Helios to make the most of natural light.
Helios is more than an app - it's your guide to mastering time and light, ensuring you're always in the right place at the right moment.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tryhelios.app/privacy

bluejetty:00169487:ios.description:
Thump to the rhythm and bounce to the beat with these cute, fuzzy, and kinda gross, musical monsters! 
Full of toe-tapping mischief and off beat melodies, Thumpies is a unique rhythm-based game where you keep the beat alive by tapping in time with Thumpies as they bounce and tumble to the musical score. 
The original inspiration for the hit mobile game My Singing Monsters, Thumpies is now remastered and re-imagined! 
Keep the Beat
Make the Thumpies happy by tapping in time to the rhythm and filling the Thump-o-Meter. Make a mistake, and the meter will deplete!
Make Some Noise
Enjoy an excellent musical score as the Thumpies drum along!
Crazy Critters
Meet the Thumpies, a collection of fuzzy monsters who live to bounce! Each of the Thumpies has its own unique look, each one wilder than the last!
FEATURES
• Full Remake of the 2010 classic
• 26 Thumpies to unlock (including previously unreleased Thumpies)
• 17 Levels and 83 Stages to complete
• All New Achievement System - challenge yourself to Platinum each stage!
• New Assist Mode - get help mastering challenging songs
For more information, check out: https://www.bigbluebubble.com/home/games/thumpies/
Make sure to check out My Singing Monsters to enjoy the franchise which Thumpies started, and to collect all of the new Thumpies Costumes available!

bluejetty:00135450:ios.description:
Vons Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Vons’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food, pharmacy prescriptions and fuel. Choose convenience that fits your schedule: grocery delivery or DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup service. 
CONVENIENT GROCERY DELIVERY OR PICKUP 
Get grocery delivery or choose DriveUp & Go™ for easy curbside grocery pickup. Use Schedule & Save to automate your household essentials and save more on every order. Flash™ 30-minute delivery available in select markets for additional convenience. 
SEND GROCERIES AS A GIFT 
Shop, add a personalized message & send fresh groceries, flowers, chocolates or everyday essentials to anyone — delivered to their door or ready for store pickup. Select "Make this order a gift" at checkout, with no extra gifting fees. It is the perfect way to care for loved ones, celebrate special occasions, send a thoughtful thank-you gift or help out a friend with a fully stocked fridge. 
MEET YOUR AI SHOPPING ASSISTANT 
Take the guesswork out of meals with Ask AI. Use everyday language to ask for recipe ideas, find items based on dietary needs or compare products. Whether you're asking "What can I make with chicken and rice?" or looking for "gluten-free snacks," our assistant helps you build your grocery list fast. 
MEAL PLANNING & RECIPES 
Get inspired with thousands of shoppable recipes designed to fit every budget and preference. Import your favorite recipes into the app to convert ingredients into a digital shopping list. Plan your weekly menu & add all necessary items to your grocery shopping list with a single tap. 
SHOP EASIER & FASTER 
Quickly add items to your cart based on frequent purchases, recommendations & past orders. View and reorder from your order history at any time. Save your favorite household items, scan barcodes at home to add products to your digital cart instantly and build repeatable shopping lists. 
LOYALTY, DEALS & COUPONS 
Maximize your budget by clipping digital coupons, tracking your fuel points and watching your savings stack up automatically at checkout. Find hundreds of weekly grocery coupons, digital offers and exclusive sales. Earn, track and redeem Vons for U™ rewards automatically as you shop. Try FreshPass® for unlimited free grocery delivery on eligible orders, exclusive perks and subscriber-only savings. 
SECURE SNAP/EBT & WIC PAYMENT OPTIONS 
Use your SNAP/EBT benefits to easily pay for online grocery delivery and DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup orders on eligible items, subject to state availability. WIC benefits are also accepted in store at participating Vons locations only. 
YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD PHARMACY & HEALTH APP 
Order eligible prescriptions in the app and pick them up curbside through DriveUp & Go™ at 1,700+ participating pharmacy locations nationwide. Transfer your prescriptions to save more on your next grocery order, refill scripts for your family or pets, schedule vaccine appointments, access health tests and manage your wellness goals with Sincerely Health. Choose to bundle your Rx with your grocery pickup in one easy trip or go pharmacy-only. 
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS 
Monitor your nutrition, steps, sleep and activity. Earn rewards as you eat better, move more and stay active through the Sincerely Health wellness hub. Take advantage of custom health insights, track your daily wellness metrics, unlock premium rewards for making positive health choices and set achievable goals that support your complete physical well-being. 
FUEL 
Now you can pay and redeem Points for Fuel in the app. Save 10 cents off per gallon for every 100 Points, up to $1 off per gallon. Drive up, fill up and go! Available at select Safeway, Albertsons, Tom Thumb, Randalls, Carrs, Acme, and Vons-owned stations. 
Download the Vons app and sign in or create your account to start shopping, saving and simplifying your week.

Showami is an on-demand showing solution that connects you with the largest network of licensed real estate agents. Show homes, host open houses, and perform other property tasks for a pay-per-service fee. Showami’s agent network is qualified, vetted, and licensed, ensuring access whenever and wherever you need.
How Showami Works
Simply open the app to schedule or accept a showing, open house, or property-related task. Once the showing is complete, feedback is provided, and payment is on its way! Flexible, fast, convenient, and reliable!
Earn More On Your Terms
Earn money by showing homes, hosting open houses, property photography, lockbox runners, and more! Showami offers you opportunities in the geographic area you choose at times when you are available to help.
Leverage Your Time
Showami helps you schedule showings so you can leverage your time and spend it better where it matters most. More time with your family, a much-needed vacation, improve time management, and enhance client service.
Download for FREE and start earning and saving time today!

Showami is the #1 proptech solution for on-demand showings that leverages Showing Agents for quick, reliable, and efficient property showings, open houses and much more. With hundreds of thousands of successful requests completed nationwide at a 97% pick up rate and the average request being picked up in less than three minutes, Showami helps agents maintain control over their schedules while retaining their commissions. The Showami community is made up of dedicated nationwide real estate professionals committed to supporting one another.

The National Counselor Examination (NCE) is a 200-item multiple-c
bluejetty:00133632:ios.description:
Pass your NCE with flying colors! Boost your confidence in passing the first time with our mobile app and a personal study plan based on your current skill and requirements.
The National Counselor Examination (NCE) is a 200-item multiple-choice examination designed to assess knowledge, skills, and abilities determined to be important for providing effective counseling services. The NCE is a requirement for counselor licensure in many states. It is also one of two examination options for the National Certified Counselor (NCC) certification. It may also be accepted by military health systems to become a recognized provider.
Follow a specially designed personal study plan and train yourself to pass first time!
Key features:
- Choose from different topics required to pass a certification
- Practice with 500+ questions
- Track your strengths and weaknesses within Stats section of the app
- Study detailed statistics of every test you take
- Compare your score to the community average for almost any type of exam
- - - -
Purchases, subscriptions and terms
You need to buy a lifetime access or subscribe to get access to all features, courses and questions. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions are auto-renewable and are billed at the rate and period selected depending on the subscription plan. Users’ accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of use: https://mastrapi.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://mastrapi.com/policy

bluejetty:00063155:ios.description:
America's #1 local music video station
IN THE AIR, EVERYWHERE over the Great San Francisco Bay
LIVE LOCAL LOUD AND CLEAR
California Music Channel (CMC) is an American music video broadcast television network based in the San Francisco Bay Area. It is one of the longest running local music video television stations in the world. CMC has been broadcasting music videos over the air in the Bay Area since 1982. CMC has grown from an hour-long program to two 24/7 stations with digital simulcast capabilities. The live broadcasts feature on-camera disc jockeys, audience participation, and contemporary music videos. It is owned by CMC Broadcasting Company, Inc. CMC is carried as a Digital Broadcast Network nationally on nine Northern California television stations plus company owned and operated KTVJ-LD Boise, Idaho. CMC is also carried as a live linear channel on various Free ad-supported streaming television platforms and the California Music Channel App available for download to connected TVs and mobile devices.
CMC DJ personalities include Chuy Gomez, Mary Diaz, Mia Amor, Hood Rat Miguel, and Lori Rosales, all professional San Francisco radio/tv announcers with a combined experience of many years. CMC's friendly announcers host the most popular music videos in the world, take requests and give away valuable prizes. You can call the Station toll free. Winners are put on air live. Fans also call or email their song requests. Within seconds you'll hear your name, dedication, and favorite song. CMC personalities are Bay Area residents delivering up to the minute information about the community they know and love.
Thanks for watching CMC. We look forward to hearing from you.

apple-macos:550892332.name: MyStuff2 Pro
apple-macos:550892332.description:
It's now easier than ever to keep track of all your stuff. Organize your collections, music, movies, books, video games, electronics, wine lists, jewelry, appliances, office supplies, or anything else in your possession with this easy to use but powerful database and inventory application.
MyStuff2 Pro allows you to get organized. Avoid buying something you already have. Make it easy to find your stuff. Be prepared in case of theft, fire, or flood.
NOTE: The initial free version has a limit of 15 items but it includes all Pro features so you can try out all functionality. Once upgraded to unrestricted items, the Pro level features become optional in-app purchases.
Data entry is made easy with barcode scanning and product search, autofill, quick copy, and bulk editing.
User definable categories allow you to keep track of what you want and how you want it. MyStuff2 Pro comes with sample categories to get you started quickly but you can set it up any way you desire to fit your needs.
Here is a small list of things you can keep track of:
• Movies
• Music
• Books
• Video Games
• Coins
• Stamps
• Quilting/knitting/sewing materials
• Wine Cellar
• Garage Sales / Estate Sales
• Art
• Electronics
• Appliances
• Toys
• Clothes
• Jewelry
• Furniture
• Product Inventory
• Anything you want to organize
Maintain multiple, independent databases of information.
Automatically sync your data between your iOS and macOS devices or share your data automatically with other MyStuff2 Pro users.
Import existing data from other applications using CSV files, Excel (xlsx) and Open Document (ods) spreadsheet files.
Transfer data into or out of MyStuff2 Pro using your own computer, email, iCloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, Box, OneDrive, ftp, other apps, or other iOS/macOS devices running MyStuff2 Pro.
